ORC:2903.01.heading: AGGRAVATED MURDER 2903.01(A) ORC
ORC:2903.01.text: _____________ did purposely, with prior calculation and design, cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME) by means of (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2903.01(A) of the Ohio Revised Code – Aggravated Murder.

ORC:2903.01.heading: AGGRAVATED MURDER 2903.01(A) ORC
ORC:2903.01.variant: PURPOSELY WITH PRIOR CALCULATION: UNLAWFUL TERMINATION OF ANOTHER’S PREGNANCY
ORC:2903.01.text: _____________ did purposely, with prior calculation and design, cause the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME) by means of (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2903.01(A) of the Ohio Revised Code – Aggravated Murder.

ORC:2903.01.heading: AGGRAVATED MURDER 2903.01(B) ORC
ORC:2903.01.variant: PURPOSELY AND WHILE COMMITTING A SPECIFIED OFFENSE
ORC:2903.01.text: _____________ did purposely cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME) while (Committing or attempting to commit) (CHOOSE ONE: Kidnapping, rape, aggravated arson, arson, aggravated robbery, robbery, aggravated burglary, burglary, terrorism, escape) to wit: (DESCRIBE FACTS OF OFFENSE COMMITTED OR ATTEMPTED), in violation of Section 2903.01(B) of the Ohio Revised Code – Aggravated Murder.

ORC:2903.01.heading: AGGRAVATED MURDER 2903.01(B) ORC
ORC:2903.01.variant: PURPOSELY AND WHILE COMMITTING A SPECIFIED OFFENSE: UNLAWFUL TERMINATION OF ANOTHER’S PREGNANCY
ORC:2903.01.text: _____________ did purposely cause the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME) while (Committing or attempting to commit) (CHOOSE ONE: Kidnapping, rape, aggravated arson, arson, aggravated robbery, robbery, aggravated burglary, burglary, terrorism, escape) to wit: (DESCRIBE FACTS OF OFFENSE COMMITTED OR ATTEMPTED), in violation of Section 2903.01(B) of the Ohio Revised Code – Aggravated Murder.

ORC:2903.01.heading: AGGRAVATED MURDER 2903.01(B) ORC
ORC:2903.01.variant: PURPOSELY AND WHILE FLEEING AFTER COMMITTING A SPECIFIED OFFENSE
ORC:2903.01.text: _____________ did purposely cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME) while fleeing immediately after (Committing or attempting to commit) (CHOOSE ONE: Kidnapping, rape, aggravated arson, arson, aggravated robbery, robbery, aggravated burglary, burglary, terrorism, escape) to wit: (DESCRIBE FACTS OF OFFENSE COMMITTED OR ATTEMPTED), in violation of Section 2903.01(B) of the Ohio Revised Code – Aggravated Murder.

ORC:2903.01.heading: AGGRAVATED MURDER 2903.01(B) ORC
ORC:2903.01.variant: PURPOSELY AND WHILE FLEEING AFTER COMMITTING A SPECIFIED OFFENSE: UNLAWFUL TERMINATION OF ANOTHER’S PREGNANCY
ORC:2903.01.text: _____________ did purposely cause the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME) while fleeing immediately after (Committing or attempting to commit) (CHOOSE ONE: Kidnapping, rape, aggravated arson, arson, aggravated robbery, robbery, aggravated burglary, burglary, terrorism, escape) to wit: (DESCRIBE FACTS OF OFFENSE COMMITTED OR ATTEMPTED), in violation of Section 2903.01(B) of the Ohio Revised Code – Aggravated Murder.

ORC:2903.01.heading: AGGRAVATED MURDER 2903.01(C) ORC
ORC:2903.01.variant: PURPOSELY CAUSE DEATH OF ANOTHER UNDER 13 YEARS OF AGE
ORC:2903.01.text: _____________ did purposely cause the death of another who is under thirteen years of age at the time of the commission of the offense, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND AGE) by means of (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2903.01(C) of the Ohio Revised Code – Aggravated Murder.

ORC:2903.01.heading: AGGRAVATED MURDER 2903.01(D) ORC
ORC:2903.01.variant: UNDER DETENTION- FOUND OR PLEAD GUILTY
ORC:2903.01.text: _____________ did purposely cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), by means of (DESCRIBE), while under detention as a result of having been found guilty of or having pleaded guilty to a felony, to wit: (STATE FELONY OFFENSE, SECTION NUMBER, CASE NUMBER, AND COURT), in violation of Section 2903.01(D) of the Ohio Revised Code

ORC:2903.01.heading: AGGRAVATED MURDER 2903.01(D) ORC
ORC:2903.01.text: _____________ did purposely cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), by means of (DESCRIBE), while under detention as a result of breaking that detention, in violation of Section 2903.01(D) of the Ohio Revised Code – Aggravated Murder.

ORC:2903.01.heading: AGGRAVATED MURDER 2903.01(E)(1) ORC
ORC:2903.01.variant: PURPOSELY CAUSE DEATH OF LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER WHILE ENGAGED IN DUTIES
ORC:2903.01.text: _____________ did purposely cause the death of a law enforcement officer, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME) by means of (DESCRIBE), and at the time of the commission of the offense the offender knows or has reasonable cause to know the victim is a law enforcement officer engaging in (his or her) duties, to wit: (DESCRIBE DUTIES), in violation of Section 2903.01(E)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code – Aggravated Murder.
ORC:2903.01.notes: NOTE: “Law enforcement officer” has the same meaning as defined in ORC 2901.01(A)(11) and also includes any federal law enforcement officer as defined in ORC 2921.51 and anyone who has previously served as a law enforcement officer or federal law enforcement officer.

ORC:2903.01.heading: AGGRAVATED MURDER 2903.01(E)(2) ORC
ORC:2903.01.variant: PURPOSELY CAUSE DEATH OF LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER: OFFENDER’S SPECIFIC PURPOSE
ORC:2903.01.text: _____________ did purposely cause the death of a law enforcement officer, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME) by means of (DESCRIBE), whom the offender knows or has reasonable cause to know is a law enforcement officer and it is the offender’s specific purpose to kill a law enforcement officer, in violation of Section 2903.01(E)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code – Aggravated Murder.
ORC:2903.01.notes: NOTE: “Law enforcement officer” has the same meaning as defined in ORC 2901.01(A)(11) and also includes any federal law enforcement officer as defined in ORC 2921.51 and anyone who has previously served as a law enforcement officer or federal law enforcement officer.

ORC:2903.01.heading: AGGRAVATED MURDER 2903.01(F) ORC
ORC:2903.01.variant: PURPOSELY CAUSE DEATH OF FIRST RESPONDER OR MILITARY MEMBER: OFFENDER’S SPECIFIC PURPOSE
ORC:2903.01.text: _____________ did purposely cause the death of a (first responder/military member), to wit: (STATE NAME OF VICTIM AND OCCUPATION/POSITION) by means of (DESCRIBE), whom the offender knows or has reasonable cause to know is a (first responder/military member) and it is the offender’s specific purpose to kill a (first responder/military member), in violation of Section 2903.01(F) of the Ohio Revised Code – Aggravated Murder.
ORC:2903.01.notes: NOTE: “First responder” means an emergency medical service provider, a firefighter, or any other emergency response personnel or anyone who has previously served as a first responder. NOTE: “Military member” means a member of the armed forces of the United States, reserves, or Ohio National Guard; a participant in the ROTC, JROTC, or any similar military training program; or anyone who has previously served in the military.

ORC:2903.02.heading: MURDER 2903.02(A) ORC
ORC:2903.02.text: _____________ did purposely cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME) by means of (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2903.02(A) of the Ohio Revised Code – Murder.

ORC:2903.02.heading: MURDER 2903.02(A) ORC
ORC:2903.02.text: _____________ did purposely cause the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME) by means of (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2903.02(A) of the Ohio Revised Code – Murder.

ORC:2903.02.heading: MURDER 2903.02(B) ORC
ORC:2903.02.variant: COMMITTING OR ATTEMPT TO COMMIT AN OFFENSE
ORC:2903.02.text: _____________ did cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME) by means of (DESCRIBE), as a proximate result of the offender’s committing or attempting to commit an offense of violence (DESCRIBE THE OFFENSE OF VIOLENCE AND STATE SECTION NUMBER) that is a felony of the first or second degree and this is not in violation of Sections 2903.03 or 2903.04 of the revised code, in violation of Section 2903.02(B) of the Ohio Revised Code – Murder.
ORC:2903.02.notes: NOTE: 2903.02(B) does not apply if the underlying offense of violence is a felony of the first or second degree only because of an enhancement due to a previous conviction per 2903.02(C).

ORC:2903.03.heading: VOLUNTARY MANSLAUGHTER 2903.03(A) ORC
ORC:2903.03.text: _____________ did knowingly cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), while (under the influence of a sudden passion or in a sudden fit of rage) brought on by serious provocation occasioned by (STATE NAME OF THE VICTIM), that was reasonably sufficient to incite (STATE NAME OF THE ACCUSED) into using deadly force, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE PROVOCATION AND THE DEADLY FORCE USED), in violation of Section 2903.03(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2903.03.heading: VOLUNTARY MANSLAUGHTER 2903.03(A) ORC
ORC:2903.03.variant: UNDER PASSION OR RAGE: UNLAWFUL TERMINATION OF ANOTHER’S PREGNANCY – F1
ORC:2903.03.text: _____________ did knowingly cause the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), while (under the influence of a sudden passion or in a sudden fit of rage) brought on by serious provocation occasioned by (STATE NAME OF THE VICTIM), that was reasonably sufficient to incite (STATE NAME OF THE ACCUSED) into using deadly force, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE PROVOCATION AND THE DEADLY FORCE USED), in violation of Section 2903.03(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2903.03.heading: VOLUNTARY MANSLAUGHTER 2903.03(B) ORC
ORC:2903.03.variant: UNDER PASSION OR RAGE: WITH A SEXUAL MOTIVATION – F1
ORC:2903.03.text: _____________ did, with a sexual motivation, knowingly cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), while (under the influence of a sudden passion or in a sudden fit of rage) brought on by serious provocation occasioned by (STATE NAME OF THE VICTIM), that was reasonably sufficient to incite (STATE NAME OF THE ACCUSED) into using deadly force, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE PROVOCATION AND THE DEADLY FORCE USED), in violation of Section 2903.03(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.
ORC:2903.03.notes: NOTE: “Sexual motivation” means a purpose to gratify the sexual needs or desires of the offender.

ORC:2903.03.heading: VOLUNTARY MANSLAUGHTER 2903.03(B) ORC
ORC:2903.03.variant: UNDER PASSION OR RAGE WITH A SEXUAL MOTIVATION: UNLAWFUL TERMINATION OF ANOTHER’S PREGNANCY – F1
ORC:2903.03.text: _____________ did, with a sexual motivation, knowingly cause the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), while (under the influence of a sudden passion or in a sudden fit of rage) brought on by serious provocation occasioned by (STATE NAME OF THE VICTIM), that was reasonably sufficient to incite (STATE NAME OF THE ACCUSED) into using deadly force, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE PROVOCATION AND THE DEADLY FORCE USED), in violation of Section 2903.03(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.
ORC:2903.03.notes: NOTE: “Sexual motivation” means a purpose to gratify the sexual needs or desires of the offender.

ORC:2903.04.heading: INVOLUNTARY MANSLAUGHTER 2903.04(A) ORC
ORC:2903.04.variant: DEATH RESULTING FROM THE COMMISSION OF A FELONY – F1
ORC:2903.04.text: _____________ did knowingly cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), as a proximate result of (STATE NAME OF THE ACCUSED) (committing or attempting to commit) a felony, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE SPECIFIC FELONY AND ITS SECTION NUMBER), in violation of Section 2903.04(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2903.04.heading: INVOLUNTARY MANSLAUGHTER 2903.04(A) ORC
ORC:2903.04.variant: DEATH RESULTING FROM THE COMMISSION OF A FELONY: UNLAWFUL TERMINATION OF ANOTHER’S PREGNANCY – F1
ORC:2903.04.text: _____________ did knowingly cause the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), as a proximate result of (STATE NAME OF THE ACCUSED) (committing or attempting to commit) a felony, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE SPECIFIC FELONY AND ITS SECTION NUMBER), in violation of Section 2903.04(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2903.04.heading: INVOLUNTARY MANSLAUGHTER 2903.04(B) ORC
ORC:2903.04.variant: DEATH RESULTING FROM THE COMMISSION OF A MISDEMEANOR – F3
ORC:2903.04.text: _____________ did knowingly cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), as a proximate result of (STATE NAME OF THE ACCUSED) (committing or attempting to commit) a misdemeanor, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE SPECIFIC MISDEMEANOR AND ITS SECTION NUMBER, in violation of Section 2903.04(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2903.04.notes: NOTE: Other than a violation of Title 45 or a municipal ordinance that is substantially equivalent to Title 45.

ORC:2903.04.heading: INVOLUNTARY MANSLAUGHTER 2903.04(B) ORC
ORC:2903.04.variant: DEATH RESULTING FROM THE COMMISSION OF A MISDEMEANOR: UNLAWFUL TERMINATION OF ANOTHER’S PREGNANCY – F3
ORC:2903.04.text: _____________ did knowingly cause the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), as a proximate result of (STATE NAME OF THE ACCUSED) (committing or attempting to commit) a misdemeanor, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE SPECIFIC MISDEMEANOR AND ITS SECTION NUMBER , in violation of Section 2903.04(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2903.04.notes: NOTE: Other than a violation of Title 45 or a municipal ordinance that is substantially equivalent to Title 45.

ORC:2903.041.heading: RECKLESS HOMICIDE 2903.041 ORC
ORC:2903.041.text: _____________ did recklessly cause the death of another or the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy, to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM AND DESCRIBE HOW DEATH WAS CAUSED), in violation of Section 2903.041 of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2903.05.heading: NEGLIGENT HOMICIDE 2903.05 ORC (CCC 2303.05)
ORC:2903.05.variant: BY MEANS OF A DEADLY WEAPON OR DANGEROUS ORDNANCE – M1
ORC:2903.05.text: _____________ did negligently cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME) by means of a (deadly weapon or dangerous ordnance), , as defined in Section 2923.11 of the Ohio Revised Code, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE CONDUCT AND THE WEAPON OR ORDNANCE USED), in violation of Section 2903.05 of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2903.05.notes: NOTE: If charging the offender under the Columbus City Code, the definition section cited in the complaint language should be changed to “Section 2323.11 of the Columbus City Code.” NOTE: Storing or leaving a deadly weapon or dangerous ordnance in a manner or location in the person’s residence where the person knows or reasonably should know a minor is able to gain access to the deadly weapon or dangerous ordnance constitutes a substantial lapse from due care. NOTE: If the offender had a firearm or dangerous ordnance on or about the offender’s person or under the offender’s control at the time of the commission of the offense in violation of the Columbus City Code, the firearm or dangerous ordnance shall be seized and is subject to forfeiture under Chapter 2981 of the Ohio Revised Code. Refer to the complaint language cited in Chapter 2927 of the Criminal Complaint Manual.

ORC:2903.05.heading: NEGLIGENT HOMICIDE 2903.05 ORC
ORC:2903.05.variant: BY MEANS OF A DEADLY WEAPON OR DANGEROUS ORDNANCE: UNLAWFUL TERMINATION OF ANOTHER’S PREGNANCY – M1
ORC:2903.05.text: _____________ did negligently cause the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME) by means of a (deadly weapon or dangerous ordnance), to wit: (DESCRIBE THE CONDUCT AND THE WEAPON OR ORDNANCE USED), in violation of Section 2903.05 of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2903.06.heading: AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HOMICIDE 2903.06(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2903.06.variant: CAUSE THE DEATH OF ANOTHER – F2
ORC:2903.06.text: _____________ did, while (operating or participating in the operation of) a (motor vehicle, motorcycle, utility vehicle, mini-truck, snowmobile, locomotive, watercraft, or aircraft), to wit: (DESCRIBE THE VEHICLE USED), cause the death of another as a proximate result of committing an OVI offense, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE OPERATION), in violation of Section 2903.06(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.

ORC:2903.06.heading: AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HOMICIDE 2903.06(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2903.06.text: _____________ did, while (operating or participating in the operation of) a (motor vehicle, motorcycle, utility vehicle, mini-truck, snowmobile, locomotive, watercraft, or aircraft), to wit: (DESCRIBE THE VEHICLE USED), cause the death of another as a proximate result of committing an OVI offense, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE OPERATION) (having previous convictions or driving under suspension or cancellation) pursuant to Ohio Revised Code 2903.06(B), to wit: (INCLUDE SUSPENSION DATES, NUMBERS, COURT NAMES, AND/OR CASE NUMBERS), in violation of Section 2903.06(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.
ORC:2903.06.notes: NOTE: Pursuant to Ohio Revised Code 2903.06(B): Aggravated Vehicular Homicide in violation of 2903.06(A)(1), if at the time of the offense the offender was driving under a suspension or cancellation imposed under Chapter 4510 or any other provision of the Ohio Revised Code, or was operating a motor vehicle or motorcycle, did not have a valid driver’s license, commercial driver’s license, temporary instruction permit, probationary license, or nonresident operating privilege, and was not eligible for renewal of the offender’s driver’s license or commercial driver’s license without examination under Section 4507.10 of the Revised Code, is a felony of the first degree. NOTE: Aggravated Vehicular Homicide in violation of 2903.06(A)(2), if the offender has previously been convicted of or pleaded guilty to a violation of this section, been convicted of or pleaded guilty to any traffic-related homicide, manslaughter, or assault offense, is a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2903.06.heading: AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HOMICIDE 2903.06(A)(2)(a) ORC
ORC:2903.06.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE THE DEATH OF ANOTHER – F3
ORC:2903.06.text: _____________ did, while (operating or participating in the operation of) a (motor vehicle, motorcycle, utility vehicle, mini-truck, snowmobile, locomotive, watercraft, or aircraft), to wit: (DESCRIBE THE VEHICLE USED), recklessly cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE THE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE OPERATION), in violation of Section 2903.06(A)(2)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2903.06.heading: AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HOMICIDE 2903.06(A)(2)(a) ORC
ORC:2903.06.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE THE TERMINATION OF ANOTHER’S PREGNANCY – F3
ORC:2903.06.text: _____________ did, while (operating or participating in the operation of) a (motor vehicle, motorcycle, utility vehicle, mini-truck, snowmobile, locomotive, watercraft, or aircraft), to wit: (DESCRIBE THE VEHICLE USED), recklessly cause the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy, to wit: (STATE THE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE OPERATION), in violation of Section 2903.06(A)(2)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2903.06.heading: AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HOMICIDE 2903.06(A)(2)(a) ORC
ORC:2903.06.text: _____________ did, while (operating or participating in the operation of) a (motor vehicle, motorcycle, utility vehicle, mini-truck, snowmobile, locomotive, watercraft, or aircraft), to wit: (DESCRIBE THE VEHICLE USED), recklessly cause the (death of another or the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy), to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE OPERATION) (having previous convictions or driving under suspension or cancellation) pursuant to Ohio Revised Code 2903.06(B), to wit: (INCLUDE SUSPENSION DATES, NUMBERS, COURT, NAMES AND/OR CASE NUMBERS OF PREVIOUS CONVICTIONS) in violation of Section 2903.06(A)(2)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.
ORC:2903.06.notes: NOTE: Pursuant to Ohio Revised Code 2903.06(B): Aggravated Vehicular Homicide in violation of 2903.06(A)(2), if at the time of the offense the offender was driving under a suspension or cancellation imposed under Chapter 4510 or any other provision of the Ohio Revised Code, or was operating a motor vehicle or motorcycle, did not have a valid driver’s license, commercial driver’s license, temporary instruction permit, probationary license, or nonresident operating privilege, and was not eligible for renewal of the offender’s driver’s license or commercial driver’s license without examination under Section 4507.10 of the Revised Code, is a felony of the second degree. NOTE: Aggravated Vehicular Homicide in violation of 2903.06(A)(2), if the offender has previously been convicted of or pleaded guilty to a violation of this section, been convicted of or pleaded guilty to any traffic-related homicide, manslaughter, or assault offense, is a felony of the second degree.

ORC:2903.06.heading: AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HOMICIDE 2903.06(A)(2)(b) ORC
ORC:2903.06.variant: RECKLESS OPERATION IN A CONSTRUCTION ZONE RESULTING IN DEATH – F3
ORC:2903.06.text: _____________ did, while (operating or participating in the operation of) a (motor vehicle, utility vehicle, mini-truck, or motorcycle) in a construction zone, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE VEHICLE USED), recklessly cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE OPERATION), as the proximate result of committing a reckless operation offense, to wit: (DESCRIBE RECKLESS OPERATION OFFENSE), provided that this division applies only if the person whose death is caused is in the construction zone at the time of the offender’s commission of the reckless operation offense in the construction zone, in violation of Section 2903.06(A)(2)(b) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2903.06.notes: NOTE: This section does not apply unless signs of the type described in Ohio Revised Code 2903.081 are erected in that construction zone in accordance with the guidelines established under Ohio Revised Code 5501.27.

ORC:2903.06.heading: AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HOMICIDE 2903.06(A)(2)(b) ORC
ORC:2903.06.variant: RECKLESS OPERATION IN A CONSTRUCTION ZONE RESULTING IN THE UNLAWFUL TERMINATION OF ANOTHER’S PREGNANCY – F3
ORC:2903.06.text: _____________ did, while (operating or participating in the operation of) a (motor vehicle, utility vehicle, mini-truck, or motorcycle) in a construction zone, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE VEHICLE USED), recklessly cause the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE OPERATION), as the proximate result of committing a reckless operation offense, to wit: (DESCRIBE RECKLESS OPERATION OFFENSE), provided that this division applies only if the person whose pregnancy is unlawfully terminated is in the construction zone at the time of the offender’s commission of the reckless operation offense in the construction zone, in violation of Section 2903.06(A)(2)(b) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2903.06.notes: NOTE: This section does not apply unless signs of the type described in Ohio Revised Code 2903.081 are erected in that construction zone in accordance with the guidelines established under Ohio Revised Code 5501.27.

ORC:2903.06.heading: AGGRAVATED VEHICULAR HOMICIDE 2903.06(A)(2)(b) ORC
ORC:2903.06.text: _____________ did, while (operating or participating in the operation of) a (motor vehicle, utility vehicle, mini-truck, or motorcycle) in a construction zone, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE VEHICLE USED), recklessly cause the (death of another or the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy), to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE OPERATION), (having previous convictions or driving under suspension or cancellation) pursuant to Ohio Revised Code 2903.06(B), to wit: (INCLUDE SUSPENSION DATES, NUMBERS, COURT NAMES, AND/OR CASE NUMBERS OF PREVIOUS CONVICTIONS), provided that this division applies only if the person whose pregnancy is unlawfully terminated in the construction zone at the time of the offender’s commission of the reckless operation offense in the construction zone, in violation of Section 2903.06(A)(2)(b) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.
ORC:2903.06.notes: NOTE: This section does not apply unless signs of the type described in Ohio Revised Code 2903.081 are erected in that construction zone in accordance with the guidelines established under Ohio Revised Code 5501.27. NOTE: Pursuant to Ohio Revised Code 2903.06(B): Aggravated Vehicular Homicide in violation of 2903.06(A)(2), if at the time of the offense the offender was driving under a suspension or cancellation imposed under Chapter 4510 or any other provision of the Ohio Revised Code, or was operating a motor vehicle or motorcycle, did not have a valid driver’s license, commercial driver’s license, temporary instruction permit, probationary license, or nonresident operating privilege, and was not eligible for renewal of the offender’s driver’s license or commercial driver’s license without examination under Section 4507.10 of the Revised Code, is a felony of the second degree. NOTE: Aggravated Vehicular Homicide in violation of 2903.06(A)(2), if the offender has previously been convicted of or pleaded guilty to a violation of this section, been convicted of or pleaded guilty to any traffic-related homicide, manslaughter, or assault offense, is a felony of the second degree.

ORC:2903.06.heading: VEHICULAR HOMICIDE 2903.06(A)(3)(a) ORC
ORC:2903.06.variant: NEGLIGENTLY CAUSE THE DEATH OF ANOTHER – M1
ORC:2903.06.text: _____________ did, while (operating or participating in the operation of) a (motor vehicle, motorcycle, utility vehicle, mini-truck, snowmobile, locomotive, watercraft, or aircraft), to wit: (DESCRIBE THE VEHICLE USED), negligently cause the death of another, to wit: (STATE THE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE OPERATION), in violation of Section 2903.06(A)(3)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2903.06.heading: VEHICULAR HOMICIDE 2903.06(A)(3)(a) ORC
ORC:2903.06.variant: NEGLIGENTLY CAUSE THE UNLAWFUL TERMINATION OF ANOTHER’S PREGNANCY – M1
ORC:2903.06.text: _____________ did, while (operating or participating in the operation of) a (motor vehicle, motorcycle, utility vehicle, mini-truck, snowmobile, locomotive, watercraft, or aircraft), to wit: (DESCRIBE THE VEHICLE USED), negligently cause the unlawful termination of another’s pregnancy, to wit: (STATE THE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE OPERATION), in violation of Section 2903.06(A)(3)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2903.06.heading: VEHICULAR HOMICIDE 2903.06(A)(3)(a) ORC

DEFINITIONS 2903.10 FUNCTIONALLY IMPAIRED PERSON – any person who has a physical or mental impairment that prevents (him or her) from providing for (his or her) own care or protection or whose infirmities caused by aging prevent (him or her) from providing for (his or her) own care or protection. CARETAKER – a person who assumes the duty to provide for the care and protection of a functionally impaired person on a voluntary basis, by contract, through receipt of payment for care and protection, as a result of a family relationship, or by order of a court of competent jurisdiction. Caretaker does not include a person who owns, operates, or administers, or who is an agent or employee of, a care facility, as defined in Section 2903.33 of the Ohio Revised Code.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM – VICTIM PERSONNEL OF LOCAL CORRECTIONAL FACILITY – IN OR ON GROUNDS – F5
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did recklessly cause serious physical harm to (another or another’s unborn), to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM) (an employee of the local correctional facility or a probation department or is on the premises of the facility for business purposes or as a visitor) and the offense occurred in or on the grounds of a local correctional facility and the offense is committed by a (person who is under custody in the facility subsequent to the person’s arrest for any crime or delinquent act, subsequent to the person’s being charged with or convicted of any crime, or subsequent to the person’s being alleged to be or adjudicated a delinquent child) by means of (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM –VICTIM PERSONNEL OF STATE CORRECTIONAL INSTITUTION/INSTITUTION OF DEPT. OF YOUTH SERVICES/PROBATION – OFF GROUNDS – F5
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did recklessly cause serious physical harm to (another or another’s unborn), to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM), an employee of the (department of rehabilitation and correction, the department of youth services, or a probation department) and the offense occurred off the grounds of employment during the employee’s official work hours and while the employee is engaged in official work responsibilities, and the offense is committed by (an incarcerated person, institutionalized person who is temporarily outside the institution for any purpose, by a parolee, by an offender under transitional control, a person under community control sanction or on an escorted visit, by a person under post-release control, or by an offender under any other type of supervision), by means of (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM – VICTIM PERSONNEL OF LOCAL CORRECTIONAL FACILITY – OFF GROUNDS – F5
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did recklessly cause serious physical harm to (another or another’s unborn), to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM), an employee of the (local correctional facility or probation department) and the offense occurred off the grounds of employment during the employee’s official work hours and while the employee is engaged in official work responsibilities, and the offense is committed by a (person who is under custody in the facility subsequent to the person’s arrest for any crime or delinquent act, subsequent to the person’s being charged with or convicted of any crime, or subsequent to the person’s being alleged to be or adjudicated a delinquent child) who is temporarily outside of the institution for any purpose or by a probationer or parolee, an offender under transitional control, a person under community control sanction or on an escorted visit, a person under post-release control, or by an offender under any type of supervision, by means of (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO SCHOOL PERSONNEL – ON SCHOOL PREMISES – F5
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did recklessly cause serious physical harm to (another or another’s unborn), to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), a (school teacher or administrator or a school bus operator) and the offense occurred (on school premises or in a school building or a school bus) by means of (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO SCHOOL PERSONNEL – OUTSIDE SCHOOL PREMISES – F5
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did recklessly cause serious physical harm to (another or another’s unborn) , to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM), a (school teacher or administrator or a school bus operator) and the offense occurred while the victim was (outside of school premises or a school bus) and was engaged in (duties or official responsibilities) associated with the victim’s (employment or position as a school teacher or administrator or a school bus operator) while (driving, accompanying or chaperoning) students (at or on) (class or field trips or athletic events or other school extracurricular activities or functions) outside of school premises, by means of (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO PEACE OFFICER – FIREFIGHTER – EMS PERSONNEL – BCI INVESTIGATOR – F4
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did, recklessly cause serious physical harm to another, to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM), a (peace officer, investigator of the bureau of criminal identification and investigation, or a person performing emergency medical service) while in the performance of (his or her) official duties by means of (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO EMERGENCY SERVICE RESPONDER – F4
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did recklessly cause serious physical harm to another who is an emergency service responder, to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM AND STATE PROFESSION), whom the offender (knows or reasonably should know) is an emergency service responder, and it was the offender’s specific purpose to commit the offense against such a person, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM), in violation of Section 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2903.13.notes: NOTE: “Emergency service responder” means any law enforcement officer, first responder, emergency medical technician-basic, emergency medical technician-intermediate, emergency medical technician-paramedic, firefighter, or volunteer firefighter.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO FAMILY, HOUSEHOLD MEMBER, OR CO-WORKER OF EMERGENCY SERVICE RESPONDER – F4
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did recklessly cause serious physical harm to another who is a (family, household member, or co-worker) of an emergency service responder, to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM AND STATE RELATIONSHIP AND PROFESSION OF EMERGENCY SERVICE RESPONDER), whom the offender (knows or reasonably should know) is a (family, household member, or co-worker) of an emergency service responder, and it was the offender’s specific purpose to commit the offense against such a person, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM), in violation of Section 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2903.13.notes: NOTE: “Emergency service responder” means any law enforcement officer, first responder, emergency medical technician-basic, emergency medical technician-intermediate, emergency medical technician-paramedic, firefighter, or volunteer firefighter.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO OFFICER OR EMPLOYEE OF CHILDREN SERVICES AGENCY – F5
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did recklessly cause serious physical harm to another, to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM), being an officer or employee of a (public children services agency or a private child placing agency), to wit: (NAME AGENCY) and the offense relates to the officer’s or employee’s performance or anticipated performance of official responsibilities or duties, to wit: (DESCRIBE PERFORMANCE OR RESPONSIBILITIES), in violation of Section 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO OFFICER OR EMPLOYEE OF CHILDREN SERVICES AGENCY – PREVIOUS CONVICTION – F4
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did recklessly cause serious physical harm to another, to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM), being an officer or employee of a (public children services agency or a private child placing agency), to wit: (NAME AGENCY) and the offense relates to the officer’s or employee’s performance or anticipated performance of official responsibilities or duties, to wit: (DESCRIBE PERFORMANCE OR RESPONSIBILITIES), and, the said (NAME OF OFFENDER), having previously been convicted of or pleaded guilty to an offense of violence, to wit: (NAME OF OFFENSE, SECTION NUMBER, COURT, AND DATE OF CONVICTION), in violation of Section 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO HOSPITAL PERSONNEL– M1
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did recklessly cause serious physical harm to another, to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM), being a (health care professional, health care worker, or security officer) of a hospital whom the offender knew or had reasonable cause to know is such a health provider, while engaged in the performance of the victim’s duties,and the hospital offers de-escalation or crisis intervention training for such health providers, by means of (DESCRIBE), in violation of 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO HOSPITAL PERSONNEL – PREVIOUS CONVICTION – F5
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did recklessly cause serious physical harm to another, to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM), being a (health care professional, health care worker, or security officer) of a hospital whom the offender knew or had reasonable cause to know is such a health provider, while engaged in the performance of the victim’s duties,and the hospital offers de-escalation or crisis intervention training for such health providers, by means of (DESCRIBE), and having previously been convicted of or pleaded guilty to violating this Section, to wit: (NAME COURT AND CASE NUMBER), in violation of 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO JUDICIAL SYSTEM PERSONNEL – M1
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did recklessly cause serious physical harm to another, to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM), being a (judge, magistrate, prosecutor, or court official or employee) whom the offender knew or had reasonable cause to know is such a judicial system personnel, while engaged in the performance of the victim’s duties, in violation of 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2903.13.heading: ASSAULT 2903.13(B) ORC
ORC:2903.13.variant: RECKLESSLY CAUSE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO JUDICIAL SYSTEM PERSONNEL – PREVIOUS CONVICTION – F5
ORC:2903.13.text: _____________ did recklessly cause serious physical harm to another, to wit: (NAME OF VICTIM), being a (judge, magistrate, prosecutor, or court official or employee) whom the offender knew or had reasonable cause to know is such a judicial system personnel, while engaged in the performance of the victim’s duties, and having been previously been convicted of or pleaded guilty to one or more assault or homicide offenses committed against justice system personnel, to wit: (NAME COURT AND CASE NUMBER AND DATE OF CONVICTION), in violation of 2903.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2903.14.heading: NEGLIGENT ASSAULT 2903.14 ORC (CCC 2303.14)
ORC:2903.14.variant: NEGLIGENTLY CAUSE PHYSICAL HARM BY DEADLY WEAPON – M3
ORC:2903.14.text: _____________ did negligently cause physical harm to another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), by means of a (deadly weapon or dangerous ordnance), as defined in Section 2923.11 of the Ohio Revised Code , to wit: (DESCRIBE WEAPON OR ORDNANCE AND DESCRIBE THE PHYSICAL HARM CAUSED), in violation of Section 2903.14 of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.
ORC:2903.14.notes: NOTE: If charging the offender under the Columbus City Code, the definition section cited in the complaint language should be changed to “Section 2323 of the Columbus City Code. NOTE: Storing or leaving a deadly weapon or dangerous ordnance in a manner or location in the person’s residence where the person knows or reasonably should know a minor is able to gain access to the deadly weapon or dangerous ordnance constitutes a substantial lapse from due care. NOTE: If the offender had a firearm or dangerous ordnance on or about the offender’s person or under the offender’s control at the time of the commission of the offense in violation of the Columbus City Code, the firearm or dangerous ordnance shall be seized and is subject to forfeiture under Chapter 2981 of the Ohio Revised Code. Refer to the complaint language cited in Chapter 2927 of the Criminal Complaint Manual.

ORC:2903.14.heading: NEGLIGENT ASSAULT 2903.14 ORC
ORC:2903.14.variant: NEGLIGENTLY CAUSE PHYSICAL HARM TO AN UNBORN BY DEADLY WEAPON – M3
ORC:2903.14.text: _____________ did negligently cause physical harm to another’s unborn, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), by means of a (deadly weapon or dangerous ordnance), as defined in Section 2923.11 of the Ohio Revised Code, to wit: (DESCRIBE WEAPON OR ORDNANCE AND DESCRIBE THE PHYSICAL HARM CAUSED), in violation of Section 2903.14 of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.

ORC:2903.15.heading: PERMITTING CHILD ABUSE 2903.15(A) ORC
ORC:2903.15.variant: SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM – CHILD UNDER 18 – F3
ORC:2903.15.text: _____________ being the (parent, guardian, custodian, or person having custody) of a child under eighteen years of age, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), caused serious physical harm to the child, as a proximate result of permitting the child to be abused, to be tortured, to be administered corporal punishment or other physical disciplinary measure, or to be physically restrained in a cruel manner or for a prolonged period (DESCRIBE ACT) in violation of Section 2903.15(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2903.15.heading: PERMITTING CHILD ABUSE 2903.15(A) ORC
ORC:2903.15.variant: SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM – MENTALLY/PHYSICALLY HANDICAPPED CHILD UNDER 21 – F3
ORC:2903.15.text: _____________ being the (parent, guardian, custodian, or person having custody) of a mentally or physically handicapped child under twenty-one years of age, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), caused serious physical harm to the child, as a proximate result of permitting the child to be abused, to be tortured, to be administered corporal punishment or other physical disciplinary measure, or to be physically restrained in a cruel manner or for a prolonged period (DESCRIBE ACT) in violation of Section 2903.15(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2903.15.heading: PERMITTING CHILD ABUSE 2903.15(A) ORC
ORC:2903.15.text: _____________ being the (parent, guardian, custodian, or person having custody) of a child under eighteen years of age, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), caused the death of the child, as a proximate result of permitting the child to be abused, to be tortured, to be administered corporal punishment or other physical disciplinary measure, or to be physically restrained in a cruel manner or for a prolonged period (DESCRIBE ACT) in violation of Section 2903.15(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2903.15.heading: PERMITTING CHILD ABUSE 2903.15(A) ORC
ORC:2903.15.variant: CAUSING DEATH – MENTALLY/PHYSICALLY HANDICAPPED CHILD UNDER 21 – F1
ORC:2903.15.text: _____________ being the (parent, guardian, custodian, or person having custody) of a mentally or physically handicapped child under twenty-one years of age, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), caused the death of the child, as a proximate result of permitting the child to be abused, to be tortured, to be administered corporal punishment or other physical disciplinary measure, or to be physically restrained in a cruel manner or for a prolonged period (DESCRIBE ACT) in violation of Section 2903.15(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2903.16.heading: KNOWINGLY FAILING TO PROVIDE FOR A FUNCTIONALLY IMPAIRED PERSON 2903.16(A) ORC
ORC:2903.16.text: _____________ did, while being the caretaker of a functionally impaired person, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), knowingly fail to provide the victim with any treatment, care, goods, or service that is necessary to maintain the health or safety of the victim, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE ACT AND FAILURE), resulting in physical harm to said other, to wit: (DESCRIBE PHYSICAL HARM), in violation of Section 2903.16(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2903.16.heading: KNOWINGLY FAILING TO PROVIDE FOR A FUNCTIONALLY IMPAIRED PERSON 2903.16(A) ORC
ORC:2903.16.text: _____________ did, while being the caretaker of a functionally impaired person, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), knowingly fail to provide the victim with any treatment, care, goods, or service that is necessary to maintain the health or safety of the victim, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE ACT AND FAILURE), resulting in serious physical harm to said other, to wit: (DESCRIBE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM), in violation of Section 2903.16(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2903.16.heading: RECKLESSLY FAILING TO PROVIDE FOR A FUNCTIONALLY IMPAIRED PERSON 2903.16(B) ORC
ORC:2903.16.text: _____________ did, while being the caretaker of a functionally impaired person, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), recklessly fail to provide the victim with any treatment, care, goods, or service that is necessary to maintain the health or safety of the victim, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE ACT AND FAILURE), resulting in physical harm to said other, to wit: (DESCRIBE PHYSICAL HARM), in violation of Section 2903.16(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.

ORC:2903.16.heading: RECKLESSLY FAILING TO PROVIDE FOR A FUNCTIONALLY IMPAIRED PERSON 2903.16(B) ORC
ORC:2903.16.text: _____________ did, while being the caretaker of a functionally impaired person, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), recklessly fail to provide the victim with any treatment, care, goods, or service that is necessary to maintain the health or safety of the victim, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE ACT AND FAILURE), resulting in serious physical harm to said other, to wit: (DESCRIBE SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM), in violation of Section 2903.16(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2903.16.notes: DEFINITIONS 2903.18 ORC As used in this section: STRANGULATION OR SUFFOCATION – any act that impedes the normal breathing or circulation of the blood by applying pressure to the throat or neck, or by covering the nose and mouth. DATING RELATIONSHIP – has the same meaning as in Section 3113.31 of the Ohio Revised Code. FAMILY OR HOUSEHOLD MEMBER – has the same meaning as in Section 2919.25 of the Ohio Revised Code. “Family or household member” does not include the unborn child of a pregnant victim. PERSON WITH WHOM THE OFFENDER IS OR WAS IN A DATING RELATIONSHIP – a person who, at the time of the conduct in question, is in a dating relationship with the defendant or who, within the twelve months preceding the conduct in question, has had a dating relationship with the defendant. PHYSICAL HARM TO PERSONS – has the same meaning as in Section 2901.01 of the Ohio Revised Code. SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO PERSONS – has the same meaning as in Section 2901.01 of the Ohio Revised Code. SUBSTANTIAL RISK – has the same meaning as in Section 2901.01 of the Ohio Revised Code.

ORC:2903.18.heading: STRANGULATION 2903.18(B)(1) ORC
ORC:2903.18.text: _____________ did knowingly cause serious physical harm to another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), by means of strangulation or suffocation, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM), in violation of Section 2903.18(B)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.
ORC:2903.18.notes: NOTE: See definitions at the beginning of Section 2903.18. NOTE: It is an affirmative defense to a charge under division (B) of this section that the act was done as part of a medical or other procedure undertaken to aid or benefit the victim.

ORC:2903.18.heading: STRANGULATION 2903.18(B)(2) ORC
ORC:2903.18.variant: SUBSTANTIAL RISK OF SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM – F3
ORC:2903.18.text: _____________ did knowingly create a substantial risk of serious physical harm to another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), by means of strangulation or suffocation, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND SUBSTANTIAL RISK OF SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM), in violation of Section 2903.18(B) (2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2903.18.notes: NOTE: See definitions at the beginning of Section 2903.18. NOTE: It is an affirmative defense to a charge under division (B) of this section that the act was done as part of a medical or other procedure undertaken to aid or benefit the victim.

ORC:2903.18.heading: STRANGULATION 2903.18(B)(3) ORC
ORC:2903.18.variant: SUBSTANTIAL RISK OF PHYSICAL HARM – F5
ORC:2903.18.text: _____________ did knowingly cause or create a substantial risk of physical harm to another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), by means of strangulation or suffocation, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND HARM), in violation of Section 2903.18(B)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.
ORC:2903.18.notes: NOTE: See definitions at the beginning of Section 2903.18. NOTE: It is an affirmative defense to a charge under division (B) of this section that the act was done as part of a medical or other procedure undertaken to aid or benefit the victim.

ORC:2903.18.heading: STRANGULATION 2903.18(B)(3) ORC
ORC:2903.18.variant: PHYSICAL HARM – FAMILY OR HOUSEHOLD MEMBER VICTIM – F4
ORC:2903.18.text: _____________ did knowingly cause or create a substantial risk of physical harm to another who is a family or household member, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE RELATIONSHIP), by means of strangulation or suffocation, to wit (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND HARM), in violation of Section 2903.18(B)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2903.18.notes: NOTE: See definitions at the beginning of Section 2903.18. NOTE: It is an affirmative defense to a charge under division (B) of this section that the act was done as part of a medical or other procedure undertaken to aid or benefit the victim.

ORC:2903.18.heading: STRANGULATION 2903.18(B)(3) ORC
ORC:2903.18.variant: PHYSICAL HARM – DATING RELATIONSHIP VICTIM – F4
ORC:2903.18.text: _____________ did knowingly cause or create a substantial risk of physical harm to another who is or was in a dating relationship with the offender, to wit (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE RELATIONSHIP), by means of strangulation or suffocation, to wit (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND HARM), in violation of Section 2903.18(B)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2903.18.notes: NOTE: See definitions at the beginning of Section 2903.18. NOTE: It is an affirmative defense to a charge under division (B) of this section that the act was done as part of a medical or other procedure undertaken to aid or benefit the victim.

ORC:2903.18.heading: STRANGULATION 2903.18(B)(3) ORC
ORC:2903.18.variant: PHYSICAL HARM – PREGNANT VICTIM – CURRENT/FORMER DATING RELATIONSHIP– F3
ORC:2903.18.text: _____________ did knowingly cause or create a substantial risk of physical harm to another who (is or was) in a dating relationship with the offender, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE RELATIONSHIP), knowing that the victim was pregnant at the time of the offense, by means of strangulation or suffocation, to wit (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES, HARM, AND FACTS RELATING TO PREGNANCY), in violation of Section 2903.18(B)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2903.18.notes: NOTE: See definitions at the beginning of Section 2903.18. NOTE: It is an affirmative defense to a charge under division (B) of this section that the act was done as part of a medical or other procedure undertaken to aid or benefit the victim.

ORC:2903.18.heading: STRANGULATION 2903.18(B)(3) ORC
ORC:2903.18.variant: PHYSICAL HARM – PREGNANT VICTIM – FAMILY OR HOUSEHOLD MEMBER – F3
ORC:2903.18.text: _____________ did knowingly cause or create a substantial risk of physical harm to another who is a family or household member, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE RELATIONSHIP), knowing that the victim was pregnant at the time of the offense, by means of strangulation or suffocation, to wit (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES, HARM, AND FACTS RELATING TO PREGNANCY), in violation of Section 2903.18(B)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2903.18.notes: NOTE: See definitions at the beginning of Section 2903.18. NOTE: It is an affirmative defense to a charge under division (B) of this section that the act was done as part of a medical or other procedure undertaken to aid or benefit the victim.

ORC:2903.18.heading: STRANGULATION 2903.18(B)(3) ORC
ORC:2903.18.variant: PHYSICAL HARM – FAMILY OR HOUSEHOLD MEMBER VICTIM – PREVIOUS FELONY OFFENSE OF VIOLENCE CONVICTION – F3
ORC:2903.18.text: _____________ did knowingly cause or create a substantial risk of physical harm to another who is a family or household member, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE RELATIONSHIP), by means of strangulation or suffocation, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND HARM), and having been previously convicted of a felony offense of violence for (type of conviction) in (name of court) on (date of conviction), in violation of Section 2903.18(B)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2903.18.notes: NOTE: See definitions at the beginning of Section 2903.18. NOTE: See list of offenses of violence in ORC 2901.01(A)(9). The previous offense of violence conviction must be a felony for purposes of this section. NOTE: It is an affirmative defense to a charge under division (B) of this section that the act was done as part of a medical or other procedure undertaken to aid or benefit the victim.

ORC:2903.18.heading: STRANGULATION 2903.18(B)(3) ORC
ORC:2903.18.variant: PHYSICAL HARM – DATING RELATIONSHIP VICTIM – PREVIOUS FELONY OFFENSE OF VIOLENCE CONVICTION – F3
ORC:2903.18.text: _____________ did knowingly cause or create a substantial risk of physical harm to another who is or was in a dating relationship with the offender, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE RELATIONSHIP), by means of strangulation or suffocation, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND HARM), and having been previously convicted of a felony offense of violence for (type of conviction) in (name of court) on (date of conviction), in violation of Section 2903.18(B)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2903.18.notes: NOTE: See definitions at the beginning of Section 2903.18. NOTE: See list of offenses of violence in ORC 2901.01(A)(9). The previous offense of violence conviction must be a felony for purposes of this section. NOTE: It is an affirmative defense to a charge under division (B) of this section that the act was done as part of a medical or other procedure undertaken to aid or benefit the victim.

ORC:2903.21.heading: AGGRAVATED MENACING 2903.21 ORC (CCC 2303.21)
ORC:2903.21.variant: CAUSE ANOTHER TO BELIEVE THAT SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM WILL BE DONE – M1
ORC:2903.21.text: _____________ did knowingly cause another, to wit: (VICTIM’S NAME), to believe that (OFFENDER’S NAME) would cause serious physical harm to (said other, said others unborn, said others property or a member of said others immediate family), to wit: (DESCRIBE REASON FOR BELIEF), in violation of Section 2903.21 of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2903.21.notes: NOTE: In addition to any other basis for the other person’s belief that the offender will cause serious physical harm to the person or property of the other person, the other person’s unborn, or a member of the other person’s immediate family, the other person’s belief may be based on words or conduct of the offender that are directed at or identify a corporation, association, or other organization that employs the other person or to which the other person belongs. ORGANIZATION – includes an entity that is a governmental employer. NOTE: If the offender had a firearm or dangerous ordnance on or about the offender’s person or under the offender’s control at the time of the commission of the offense in violation of the Columbus City Code, the firearm or dangerous ordnance shall be seized and is subject to forfeiture under Chapter 2981 of the Ohio Revised Code. Refer to the complaint language cited in Chapter 2927 of the Criminal Complaint Manual.

ORC:2903.21.notes: NOTE: In addition to any other basis for the other person’s belief that the offender will cause serious physical harm to the person or property of the other person, the other person’s unborn, or a member of the other person’s immediate family, the other person’s belief may be based on words or conduct of the offender that are directed at or identify a corporation, association, or other organization that employs the other person or to which the other person belongs. ORGANIZATION – includes an entity that is a governmental employer. NOTE: If the offender had a firearm or dangerous ordnance on or about the offender’s person or under the offender’s control at the time of the commission of the offense in violation of the Columbus City Code, the firearm or dangerous ordnance shall be seized and is subject to forfeiture under Chapter 2981 of the Ohio Revised Code. ORC:2903.21.heading: AGGRAVATED MENACING 2903.21 ORC (CCC 2303.21)
ORC:2903.21.variant: CAUSE ANOTHER TO BELIEVE THAT SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM WILL BE DONE – OFFICER OR EMPLOYEE OF CHILDREN SERVICES AGENCY – PREVIOUS CONVICTION – F4
ORC:2903.21.text: _____________ did knowingly cause another, to wit: (VICTIM’S NAME), to believe that (OFFENDER’S NAME) would cause serious physical harm to (said other, said others unborn, said others property or a member of said others immediate family), to wit: (DESCRIBE REASON FOR BELIEF), and, the victim of the offense being an officer or employee of a (public children services agency or a private child placing agency) and the offense relates to the officer’s or employee’s performance or anticipated performance of official responsibilities or duties, to wit: (DESCRIBE PERFORMANCE OR RESPONSIBILITIES), and, the said (NAME OF OFFENDER), having previously been convicted of or pleaded guilty to an offense of violence, to wit: (NAME OFFENSE, COURT, SECTION NUMBER, DATE OF CONVICTION), in violation of Section 2903.21 of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2903.21.notes: NOTE: In addition to any other basis for the other person’s belief that the offender will cause serious physical harm to the person or property of the other person, the other person’s unborn, or a member of the other person’s immediate family, the other person’s belief may be based on words or conduct of the offender that are directed at or identify a corporation, association, or other organization that employs the other person or to which the other person belongs. ORGANIZATION – includes an entity that is a governmental employer. NOTE: If the offender had a firearm or dangerous ordnance on or about the offender’s person or under the offender’s control at the time of the commission of the offense in violation of the Columbus City Code, the firearm or dangerous ordnance shall be seized and is subject to forfeiture under Chapter 2981 of the Ohio Revised Code.
