ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did have sexual contact, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT) with another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), by purposely compelling said victim to submit by (force or threat of force), to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF FORCE), in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2907.05.variant: CAUSE ANOTHER TO HAVE SEXUAL CONTACT BY FORCE – F4
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did cause another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), to have sexual contact with the offender, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT) by purposely compelling said victim to submit by (force or threat of force), to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF FORCE), in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2907.05.variant: CAUSE OTHERS TO HAVE SEXUAL CONTACT BY FORCE – F4
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did cause (two or more than two) other persons, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAMES), to have sexual contact, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT) by purposely compelling said victim to submit by (force or threat of force), to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF FORCE), in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.05.variant: SEXUAL CONTACT BY ADMINISTERING DRUGS OR INTOXICANTS
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did have sexual contact, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT) with another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), and for the purpose of preventing resistance by said victim, did substantially impair said victim’s (judgment or control) by administering (surreptitiously or by force or by threat of force or by deception) a (drug or intoxicant or controlled substance*), to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND STATE NAME OF ITEM), in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree (*a felony of the third degree if it’s a controlled substance under Section 3719.41).

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.05.variant: CAUSE ANOTHER TO HAVE SEXUAL CONTACT BY ADMINISTERING DRUGS OR INTOXICANTS
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did cause another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), to have sexual contact with the offender, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT) and for the purpose of preventing resistance by said victim, did substantially impair one of the other person’s (judgment or control) by administering (surreptitiously or by force or by threat of force or by deception) a (drug or intoxicant or controlled substance*), to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND STATE NAME OF ITEM), in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree (*a felony of the third degree if it’s a controlled substance under Section 3719.41).

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.05.variant: CAUSE OTHERS TO HAVE SEXUAL CONTACT BY ADMINISTERING DRUGS OR INTOXICANTS
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did cause (two or more than two) other persons, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAMES), to have sexual contact, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT) and for the purpose of preventing resistance by said victims, did substantially impair one of the other person’s (judgment or control) by administering (surreptitiously or by force or by threat of force or by deception) a (drug or intoxicant or controlled substance*), to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND STATE NAME OF ITEM), in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree (*a felony of the third degree if it’s a controlled substance under Section 3719.41).

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2907.05.variant: SEXUAL CONTACT KNOWING VICTIM’S JUDGMENT IS SUBSTANTIALLY IMPAIRED AS RESULT OF ADMINISTERED DRUG FOR TREATMENT – F4
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did have sexual contact, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT) with another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), knowing said victim’s (judgment or control) was substantially impaired as a result of influence of (any drug or intoxicant) administered with victim’s consent for the purpose of (medical examination or dental examination or treatment or surgery) to wit: (GIVE CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2907.05.variant: SEXUAL CONTACT KNOWING VICTIM’S JUDGMENT IS SUBSTANTIALLY IMPAIRED AS RESULT OF ADMINISTERED DRUG FOR TREATMENT (TWO) OR MORE PERSONS INVOLVED) – F4
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did have sexual contact, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT) with (two or more than two) other persons, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), knowing said victim’s (judgment or control) was substantially impaired as a result of influence of (any drug or intoxicant) administered with the other person(s’) consent for the purpose of (medical examination or dental examination or treatment or surgery) to wit: (GIVE CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(A)(4) ORC
ORC:2907.05.variant: SEXUAL CONTACT WITH CHILD UNDER 13 YEARS OLD – F3
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did have sexual contact, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT) with another under the age of thirteen years, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND AGE), in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(A)(4) ORC
ORC:2907.05.variant: CAUSE ANOTHER UNDER 13 YEARS OLD TO HAVE SEXUAL CONTACT WITH OFFENDER – F3
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did cause another under the age of thirteen years, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), to have sexual contact with the offender, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT), in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(A)(4) ORC
ORC:2907.05.variant: CAUSE OTHERS, ONE OF WHICH IS UNDER 13 YEARS OLD, TO HAVE SEXUAL CONTACT – F3
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did cause (two or more than two) other persons, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAMES) of which (one or more than one) was under the age of thirteen years, to wit: (STATE NAME AND AGE), to have sexual contact, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT), in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(A)(5) ORC
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did have sexual contact, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT) with another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), whose ability to (resist or consent) is substantially impaired because of (mental condition or physical condition or advanced age), to wit: (DESCRIBE IMPAIRMENT) and the offender (knew or had reasonable cause to know) victim’s impairment, in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(A)(5) ORC
ORC:2907.05.variant: CAUSE AN IMPAIRED VICTIM TO HAVE SEXUAL CONTACT WITH OFFENDER – F4
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did cause another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), to have sexual contact with the offender, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT) whose ability to (resist or consent) is substantially impaired because of (mental condition or physical condition or advanced age), to wit: (DESCRIBE IMPAIRMENT) and the offender (knew or had reasonable cause to know) of victim’s impairment, in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(A)(5) ORC
ORC:2907.05.variant: CAUSE OTHERS TO HAVE SEXUAL CONTACT BY FORCE – F4
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did cause (two or more than two) other persons, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAMES), to have sexual contact, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT) and (one or more) of victim’s ability to (resist or consent) is substantially impaired because of (mental condition or physical condition or advanced age), to wit: (DESCRIBE IMPAIRMENT) and the offender (knew or had reasonable cause to know) of victim’s impairment, in violation of Section 2907.05(A)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2907.05.heading: GROSS SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.05(B) ORC
ORC:2907.05.variant: KNOWINGLY TOUCHED GENITALIA OF ANOTHER UNDER 12 YEARS OF AGE – F3
ORC:2907.05.text: _____________ did knowingly touch the genitalia of another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), when the touching is not through clothing and the other person is less than twelve years of age, whether or not the offender knows the age of that person, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S AGE), and the touching was done with an intent to abuse, humiliate, harass, degrade, or arouse or gratify the sexual desire of any person, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT), in violation of Section 2907.05(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.06.heading: SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.06(A) ORC
ORC:2907.06.variant: SEXUAL CONTACT WITH ANOTHER KNOWING IT TO BE OFFENSIVE – M3
ORC:2907.06.text: _____________ did have sexual contact, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT) with another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), (knowing that the sexual contact was offensive to the said victim or being reckless in regards to knowing that the sexual contact would be offensive to the said victim), in violation of Section 2907.06(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.
ORC:2907.06.notes: NOTE: If a previous conviction exists of this section or section 2907.02, 2907.03, 2907.04, 2907.05, or 2907.12, the charge is a misdemeanor of the first degree and you must allege the previous conviction in the body of the complaint by putting in the date of conviction, the case number, and the section of the previous conviction. NOTE: Victim’s testimony must be supported by other evidence for a conviction.

ORC:2907.06.heading: SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.06(A) ORC
ORC:2907.06.variant: CAUSE ANOTHER TO HAVE SEXUAL CONTACT KNOWING IT TO BE OFFENSIVE – M3
ORC:2907.06.text: _____________ did cause another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), to have sexual contact with (him or her), to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT), knowing that the sexual contact would be offensive to the said victim or being reckless in that regard, in violation of Section 2907.06(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.
ORC:2907.06.notes: NOTE: If a previous conviction exists of this section or section 2907.02, 2907.03, 2907.04, 2907.05, or 2907.12, the charge is a misdemeanor of the first degree and you must allege the previous conviction in the body of the complaint by putting in the date of conviction, the case number, and the section of the previous conviction. NOTE: Victim’s testimony must be supported by other evidence for a conviction.

ORC:2907.06.heading: SEXUAL IMPOSITION 2907.06(A) ORC
ORC:2907.06.variant: CAUSE OTHERS TO HAVE SEXUAL CONTACT, KNOWING IT TO BE OFFENSIVE – M3
ORC:2907.06.text: _____________ did cause (two or more than two) other persons, to wit: (STATE NAMES OF VICTIMS), to have sexual contact, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONTACT), knowing that the sexual contact was offensive to one of the persons or being reckless in regards to knowing that the sexual contact would be offensive to one of the persons), in violation of Section 2907.06(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.
ORC:2907.06.notes: NOTE: If a previous conviction exists of this section or section 2907.02, 2907.03, 2907.04, 2907.05, or 2907.12, the charge is a misdemeanor of the first degree and you must allege the previous conviction in the body of the complaint by putting in the date of conviction, the case number, and the section of the previous conviction. NOTE: Victim’s testimony must be supported by other evidence for a conviction.

ORC:2907.07.heading: IMPORTUNING 2907.07(A) ORC
ORC:2907.07.variant: SOLICITING CHILD UNDER 13 YEARS FOR SEXUAL ACTIVITY – F3
ORC:2907.07.text: _____________ did solicit another under the age of thirteen years, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND AGE), to engage in sexual activity with (him or her), to wit: (DESCRIBE SEXUAL ACTIVITY), whether or not the offender knows the age of such person, in violation of Section 2907.07(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2907.07.notes: NOTE: If a previous conviction exists, the charge is a felony of the second degree and you must allege the previous conviction in the body of the complaint by putting in the date of conviction, the case number, and the section of the previous conviction.

ORC:2907.07.heading: IMPORTUNING 2907.07(B)(1) ORC
ORC:2907.07.variant: SOLICITING CHILD UNDER 16 YEARS FOR SEXUAL CONDUCT – F5
ORC:2907.07.text: _____________ did, being (eighteen years old or older than eighteen years of age), to wit: (STATE AGE), solicit another who was (four years or more than four years) younger and thirteen years of age or older but not over sixteen years of age, to wit: (STATE NAME AND AGE OF VICTIM) to engage in sexual conduct with (him or her), to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONDUCT), whether or not the offender knows the age of such person, in violation of Section 2907.07(B)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.
ORC:2907.07.notes: NOTE: If a previous conviction exists, the charge is a felony of the fourth degree and you must allege the previous conviction in the body of the complaint by putting in the date of conviction, the case number, and the section of the previous conviction.

ORC:2907.07.heading: IMPORTUNING 2907.07(B)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.07.variant: SOLICITING VICTIM OF HUMAN TRAFFICKING AGE 16-17 – F5
ORC:2907.07.text: _____________ did, being (eighteen years old or older than eighteen years of age), to wit: (STATE AGE), solicit another who was (four years or more than four years) younger, age (sixteen or seventeen), to wit: (STATE NAME AND AGE OF VICTIM), as well as a victim of Section 2905.32 of the Ohio Revised Code, to wit: in (NAME OF COURT AND CASE NUMBER) to engage in sexual conduct with (him or her), to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF CONDUCT) and (knew or recklessly disregarded) the age of the other person, to wit: (DESCRIBE KNOWLEDGE OR RECKLESS DISREGARD), in violation of Section 2907.07(B)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.
ORC:2907.07.notes: NOTE: If a previous conviction exists, the charge is a felony of the fourth degree and you must allege the previous conviction in the body of the complaint by putting in the date of conviction, the case number, and the section of the previous conviction.

ORC:2907.07.heading: IMPORTUNING 2907.07(C) ORC
ORC:2907.07.variant: SOLICITING A PERSON WHO IS SUBSTANTIALLY IMPAIRED BY A MENTAL/PHYSICAL CONDITION – VICTIM IS LESS THAN SIXTEEN YEARS OF AGE – F3
ORC:2907.07.text: _____________ did solicit a person who is less than sixteen years of age, to wit: (INITIALS OF THE VICTIM), to engage in sexual activity, to wit: (DESCRIBE CONDUCT), when the person who is less than sixteen years of age is substantially impaired because of a mental or physical condition, to wit: (DESCRIBE CONDITION), in violation of Section 2907.07(C) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2907.07.notes: NOTE: If a previous conviction exists, the charge is a felony of the second degree and you must allege the previous conviction in the body of the complaint by listing the date of conviction and case number.

ORC:2907.07.heading: IMPORTUNING 2907.07(D) ORC
ORC:2907.07.variant: SOLICITING BY MEANS OF A TELECOMMUNICATIONS DEVICE, VICTIM IS LESS THAN THIRTEEN YEARS OF AGE– F3
ORC:2907.07.text: _____________ did, being (eighteen years or older), to wit: (STATE AGE), solicit another to engage in sexual activity by means of a telecommunications device as defined in Section 2913.01 of the Ohio Revised Code, to wit: (STATE TELECOMMUNICATIONS DEVICE AND CONDUCT), the other person is (less than thirteen years of age or a law enforcement officer posing as a person that is less than thirteen years of age), to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S INITIALS AND AGE OR NAME AND BADGE NUMBER OF OFFICER POSING AS PERSON LESS THAN 13 YEARS OF AGE), and offender (knows or thinks that other person is less than thirteen years of age or is reckless in that regard), in violation of Section 2907.07(D) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2907.07.notes: NOTE: If a previous conviction exists, the charge is a felony of the second degree and you must allege the previous conviction in the body of the complaint by listing the date of conviction and case number.

ORC:2907.07.heading: IMPORTUNING 2907.07(E) ORC
ORC:2907.07.variant: SOLICITING BY MEANS OF A TELECOMMUNICATIONS DEVICE, VICTIM IS OLDER THAN THIRTEEN BUT LESS THAN SIXTEEN YEARS OF AGE – F5
ORC:2907.07.text: _____________ did being (eighteen years or older), to wit: (STATE AGE), solicit another who was (four or more years younger than the offender) to engage in sexual activity by means of a telecommunications device as defined in Section 2913.01 of the Ohio Revised Code, to wit: (STATE TELECOMMUNICATIONS DEVICE AND CONDUCT), the other person is (thirteen years of age or older but less than sixteen years of age or a law enforcement officer posing as a person that is thirteen years of age or older but less than sixteen years of age), to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S INITIALS AND AGE OR NAME AND BADGE NUMBER OF OFFICER), and offender (knows or thinks) that the other person is thirteen years of age or older but less than sixteen years of age or is reckless in that regard, in violation of Section 2907.07(E) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.
ORC:2907.07.notes: NOTE: If a previous conviction exists, the charge is a felony of the fourth degree and you must allege the previous conviction in the body of the complaint by listing the date of conviction and case number.

ORC:2907.08.heading: VOYEURISM 2907.08(A) ORC (CCC 2307.08)
ORC:2907.08.text: _____________ did, for the purpose of sexually (arousing or gratifying) (himself or herself) trespass or surreptitiously invade the privacy of another to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES), to (spy or eavesdrop) upon another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME), in violation of Section 2907.08(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree

ORC:2907.08.heading: VOYEURISM 2907.08(B) ORC
ORC:2907.08.variant: TRESPASSING TO VIEW PRIVATE AREAS OF ANOTHER – REASONABLE EXPECTATION OF PRIVACY – M2
ORC:2907.08.text: _____________ did, for the purpose of viewing the private areas of another, knowingly trespass or otherwise secretly or surreptitiously (videotape, film, photograph, broadcast, stream, or otherwise record) another person, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND STATE VICTIM’S INITIALS), in a place where the person has a reasonable expectation of privacy, to wit: (DESCRIBE LOCATION AND REASONABLE EXPECTATION OF PRIVACY), in violation of Section 2907.08(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.

ORC:2907.08.heading: VOYEURISM 2907.08(C) ORC
ORC:2907.08.variant: TRESPASSING TO VIEW PRIVATE AREAS OF MINOR – REASONABLE EXPECTATION OF PRIVACY – F5
ORC:2907.08.text: _____________ did, for the purpose of viewing the private areas of another, trespass or otherwise secretly or surreptitiously (videotape, film, photograph, broadcast, stream, or otherwise record) a minor, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S INITIALS AND AGE), in a place where the person has a reasonable expectation of privacy, to wit: (DESCRIBE LOCATION AND REASONABLE EXPECTATION OF PRIVACY), in violation of Section 2907.08(C) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2907.08.heading: VOYEURISM 2907.08(D) ORC
ORC:2907.08.variant: SECRETLY OR SURREPTITIOUSLY TO VIEW BODY OR UNDERGARMENTS OF ANOTHER – M1
ORC:2907.08.text: _____________ did, for the purpose of viewing the body of or the undergarments worn by another, secretly or surreptitiously (videotape, film, photograph, or otherwise record) another person, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S INITIALS AND DESCRIBE CONDUCT), in violation of Section 2907.08(D) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2907.09.heading: PUBLIC INDECENCY 2907.09(A)(1) ORC (CCC 2307.09)
ORC:2907.09.text: _____________ did recklessly, under circumstances in which the conduct was likely to be viewed by and affront others who are in the defendant’s physical proximity and are not members of (his or her) household, expose (his or her) private parts, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES, VICTIMS, AND EXPOSURE) in violation of Section 2907.09(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.
ORC:2907.09.notes: NOTE: If the defendant has a prior conviction for a violation of ORC 2907.09, it is a M3. If the defendant has a prior conviction for a violation of ORC 2907.09 and the victim of the instant offense is a minor, it is an M2. If the defendant has two prior convictions for violations of ORC 2907.09, it is a M2. If the defendant has two prior convictions for violations of ORC 2907.09 and the victim of the instant offense is a minor, it is a M1. If the defendant has three or more prior convictions for violations of ORC 2907.09, it is a M1. If the defendant has three or more prior convictions for violations of ORC 2907.09 and the victim of the instant offense is a minor, it is a F5. The prior convictions, case numbers and dates of convictions must be alleged in the affidavit. The minor victim’s date of birth must be alleged in the affidavit.

ORC:2907.09.heading: PUBLIC INDECENCY 2907.09(A)(2) ORC (CCC 2307.09)
ORC:2907.09.variant: ENGAGE IN SEXUAL CONDUCT OR MASTURBATION – M3
ORC:2907.09.text: _____________ did recklessly, under circumstances in which the conduct was likely to be viewed by and affront others who are in the defendant’s physical proximity and are not members of (his or her) household, engage in sexual conduct or masturbation, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES, VICTIMS, AND CONDUCT/MASTURBATION) in violation of Section 2907.09(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.

ORC:2907.09.heading: PUBLIC INDECENCY 2907.09(A)(3) ORC (CCC 2307.09)
ORC:2907.09.variant: CONDUCT HAVING THE APPEARANCE OF SEXUAL CONDUCT OR MASTURBATION – M3
ORC:2907.09.text: _____________ did recklessly, under circumstances in which the conduct was likely to be viewed and affront others who are in the defendant’s physical proximity and are not members of (his or her) household, engage in conduct that to an ordinary observer would appear to be sexual conduct or masturbation, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES, VICTIMS, AND CONDUCT) in violation of Section 2907.09(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.
ORC:2907.09.notes: NOTE: If the defendant has a prior conviction for a violation of ORC 2907.09, then a violation of (A)(2) or (A)(3) is a M2. If the defendant has a prior conviction for a violation of ORC 2907.09, and the victim of the instant offense is a minor, then a violation of (A)(2) or (A)(3) is a M1. If the defendant has two or more prior convictions for violations of ORC 2907.09, then a violation of (A)(2) or (A)(3) is a M1. If the defendant has two or more prior convictions for violations of ORC 2907.09, and the victim of the instant offense is a minor, then a violation of (A)(2) or (A)(3) is a F5. The prior convictions, dates of conviction, and case numbers must be alleged in the affidavit. The minor victim’s date of birth must be alleged in the affidavit.

ORC:2907.09.heading: PUBLIC INDECENCY 2907.09(B)(1) ORC
ORC:2907.09.variant: ENGAGE IN MASTURBATION IN VIEW OF MINOR – DEFENDANT’S PHYSICAL PROXIMITY – M2
ORC:2907.09.text: _____________ did knowingly, under circumstances in which the conduct was likely to be viewed by and affront a minor who is in the defendant’s physical proximity and is not the defendant’s spouse, engage in masturbation, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES, THE MINOR, AND CONDUCT) in violation of Section 2907.09(B)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.

ORC:2907.09.heading: PUBLIC INDECENCY 2907.09(B)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.09.variant: ENGAGE IN SEXUAL CONDUCT IN VIEW OF MINOR – DEFENDANT’S PHYSICAL PROXIMITY – M2
ORC:2907.09.text: _____________ did knowingly, under circumstances in which the conduct was likely to be viewed by and affront a minor who is in the defendant’s physical proximity and is not the defendant’s spouse, engage in sexual conduct, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES, THE MINOR, AND CONDUCT) in violation of Section 2907.09(B)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.

ORC:2907.09.heading: PUBLIC INDECENCY 2907.09(B)(3) ORC
ORC:2907.09.variant: CONDUCT HAVING THE APPEARANCE OF SEXUAL CONDUCT OR MASTURBATION – MINOR – DEFENDANT’S PHYSICAL PROXIMITY – M2
ORC:2907.09.text: _____________ did knowingly, under circumstances in which the conduct was likely to be viewed by and affront a minor who is in the defendant’s physical proximity and is not the defendant’s spouse, engage in conduct that to an ordinary observer would appear to be sexual conduct or masturbation, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES, THE MINOR, AND CONDUCT) in violation of Section 2907.09(B)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.
ORC:2907.09.notes: NOTE: If the defendant has a prior conviction for a violation of 2907.09, then a violation of (B)(1), (B)(2), or (B)(3) is a M1. If the defendant has two or more prior convictions for violations of 2907.09, then a violation of (B)(1), (B)(2), or (B)(3) is a F5. The prior conviction, date of conviction, court of conviction, and case number must be alleged in the complaint.

ORC:2907.09.heading: PUBLIC INDECENCY 2907.09(B)(4) ORC
ORC:2907.09.variant: EXPOSE PRIVATE PARTS WITH PURPOSE OF SEXUAL AROUSAL/ GRATIFICATION OR TO LURE MINOR INTO SEXUAL ACTIVITY – M1
ORC:2907.09.text: _____________ did knowingly, under circumstances in which the conduct was likely to be viewed by and affront a minor who is in the defendant’s physical proximity and is not the defendant’s spouse, expose (HIS or HER) private parts with the purpose of personal sexual arousal or gratification or to lure the minor into sexual activity, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES, THE MINOR, AND CONDUCT) in violation of Section 2907.09(B)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2907.09.notes: NOTE: If the defendant has a prior conviction for a violation of 2907.09, then a violation of (B)(4) is a F5. The prior conviction, date of conviction, court of conviction, and case number must be alleged in the complaint. DEFINITIONS 2907.13 HUMAN REPRODUCTIVE MATERIAL – a human spermatozoa or ova; or a human organism at any stage of development from fertilized ovum to embryo. ASSISTED REPRODUCTION – a method of causing pregnancy other than through sexual intercourse that includes all of the following: intrauterine insemination; human reproductive material donation; in vitro fertilization and transfer of embryos; and intracytoplasmic sperm injection. DONOR – an individual who provides human reproductive material to a health care professional to be used for assisted reproduction, regardless of whether the human reproductive material is provided for consideration. The term does not include any of the following: a husband or a wife who provides human reproductive material to be used for assisted reproduction by the wife; a woman who gives birth to a child by means of assisted reproduction; or an unmarried man who, with the intent to be the father of the resulting child, provides human reproductive material to be used for assisted reproduction by an unmarried woman. HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONAL – any of the following individuals: a physician; an advanced practice registered nurse; a certified nurse practitioner; a clinical nurse specialist; a physician’s assistant; or a certified nurse-midwife. NOTE: If the offender commits a violation of division (B) of this section and the violation occurs as part of a course of conduct involving other violations of division (B) of this section, the violation is a felony of the second degree. The course of conduct may involve one victim or more than one victim. NOTE: Patient consent to the use of human reproductive material from an anonymous donor is not effective to provide consent for use of human reproductive material of the health care professional performing the procedure. NOTE: It is not a defense to a violation of this section that the patient expressly consented in writing, or by any other means, to the use of human reproductive material from an anonymous donor.

ORC:2907.13.heading: FRAUDULENT ASSISTED REPRODUCTION 2907.13(B)(1) ORC
ORC:2907.13.variant: USE HUMAN REPRODUCTIVE MATERIAL FROM ANOTHER WITHOUT EXPRESS CONSENT – F3
ORC:2907.13.text: _____________, who is a healthcare professional in connection with an assisted reproduction, did knowingly use human reproductive material from (the health care provider, donor, or any other person) while performing the procedure and the patient receiving the procedure had not expressly consented to the use of that material, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 2907.13(B)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2907.13.notes: NOTE: See additional information at the beginning of Section 2907.13 of this manual.

ORC:2907.13.heading: FRAUDULENT ASSISTED REPRODUCTION 2907.13(B)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.13.variant: FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH 3111.88 ORC TO 3111.96 ORC – F3
ORC:2907.13.text: _____________, who is a healthcare professional in connection with an assisted reproduction, did knowingly fail to comply with the standards of Sections 3111.88 to 3111.96 of the Ohio Revised Code, including the terms of the required written consent form, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND THE SECTION(S) OFFENDER FAILED TO COMPLY), in violation of Section 2907.13(B)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2907.13.notes: NOTE: See additional information at the beginning of Section 2907.13 of this manual.

ORC:2907.13.heading: FRAUDULENT ASSISTED REPRODUCTION 2907.13(B)(3) ORC
ORC:2907.13.variant: MISREPRESENT MATERIAL INFORMATION TO PATIENT – F3
ORC:2907.13.text: _____________, who is a healthcare professional in connection with an assisted reproduction, did knowingly misrepresent to the patient receiving the procedure any material information about the donor’s profile, including (the types of information listed in Section 3111.93(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code or the manner or extent to which the material will be used), to wit: (DESCRIBE MISREPRESENTATION AND CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 2907.13(B)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2907.13.notes: NOTE: Section 3111.93(A)(2) states that prior to a non-spousal artificial insemination, the physician associated with the procedure shall, upon request, provide the recipient and her husband (if married) with the following information to the extent the physician has knowledge of it: 1. The medical history of the donor, including, but not limited to, any available genetic history of the donor and persons related to him by consanguinity, the blood type of the donor, and whether he has an RH factor; 2. The race, eye and hair color, age, height, and weight of the donor; 3. The educational attainment and talents of the donor; 4. The religious background of the donor; and 5. Any other information that the donor has indicated may be disclosed. NOTE: See additional information at the beginning of Section 2907.13 of this manual. DEFINITIONS 2907.19(A) ADVERTISEMENT FOR SEXUAL ACTIVITY FOR HIRE or ADVERTISEMENT – any advertisement or offer in electronic or print media that includes an explicit or implicit offer for sexual activity for hire to occur in this state. DEPICTION – any photograph, film, videotape, visual material, or printed material. PERSON – includes an individual, corporation, business trust, estate, trust, partnership, and association. NOTE: In any prosecution under this section, it is not a defense that the offender did not know the age of the person depicted in the advertisement, relied on an oral or written representation of the age of the person depicted in the advertisement, or relied on the apparent age of the person depicted in the advertisement. NOTE: In any prosecution under this section, it is an affirmative defense that the offender, prior to purchasing advertising space for the advertisement, made a reasonable bona fide attempt to ascertain the true age of the person depicted in the advertisement by requiring the person depicted in the advertisement to produce a driver’s license, marriage license, birth certificate, or other government issued or school issued document that identifies the age of the person, provided the offender retains and produces a copy or other record of the driver’s license, marriage license, birth certificate, or other document used to ascertain the age of the person depicted in the advertisement.

ORC:2907.19.heading: COMMERCIAL SEXUAL EXPLOITATION OF A MINOR 2907.19(B) ORC
ORC:2907.19.variant: ADVERTISEMENT FOR SEXUAL ACTIVITY DEPICTING MINOR – F3
ORC:2907.19.text: _____________ did knowingly (purchase or otherwise obtain), advertising space for an advertisement for sexual activity for hire, to wit: (DESCRIBE ADVERTISEMENT), that includes a depiction of a minor, in violation of Section 2907.19(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.21.heading: COMPELLING PROSTITUTION 2907.21(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2907.21.text: _____________ did knowingly compel another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON), to engage in sexual activity for hire, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACTIVITY AND COMPENSATION INVOLVED), in violation of Section 2907.21(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2907.21.notes: NOTE: The element “compel” does not require that the compulsion be openly displayed or physically exerted. The element “compel” has been established if the state proves that the offender overcame the victim’s will by force, fear, duress, or intimidation; by furnishing or offering a controlled substance to the victim; or by manipulating the victim’s controlled substance addiction.

ORC:2907.21.notes: NOTE: The element “compel” does not require that the compulsion be openly displayed or physically exerted. The element “compel” has been established if the state proves that the offender overcame the victim’s will by force, fear, duress, or intimidation; by furnishing or offering a controlled substance to the victim; or by manipulating the victim’s controlled substance addiction.

ORC:2907.21.heading: COMPELLING PROSTITUTION 2907.21(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.21.variant: INDUCE OR REQUEST A MINOR – F3
ORC:2907.21.text: _____________ did knowingly (induce, procure, encourage, solicit, request or otherwise facilitate) a minor, to wit: (STATE NAME AND AGE OF PERSON), to engage in sexual activity for hire, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACTIVITY and COMPENSATION INVOLVED), whether or not the offender knows the age of the minor, in violation of section 2907.21(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.21.heading: COMPELLING PROSTITUTION 2907.21(A)(3) ORC

ORC:2907.21.heading: COMPELLING PROSTITUTION 2907.21(A)(4) ORC

ORC:2907.21.text: _____________ did knowingly pay a minor, to wit: (STATE NAME AND AGE OF PERSON), either directly or through the minor’s agent, for the minor having engaged in sexual activity, pursuant to a prior agreement, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACTIVITY AND COMPENSATION INVOLVED), whether or not the offender knows the age of the minor, in violation of Section 2907.21(A)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.21.heading: COMPELLING PROSTITUTION 2907.21(A)(5) ORC
ORC:2907.21.variant: PARENT/GUARDIAN ALLOWING MINOR TO ENGAGE IN SEXUAL ACTIVITY FOR HIRE – F3
ORC:2907.21.text: _____________ being the (parent, guardian, custodian, person having custody or control, or the person in loco parentis) of the minor, to wit: (STATE NAME AND AGE OF PERSON), did knowingly allow the minor to engage in sexual activity for hire to wit: (DESCRIBE ACTIVITY AND COMPENSATION) in violation of Section 2907.21(A)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.22.heading: PROMOTING PROSTITUTION 2907.22(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2907.22.variant: BROTHEL OR SEXUAL ACTIVITY FOR HIRE ENTERPRISE – F4
ORC:2907.22.text: _____________ did knowingly (establish, maintain, operate, manage, supervise, control, or have an interest) in a brothel or any other enterprise a purpose of which is to facilitate engagement in sexual activity for hire, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES) in violation of Section 2907.22(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2907.22.notes: NOTE: If the prostitute is a minor, whether or not the offender knows the age of the minor, then promoting prostitution is a felony of the third degree. NOTE: Whoever violates this section is guilty of promoting prostitution. Except as otherwise provided in this division, promoting prostitution is a felony of the fourth degree. If any prostitute in the brothel involved in the offense, or the prostitute whose activities are supervised, managed, or controlled by the offender, or the person transported, induced, or procured by the offender to engage in sexual activity for hire, is a minor, whether or not the offender knows the age of the minor, then promoting prostitution is a felony of the third degree. If the offender in any case also is convicted of or pleads guilty to a specification as described in section 2941.1422 of the Revised Code that was included in the indictment, count in the indictment, or information charging the offense, the court shall sentence the offender to a mandatory prison term as provided in division (B)(7) of section 2929.14 of the Revised Code and shall order the offender to make restitution as provided in division (B)(8) of section 2929.18 of the Revised Code.

NOTE: Whoever violates this section is guilty of promoting prostitution. Except as otherwise provided in this division, promoting prostitution is a felony of the fourth degree. If any prostitute in the brothel involved in the offense, or the prostitute whose activities are supervised, managed, or controlled by the offender, or the person transported, induced, or procured by the offender to engage in sexual activity for hire, is a minor, whether or not the offender knows the age of the minor, then promoting prostitution is a felony of the third degree. If the offender in any case also is convicted of or pleads guilty to a specification as described in section 2941.1422 of the Revised Code that was included in the indictment, count in the indictment, or information charging the offense, the court shall sentence the offender to a mandatory prison term as provided in division (B)(7) of section 2929.14 of the Revised Code and shall order the offender to make restitution as provided in division (B)(8) of section 2929.18 of the Revised Code.

ORC:2907.23.heading: PROCURING 2907.23(A)(1) ORC (CCC 2307.23)
ORC:2907.23.text: _____________ did, knowingly and for gain, (entice or solicit) another, to wit: (DESCRIBE MANNER, COMPENSATION and STATE NAME), to patronize a (prostitute or brothel), to wit: (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2907.23(A) (1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2907.23.notes: NOTE: The Columbus City Code provides for no reduction in sentence for first thirty days under the first offense and no reduction in sentence for the first 60 days on subsequent offenses.

ORC:2907.23.heading: PROCURING 2907.23(A)(2) ORC (CCC 2307.23)
ORC:2907.23.text: _____________ did, knowingly and for gain, procure a prostitute for another to patronize, to wit: (DESCRIBE PROCUREMENT, COMPENSATION AND NAME OF PROSTITUTE AND PATRON), in violation of Section 2907.23(A) (2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2907.23.notes: NOTE: The Columbus City Code provides for no reduction in sentence for first thirty days under the first offense and no reduction in sentence for the first 60 days on subsequent offenses.

ORC:2907.23.text: _____________ did, knowingly and for gain, procure a prostitute for another to patronize, to wit: (DESCRIBE PROCUREMENT, COMPENSATION, NAME OF PROSTITUTE AND PATRON, AND AGE OF THE PROSTITUTE), under the age of sixteen in violation of Section 2907.23(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2907.23.heading: PROCURING 2907.23(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.23.variant: PROCURE PROSTITUTE AGE 16-17 FOR ANOTHER – F5
ORC:2907.23.text: _____________ did, knowingly and for gain, procure a prostitute for another to patronize, to wit: (DESCRIBE PROCUREMENT, COMPENSATION, NAME OF PROSTITUTE AND PATRON, AND AGE OF THE PROSTITUTE), between the ages of sixteen and seventeen in violation of Section 2907.23(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2907.23.heading: PROCURING 2907.23(A)(2) ORC (CCC 2307.23)
ORC:2907.23.variant: DIRECT ANOTHER TO A PLACE FOR PROSTITUTION – M1
ORC:2907.23.text: _____________ did, knowingly and for gain, (take or direct) another, to wit: (DESCRIBE COMPENSATION, MANNER, AND STATE NAME), at (his or her) request to a place, to wit: (STATE LOCATION OF PLACE), for the purpose of patronizing a prostitute, in violation of Section 2907.23(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2907.23.notes: NOTE: The Columbus City Code provides for no reduction in sentence for first thirty days under the first offense and no reduction in sentence for the first 60 days on subsequent offenses.

ORC:2907.23.heading: PROCURING 2907.23(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.23.variant: DIRECT ANOTHER TO A PLACE FOR PROSTITUTION, PROSTITUTE UNDER 16 – F4
ORC:2907.23.text: _____________ did, knowingly and for gain, (take or direct) another, to wit: (DESCRIBE COMPENSATION, MANNER, AND STATE NAME), at (his or her) request to a place, to wit: (STATE LOCATION OF PLACE), for the purpose of patronizing a prostitute under the age of sixteen, to wit: (STATE NAME AND AGE OF PROSTITUTE), in violation of Section 2907.23(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2907.23.heading: PROCURING 2907.23(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.23.variant: DIRECT ANOTHER TO A PLACE FOR PROSTITUTION, PROSTITUTE AGE 16-17 – F5
ORC:2907.23.text: _____________ did, knowingly and for gain, (take or direct) another, to wit: (DESCRIBE COMPENSATION, MANNER, AND STATE NAME), at (his or her) request to a place, to wit: (STATE LOCATION OF PLACE), for the purpose of patronizing a prostitute between the ages of sixteen and seventeen, to wit: (STATE NAME AND AGE OF PROSTITUTE), in violation of Section 2907.23(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2907.23.heading: PROCURING 2907.23(B) ORC (CCC 2307.23)
ORC:2907.23.variant: PERMIT PREMISES TO BE USED FOR PROSTITUTION – M1
ORC:2907.23.text: _____________ did, having (authority or responsibility) over the use of premises, to wit: (STATE LOCATION), knowingly permit such premises to be used for the purpose of engaging in sexual activity for hire, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACTIVITY AND COMPENSATION), in violation of Section 2907.23(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2907.23.notes: NOTE: The Columbus City Code provides for no reduction in sentence for first thirty days under the first offense and no reduction in sentence for the first 60 days on subsequent offenses.

ORC:2907.23.heading: PROCURING 2907.23(B) ORC
ORC:2907.23.variant: PERMIT PREMISES TO BE USED FOR PROSTITUTION, PROSTITUTE AGE 16-17 – F5
ORC:2907.23.text: _____________ did, having (authority or responsibility) over the use of premises, to wit: (STATE LOCATION), knowingly permit such premises to be used for the purpose of engaging in sexual activity for hire, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACTIVITY AND COMPENSATION) by a prostitute between the ages of sixteen and seventeen, to wit: (STATE NAME AND AGE OF PROSTITUTE), in violation of Section 2907.23(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2907.231.heading: ENGAGING IN PROSTITUTION 2907.231(B) ORC
ORC:2907.231.variant: INDUCE, ENTICE, OR PROCURE ANOTHER – M1
ORC:2907.231.text: _____________ did recklessly induce, entice, or procure another, to wit: (STATE NAME), to engage in sexual activity for hire, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACTIVITY AND COMPENSATION), in violation of Section 2907.231(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2907.231.notes: NOTE: “Sexual activity for hire” means an implicit or explicit agreement to provide sexual activity in exchange for anything of value paid to the person engaging in such sexual activity, to any person trafficking that person, or to any person associated with either such person. NOTE: This section is intended to be used for “Johns” who are attempting to purchase sexual activity.

ORC:2907.231.heading: ENGAGING IN PROSTITUTION 2907.231(C) ORC
ORC:2907.231.variant: INDUCE, ENTICE, OR PROCURE ANOTHER WHO HAS A DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITY – F3
ORC:2907.231.text: _____________ did recklessly induce, entice, or procure another who has a developmental disability, to wit: (STATE NAME AND DESCRIBE DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITY), to engage in sexual activity for hire in exchange for the person giving anything of value to the other person, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACTIVITY AND COMPENSATION), and the offender (knows or has reasonable cause to believe) that the other person is a person with a developmental disability, in violation of Section 2907.231(C) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.24.heading: SOLICITING 2907.24(A) ORC (CCC 2307.24)

ORC:2907.24.notes: NOTE: “Sexual activity for hire” means an implicit or explicit agreement to provide sexual activity in exchange for anything of value paid to the person engaging in such sexual activity, to any person trafficking that person, or to any person associated with either such person. NOTE: This section is intended to be used for persons attempting to sell sexual activity.

ORC:2907.24.heading: SOLICITING 2907.24(B) ORC
ORC:2907.24.variant: SEXUAL ACTIVITY FOR HIRE – SOLICITATION AFTER POSITIVE HIV TEST – F3
ORC:2907.24.text: _____________ did, with knowledge that he or she has tested positive as a carrier of a virus that causes acquired immunodeficiency syndrome, to wit: (DESCRIBE DETAILS OF KNOWLEDGE AND LOCATION OF CLINIC OF TEST), knowingly solicit another, to wit: (STATE NAME), to engage in sexual activity for hire, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACTIVITY AND COMPENSATION), in violation of Section 2907.24(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2907.24.notes: NOTE: “Sexual activity for hire” means an implicit or explicit agreement to provide sexual activity in exchange for anything of value paid to the person engaging in such sexual activity, to any person trafficking that person, or to any person associated with either such person. NOTE: If the offender commits the violation prior to July 1, 1996, engaging in solicitation after a positive HIV test is a felony of the second degree. If the offender commits the violation on or after July 1, 1996, engaging in solicitation after a positive HIV test is a felony of the third degree. NOTE: This section is intended to be used for persons attempting to sell sexual activity.

ORC:2907.241.heading: LOITERING TO ENGAGE IN SOLICITATION 2907.241(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2907.241.variant: BECKON TO, STOP OR ATTEMPT TO STOP – M3
ORC:2907.241.text: _____________ did, with purpose to solicit another to engage in sexual activity for hire and while in or near a public place, to wit: (NAME SEXUAL ACTIVITY SOLICITED AND WHERE IT TOOK PLACE), beckon to or stop or attempt to stop another, to wit: (NAME OF PERSON), in violation of Section 2907.241(A) (1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.
ORC:2907.241.notes: NOTE: If the person has knowledge that he or she has tested positive as a carrier of a virus that causes acquired immunodeficiency syndrome and has engaged in conduct as described in this section, and the offense was committed prior to July 1, 1996, the offense is LOITERING TO ENGAGE IN SOLICITATION AFTER A POSITIVE HIV TEST in violation of Section 2907.241(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree. ORC:2907.32.heading: PANDERING OBSCENITY 2907.32(A)(5) ORC

ORC:2907.32.notes: DEFINITIONS 2907.321, 2907.322, AND 2907.323 IMPAIRED PERSON – Means a person whose ability to resist or consent is substantially impaired because of a mental or physical condition or because of advanced age, and the offender knows or has reasonable cause to believe that the other person’s ability to resist or consent is substantially impaired because of a mental or physical condition or because of advanced age. NOTE: Mistake of age is not a defense to the charge.

ORC:2907.321.heading: PANDERING OBSCENITY INVOLVING A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON 2907.321(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2907.321.variant: CREATE, REPRODUCE OR PUBLISH OBSCENE MATERIAL– F2 OR F3
ORC:2907.321.text: _____________ did, with knowledge of the character of the material involved, to wit: (STATE NATURE OF MATERIAL AND BASIS OF PERSON’S KNOWLEDGE), (create or reproduce or publish) obscene material that has a minor or impaired person as one of its (participants or portrayed observers), to wit: (DESCRIBE MATERIAL AND NAME OR DESCRIBE MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON INVOLVED INCLUDING AGE), in violation of Section 2907.321(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.
ORC:2907.321.notes: NOTE: If the offense involved a minor, violation of this section is a felony of the second degree. If the offense involved an impaired person, violation of this section is a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.321.heading: PANDERING OBSCENITY INVOLVING A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON 2907.321(A)(2) ORC

ORC:2907.321.variant: SELL, DELIVER, PUBLICLY DISPLAY OBSCENE MATERIAL – F2 OR F3

ORC:2907.321.text: _____________ did, having knowledge of the character of the material involved, to wit: (STATE NATURE OF MATERIAL AND BASIS OF PERSON’S KNOWLEDGE), (offer to sell or agree to sell or agree to deliver or agree to publicly disseminate or agree to publicly display or agree to exhibit or agree to present or agree to rent or agree to provide) obscene material that has a minor or impaired person as one of its (participants or portrayed observers), to wit: (DESCRIBE MATERIAL AND MINOR/IMPAIRED PERSON), in violation of Section 2907.321(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.
ORC:2907.321.notes: NOTE: If the offense involved a minor, violation of this section is a felony of the second degree. If the offense involved an impaired person, violation of this section is a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.321.heading: PANDERING OBSCENITY INVOLVING A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON 2907.321(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2907.321.variant: CREATE, DIRECT, PRODUCE AN OBSCENE PERFORMANCE WITH MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON – F2 OR F3

ORC:2907.321.notes: NOTE: If the offense involved a minor, violation of this section is a felony of the second degree. If the offense involved an impaired person, violation of this section is a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.321.heading: PANDERING OBSCENITY INVOLVING A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON 2907.321(A)(4) ORC
ORC:2907.321.variant: ADVERTISE, PROMOTE AN OBSCENE PERFORMANCE WITH MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON – F2 OR F3

ORC:2907.321.text: _____________ did, having knowledge of the character of the material involved, to wit: (STATE NATURE OF MATERIAL AND BASIS OF PERSON’S KNOWLEDGE), (present or participate in the presentation of) an obscene performance for presentation that has a minor or impaired person as one of its participants (DESCRIBE PERFORMANCE AND MINOR/IMPAIRED PERSON), in violation of Section 2907.321(A)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.
ORC:2907.321.notes: NOTE: If the offense involved a minor, violation of this section is a felony of the second degree. If the offense involved an impaired person, violation of this section is a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.321.heading: PANDERING OBSCENITY INVOLVING A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON 2907.321(A)(5) ORC
ORC:2907.321.variant: BUY OR POSSESS FOR ADVERTISING, SALE OR DELIVERY – F4
ORC:2907.321.text: _____________ did, having knowledge of the character of the material involved, to wit: (STATE NATURE OF MATERIAL AND BASIS OF PERSON’S KNOWLEDGE), (buy or procure or possess or control) obscene material that has a minor or impaired person as one of its participants (DESCRIBE PERFORMANCE AND MINOR/IMPAIRED PERSON), in violation of Section 2907.321(A)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2907.321.notes: NOTE: “Impaired Person” means a person whose ability to resist or consent is substantially impaired because of a mental or physical condition or because of advanced age, and the offender knows or has reasonable cause to believe that the other person’s ability to resist or consent is substantially impaired because of a mental or physical condition or because of advanced age.

ORC:2907.321.heading: PANDERING OBSCENITY INVOLVING A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON 2907.321(A)(5) ORC

ORC:2907.321.text: _____________ did, having knowledge of the character of the material involved, to wit: (STATE NATURE OF MATERIAL AND BASIS OF PERSON’S KNOWLEDGE), (buy or procure or possess or control) obscene material that has a minor or impaired person as one of its participants (DESCRIBE PERFORMANCE AND MINOR/IMPAIRED PERSON), and having been previously convicted of (this section or section 2907.322 or section 2907.323) of the Ohio Revised Code, to wit: (STATE SECTION, COURT, CASE NUMBER AND DATE OF PREVIOUS CONVICTION), in violation of Section 2907.321(A) (5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.321.notes: NOTE: If the offense involved a minor, violation of this section is a felony of the second degree. If the offense involved an impaired person, violation of this section is a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.322.heading: PANDERING SEXUALLY ORIENTED MATTER INVOLVING A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON 2907.322(A)(1) ORC

ORC:2907.322.variant: SELL, DELIVER, PUBLICLY DISPLAY OBSCENE MATERIAL – F2 OR F3

ORC:2907.322.notes: NOTE: If the offense involved a minor, violation of this section is a felony of the second degree. If the offense involved an impaired person, violation of this section is a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.322.heading: PANDERING SEXUALLY ORIENTED MATTER INVOLVING A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON 2907.322(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2907.322.variant: CREATE, DIRECT, PRODUCE A PERFORMANCE – F2 OR F3

ORC:2907.322.variant: ADVERTISE, PROMOTE A PERFORMANCE – F2 OR F3

ORC:2907.322.variant: PRESENT, PARTICIPATE IN PRESENTING AN OBSCENE PERFORMANCE – F2 OR F3
ORC:2907.322.text: _____________ did, having knowledge of the character of the material involved, to wit: (STATE NATURE OF MATERIAL AND BASIS OF PERSON’S KNOWLEDGE), (present or participate in presenting) a performance for presentation that shows a minor or impaired person (participating or engaging) in (sexual activity or masturbation or bestiality), to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT AND IDENTIFY MINOR/IMPAIRED PERSON INVOLVED INCLUDING AGE), in violation of Section 2907.322(A)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.
ORC:2907.322.notes: NOTE: If the offense involved an impaired person, violation of this section is a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.322.heading: PANDERING SEXUALLY ORIENTED MATTER INVOLVING A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON 2907.322(A)(5) ORC
ORC:2907.322.text: _____________ did, having knowledge of the character of the material involved, to wit: (STATE NATURE OF MATERIAL AND BASIS OF PERSON’S KNOWLEDGE), knowingly (solicit or receive or purchase or exchange or possess or control) material that shows a minor or impaired person (participating or engaging) in (sexual activity or masturbation or bestiality), to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT AND IDENTIFY MINOR/IMPAIRED PERSON INVOLVED INCLUDING AGE), in violation of Section 2907.322(A)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2907.322.heading: PANDERING SEXUALLY ORIENTED MATTER INVOLVING A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON 2907.322(A)(5) ORC
ORC:2907.322.variant: BUY OR POSSESS – PREVIOUS CONVICTION – F3
ORC:2907.322.text: _____________ did, having knowledge of the character of the material involved, to wit: (STATE NATURE OF MATERIAL AND BASIS OF PERSON’S KNOWLEDGE), knowingly (solicit or receive or purchase or exchange or possess or control) material that shows a minor or impaired person (participating or engaging) in (sexual activity or masturbation or bestiality), to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT AND IDENTIFY MINOR/IMPAIRED PERSON INVOLVED INCLUDING AGE), and having been previously convicted of (this section or section 2907.321 or section 2907.323) of the Ohio Revised Code, to wit: (STATE SECTION, COURT, CASE NUMBER AND DATE OF PREVIOUS CONVICTION), in violation of Section 2907.322(A)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.322.heading: PANDERING SEXUALLY ORIENTED MATTER INVOLVING A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON 2907.322(A)(6) ORC

ORC:2907.322.notes: NOTE: If the offense involved a minor, violation of this section is a felony of the second degree. If the offense involved an impaired person, violation of this section is a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2907.323.heading: ILLEGAL USE OF A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON IN NUDITY–ORIENTED MATERIAL OR PERFORMANCE 2907.323(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2907.323.variant: PHOTOGRAPH ANOTHER’S CHILD OR IMPAIRED PERSON NUDE – F2 OR F3
ORC:2907.323.text: _____________ did photograph a minor or impaired person who was not the person’s own (child or ward), to wit: (STATE NAME AND AGE OR IMPAIRMENT), in a state of nudity, in violation of Section 2907.323(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.
ORC:2907.323.notes: NOTE: If the offense involved a minor, violation of this section is a felony of the second degree. If the offense involved an impaired person, violation of this section is a felony of the third degree. NOTE: This section does not apply if the material or performance is for or presented for a bona fide artistic, medical, scientific, educational, religious, governmental, judicial or other proper purpose, by or to a physician, psychologist, sociologist, scientist, teacher, a person pursuing bona fide studies or research, librarian, clergyman, member of the clergy, prosecutor, judge, or other person having a proper interest in the material or performance, and with the written consent of the impaired person’s or minor’s parent/guardian/custodian.

ORC:2907.323.heading: ILLEGAL USE OF A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON IN NUDITY–ORIENTED MATERIAL OR PERFORMANCE 2907.323(A)(1) ORC

ORC:2907.323.notes: NOTE: If the offense involved a minor, violation of this section is a felony of the second degree. If the offense involved an impaired person, violation of this section is a felony of the third degree. NOTE: This section does not apply if the material or performance is for or presented for a bona fide artistic, medical, scientific, educational, religious, governmental, judicial or other proper purpose, by or to a physician, psychologist, sociologist, scientist, teacher, a person pursuing bona fide studies or research, librarian, clergyman, member of the clergy, prosecutor, judge, or other person having a proper interest in the material or performance, and with the written consent of the impaired person’s or minor’s parent/guardian/custodian.

ORC:2907.323.notes: NOTE: If the offense involved a minor, violation of this section is a felony of the second degree. If the offense involved an impaired person, violation of this section is a felony of the third degree.

If the offense involved an impaired person, violation of this section is a felony of the third degree. NOTE: An affirmative defense to this section is that the material or performance is for or presented for a bona fide artistic, medical, scientific, educational, religious, governmental, judicial or other proper purpose, by or to a physician, psychologist, sociologist, scientist, teacher, a person pursuing bona fide studies or research, librarian, clergyman, member of the clergy, prosecutor, judge, or other person having a proper interest in the material or performance, and with the written consent of the impaired person’s or minor’s parent/ guardian/custodian.
