ORC:2907.323.notes: NOTE: This section does not apply if the material or performance is for or presented for a bona fide artistic, medical, scientific, educational, religious, governmental, judicial or other proper purpose, by or to a physician, psychologist, sociologist, scientist, teacher, a person pursuing bona fide studies or research, librarian, clergyman, member of the clergy, prosecutor, judge, or other person having a proper interest in the material or performance, and with the written consent of the impaired person’s or minor’s parent/guardian/custodian.

ORC:2907.323.heading: ILLEGAL USE OF A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON IN NUDITY–ORIENTED MATERIAL OR PERFORMANCE 2907.323(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2907.323.variant: POSSESS OR VIEW MATERIAL OR PERFORMANCE OF ANOTHER’S CHILD OR IMPAIRED PERSON NUDE – F5
ORC:2907.323.text: _____________ did possess or view any (material or performance), to wit: (DESCRIBE MATERIAL OR PERFORMANCE) that shows another’s (minor child or ward)(or impaired person), to wit: (STATE NAME AND AGE OR IMPAIRMENT), in a state of nudity, in violation of Section 2907.323(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.
ORC:2907.323.notes: NOTE: This section does not apply if the material or performance is for or presented for a bona fide artistic, medical, scientific, educational, religious, governmental, judicial or other proper purpose, by or to a physician, psychologist, sociologist, scientist, teacher, a person pursuing bona fide studies or research, librarian, clergyman, member of the clergy, prosecutor, judge, or other person having a proper interest in the material or performance, and with the written consent of the impaired person’s or minor’s parent/guardian/custodian.

ORC:2907.323.heading: ILLEGAL USE OF A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON IN NUDITY–ORIENTED MATERIAL OR PERFORMANCE 2907.323(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2907.323.variant: POSSESS PHOTOGRAPH ANOTHER’S CHILD OR IMPAIRED PERSON NUDE – PREVIOUS CONVICTION – F4
ORC:2907.323.text: _____________ did possess or view a photograph of another’s (minor child or ward)(or impaired person), to wit: (STATE NAME AND AGE OR IMPAIRMENT), in a state of nudity, and having been previously convicted of (this section or section 2907.321 or section 2907.322) of the Ohio Revised Code, to wit: (STATE SECTION, COURT, CASE NUMBER AND DATE OF PREVIOUS CONVICTION), in violation of Section 2907.323(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2907.323.notes: NOTE: This section does not apply if the material or performance is for or presented for a bona fide artistic, medical, scientific, educational, religious, governmental, judicial or other proper purpose, by or to a physician, psychologist, sociologist, scientist, teacher, a person pursuing bona fide studies or research, librarian, clergyman, member of the clergy, prosecutor, judge, or other person having a proper interest in the material or performance, and with the written consent of the impaired person’s or minor’s parent/guardian/custodian.

ORC:2907.323.heading: ILLEGAL USE OF A MINOR OR IMPAIRED PERSON IN NUDITY–ORIENTED MATERIAL OR PERFORMANCE 2907.323(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2907.323.variant: POSSESS ANY MATERIAL OR PERFORMANCE OF ANOTHER’S CHILD OR IMPAIRED PERSON NUDE – PREVIOUS CONVICTION – F4
ORC:2907.323.text: _____________ did possess any (material or performance), to wit: (DESCRIBE MATERIAL OR PERFORMANCE) that shows another’s (minor child or ward) (or impaired person), to wit: (STATE NAME AND AGE OR IMPAIRMENT), in a state of nudity, and having been previously convicted of (this section or section 2907.321 or section 2907.322) of the Ohio Revised Code, to wit: (STATE SECTION, COURT, CASE NUMBER AND DATE OF PREVIOUS CONVICTION), in violation of Section 2907.323(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2907.323.notes: NOTE: This section does not apply if the material or performance is for or presented for a bona fide artistic, medical, scientific, educational, religious, governmental, judicial or other proper purpose, by or to a physician, psychologist, sociologist, scientist, teacher, a person pursuing bona fide studies or research, librarian, clergyman, member of the clergy, prosecutor, judge, or other person having a proper interest in the material or performance, and with the written consent of the impaired person’s or minor’s parent/guardian/custodian.

ORC:2907.33.heading: DECEPTION TO OBTAIN MATTER HARMFUL TO JUVENILES 2907.33(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2907.33.text: _____________, for the purpose of enabling a juvenile to obtain (any material or gain admission to any performance) which is harmful to juveniles, did falsely represent that the offender, to wit: (OFFENDER’S NAME) is the (parent or guardian or spouse) of such juvenile, to wit: (NAME JUVENILE AND STATE AGE), in violation of Section 2907.33(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.

ORC:2907.33.heading: DECEPTION TO OBTAIN MATTER HARMFUL TO JUVENILES 2907.33(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.33.text: _____________, for the purpose of enabling a juvenile to obtain (any material or gain admission to performance) which is harmful to juveniles, the offender, to wit: (OFFENDER’S NAME), did furnish (identification or documentation) purporting to show that such juvenile is eighteen years of age or older than eighteen years of age or married) to wit: (IDENTIFY DOCUMENT), in violation of Section 2907.33(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.

ORC:2907.33.heading: DECEPTION TO OBTAIN MATTER HARMFUL TO JUVENILES 2907.33(B)(1) ORC
ORC:2907.33.text: _____________ being a juvenile, to wit: (STATE AGE), did, for the purpose of enabling said juvenile to obtain (any material or gain admission to any performance) which is harmful to juveniles, to wit: (DESCRIBE MATERIAL OR PERFORMANCE), falsely represent that said juvenile is eighteen years old, in violation of Section 2907.33(B)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.

ORC:2907.33.heading: DECEPTION TO OBTAIN MATTER HARMFUL TO JUVENILES 2907.33(B)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.33.text: _____________ being a juvenile, to wit: (STATE AGE), did, for the purpose of enabling said juvenile to obtain (any material or gain admission to any performance) which is harmful to juveniles, exhibit (identification or documentation) purporting to show that said juvenile is (eighteen years of age or older than eighteen years of age or married), to wit: (IDENTIFY DOCUMENT), in violation of Section 2907.33(B)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.
ORC:2907.33.notes: NOTE: A juvenile that violates division (B) of this section shall be adjudged an unruly child.

ORC:2907.34.heading: COMPELLING ACCEPTANCE OF OBJECTIONABLE MATERIALS 2907.34(A) ORC
ORC:2907.34.text: _____________ did, as a condition to the (sale or allocation or consignment or delivery) of any (materials or goods) of any kind, require the (purchaser or consignee), to wit: (STATE NAME AND/OR COMPANY AND ADDRESS) to accept other material that was reasonably believed to be obscene, to wit: (DESCRIBE MATERIAL), in violation of Section 2907.34(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2907.34.heading: COMPELLING ACCEPTANCE OF OBJECTIONABLE MATERIALS 2907.34(A) ORC
ORC:2907.34.text: _____________ did, as a condition to the (sale or allocation or consignment or delivery) of any (materials or goods) of any kind, require the (purchaser or consignee), to wit: (STATE NAME AND/OR COMPANY AND ADDRESS) to accept other material that if furnished to a juvenile would be a violation of section 2907.31 of the Ohio Revised Code, to wit: (DESCRIBE MATERIAL), in violation of Section 2907.34(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2907.34.heading: COMPELLING ACCEPTANCE OF OBJECTIONABLE MATERIALS 2907.34(B) ORC
ORC:2907.34.variant: THREATEN OR IMPOSE FINANCIAL PENALTY – F5
ORC:2907.34.text: _____________ did (impose or threaten to impose) a (financial or other) penalty upon a (purchaser or consignee), to wit: (STATE NAME AND/OR COMPANY AND ADDRESS) because said person refused to accept other material, that was reasonably believed to be obscene, to wit: (DESCRIBE MATERIAL), as a condition to the (sale or allocation or consignment or delivery) of other (materials or goods) of any kind, in violation of Section 2907.34(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2907.34.heading: COMPELLING ACCEPTANCE OF OBJECTIONABLE MATERIALS 2907.34(B) ORC
ORC:2907.34.text: _____________ did (deny or threaten to deny) a franchise to a (purchaser or consignee), to wit: (STATE NAME AND/OR COMPANY AND ADDRESS) because said person refused to accept other material, that was if furnish to a juvenile would be a violation of section 2907.31 of the Ohio Revised Code, to wit: (DESCRIBE MATERIAL), as a condition of the (sale or allocation or consignment or delivery) of other goods, in violation of Section 2907.34(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2907.38.heading: PERMITTING UNLAWFUL OPERATION OF VIEWING BOOTHS DEPICTING SEXUAL CONDUCT 2907.38 ORC
ORC:2907.38.text: _____________ did, having (custody, control or supervision) of a commercial establishment, with knowledge of the character of the visual material or performance involved, to wit: (STATE NAME OF ESTABLISHMENT AND DESCRIBE MATERIAL INVOLVED), knowingly (permit the use of or offer the use of) (viewing booths, stalls, or partitioned portions of a room) located in the commercial establishment for the purpose of viewing visual materials or performances depicting sexual conduct, in violation of Section 2907.38 of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2907.38.notes: NOTE: This section does not apply if both of the following apply: 1. The inside of each booth, stall, or partitioned room is visible from, and at least one side of each booth, stall, or partitioned room is open to, a continuous and contiguous main aisle or hallway that is open to the public areas of the commercial establishment and is not obscured by any curtain, door, or other covering or enclosure. 2. No booth, stall, or partitioned room is designed, constructed, pandered, or allowed to be used for the purpose of encouraging or facilitating nudity or sexual activity on the part of or between patrons or members of the public, and no booth, stall or partitioned room has any aperture, hole, or opening for the purpose of encouraging or facilitating nudity or sexual activity.

ORC:2907.39.heading: PERMITTING JUVENILE ON PREMISES OF ADULT ENTERTAINMENT ESTABLISHMENT 2907.39(B) ORC
ORC:2907.39.variant: ALLOWING MINOR TO ENTER PREMISES – M1
ORC:2907.39.text: _____________ did knowingly allow an individual under the age of eighteen, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON UNDER EIGHTEEN AND DOB) on the premise of an adult entertainment establishment, to wit: (NAME OF ESTABLISHMENT AND DESCRIBE VIOLATION), in violation of Section 2907.39(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2907.39.notes: NOTE: Each day a person violates this division constitutes a separate offense.

ORC:2907.39.heading: PERMITTING JUVENILE ON PREMISES OF ADULT ENTERTAINMENT ESTABLISHMENT 2907.39(C) ORC
ORC:2907.39.variant: USE OF FALSE INFORMATION TO GAIN ENTRY – M4
ORC:2907.39.text: _____________ did, being a person under the age of eighteen, to wit: (STATE DOB OF OFFENDER), knowingly gave false information concerning offender’s age or other false identification, to wit: (DESCRIBE FALSE INFORMATION), for the purpose of gaining entrance to an adult entertainment establishment, to wit: (NAME OF ESTABLISHMENT), in violation of Section 2907.39(C) of the Ohio Revised Code, a delinquent act that would be a misdemeanor of the fourth degree if committed by an adult.

ORC:2907.40.heading: ILLEGALLY OPERATING A SEXUALLY ORIENTED BUSINESS 2907.40(B) ORC
ORC:2907.40.variant: NOT A LIQUOR PERMIT HOLDER – M1
ORC:2907.40.text: (NAME AND ADDRESS OF SEXUALLY ORIENTED BUSINESS), a sexually oriented business that is a(n) (adult bookstore, adult video store, adult cabaret, adult motion picture theater, sexual device shop, or sexual encounter center), and which does not hold a liquor permit pursuant to Chapter 4303 of the Revised Code, was or remained open for business between 12:00 midnight and 6:00 am, to wit: (STATE DATE AND TIME BUSINESS WAS OPEN), in violation of Section 2907.40(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2907.40.heading: ILLEGALLY OPERATING A SEXUALLY ORIENTED BUSINESS 2907.40(B) ORC
ORC:2907.40.variant: LIQUOR PERMIT HOLDER – OPEN AFTER CLOSING HOUR SPECIFIED IN LIQUOR PERMIT – M1
ORC:2907.40.text: (NAME AND ADDRESS OF SEXUALLY ORIENTED BUSINESS), a sexually oriented business that is a(n) (adult bookstore, adult video store, adult cabaret, adult motion picture theater, sexual device shop, or sexual encounter center), and which holds a liquor permit pursuant to Chapter 4303 of the Revised Code, was or remained open for business after the hour specified in the liquor permit held by the business, to wit: (STATE TIME ON LIQUOR PERMIT THAT BUSINESS MAY REMAIN OPEN, AND DATE AND TIME BUSINESS WAS OPEN), in violation of Section 2907.40(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2907.40.heading: ILLEGALLY OPERATING A SEXUALLY ORIENTED BUSINESS 2907.40(B) ORC
ORC:2907.40.variant: LIQUOR PERMIT HOLDER – EMPLOYEES APPEAR NUDE – M1
ORC:2907.40.text: (NAME AND ADDRESS OF SEXUALLY ORIENTED BUSINESS), a sexually oriented business that is a(n) (adult bookstore, adult video store, adult cabaret, adult motion picture theater, sexual device shop, or sexual encounter center), was or remained open for business until the hour specified in the liquor permit held by the business pursuant to Chapter 4303 of the Revised Code, which was between 12:00 midnight and 6:00 am, to wit: (STATE PERMIT CLOSING HOUR), and during the time between 12:00 midnight and (STATE PERMIT CLOSING HOUR), conducted, offered, or allowed sexually oriented entertainment activity in which the performers appeared nude, to wit: (DESCRIBE SEXUALLY ORIENTED ENTERTAINMENT ACTIVITY, SPECIFY THE PERFORMER’S STATE OF NUDITY, AND STATE THE DATE AND TIME THE ACTIVITY OCCURRED), in violation of Section 2907.40(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2907.40.heading: ILLEGAL SEXUALLY ORIENTED ACTIVITY IN A SEXUALLY ORIENTED BUSINESS 2907.40(C)(1) ORC
ORC:2907.40.text: _____________, a patron at a(n) (adult bookstore, adult video store, adult cabaret, adult motion picture theater, sexual device shop, or sexual encounter center) , to wit: (STATE NAME AND ADDRESS OF BUSINESS); who is not a member of the employee’s immediate family; did knowingly (touch or touch the clothing of) an employee of said sexually oriented business, to wit: (STATE NAME OF EMPLOYEE), while said employee was nude or seminude, to wit: (DESCRIBE STATE OF NUDITY AND DESCRIBE TOUCHING AND ANATOMICAL AREA THAT WAS TOUCHED), in violation of Section 2907.40(C)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.
ORC:2907.40.notes: NOTE: Illegal Sexually Oriented Activity in a Sexually Oriented Business is an M1 if the offender touches a specified anatomical area of the patron or employee, or the clothing covering a specified anatomical area. “Specified anatomical area” includes human genitals, pubic region, buttocks, and “the human female breast below a point immediately above the top of the areola”. When enhancing to an M1, you must state the specified anatomical area that was touched.

ORC:2907.40.heading: ILLEGAL SEXUALLY ORIENTED ACTIVITY IN A SEXUALLY ORIENTED BUSINESS 2907.40(C)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.40.text: _____________, an employee who regularly appears nude or seminude on the premises of a(n) (adult bookstore, adult video store, adult cabaret, adult motion picture theater, sexual device shop, or sexual encounter center) , to wit: (STATE NAME AND ADDRESS OF BUSINESS); while on the premises of said sexually oriented business, to wit: (STATE LOCATION ON PREMISES), and while nude or seminude, to wit: (DESCRIBE STATE OF NUDITY); did knowingly touch (a patron/another employee) who is not a member of the employee’s immediate family, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PATRON/OTHER EMPLOYEE), to wit: (DESCRIBE TOUCHING AND ANATOMICAL AREA THAT WAS TOUCHED), in violation of Section 2907.40(C)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.
ORC:2907.40.notes: NOTE: Illegal Sexually Oriented Activity in a Sexually Oriented Business is an M1 if the offender touches a specified anatomical area of the patron or employee, or the clothing covering a specified anatomical area. “Specified anatomical area” includes human genitals, pubic region, buttocks, and “the human female breast below a point immediately above the top of the areola”. When enhancing to an M1, you must state the specified anatomical area that was touched.

ORC:2907.40.heading: ILLEGAL SEXUALLY ORIENTED ACTIVITY IN A SEXUALLY ORIENTED BUSINESS 2907.40(C)(2) ORC
ORC:2907.40.variant: EMPLOYEE ALLOWS PATRON/OTHER EMPLOYEE TO TOUCH EMPLOYEE – M4
ORC:2907.40.text: _____________, an employee who regularly appears nude or seminude on the premises of a(n) (adult bookstore, adult video store, adult cabaret, adult motion picture theater, sexual device shop, or sexual encounter center) , to wit: (STATE NAME AND ADDRESS OF BUSINESS); while on the premises of said sexually oriented business, to wit: (STATE LOCATION ON PREMISES), and while nude or seminude, to wit: (DESCRIBE STATE OF NUDITY); did knowingly allow (a patron/another employee) who is not a member of the employee’s immediate family, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PATRON/OTHER EMPLOYEE) to (touch or touch the clothing of) the employee, to wit: (DESCRIBE TOUCHING AND ANATOMICAL AREA THAT WAS TOUCHED), in violation of Section 2907.40(C)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.
ORC:2907.40.notes: NOTE: Illegal Sexually Oriented Activity in a Sexually Oriented Business is an M1 if the offender touches a specified anatomical area of the patron or employee, or the clothing covering a specified anatomical area. “Specified anatomical area” includes human genitals, pubic region, buttocks, and “the human female breast below a point immediately above the top of the areola”. When enhancing to an M1, you must state the specified anatomical area that was touched.

ORC:2909.02.heading: AGGRAVATED ARSON 2909.02(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2909.02.variant: RISK OF SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM – F1
ORC:2909.02.text: _____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion), knowingly create a substantial risk of serious physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to a person, to wit: (NAME PERSON, OTHER THAN THE OFFENDER), in violation of Section 2909.02(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2909.02.heading: AGGRAVATED ARSON 2909.02(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2909.02.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO OCCUPIED STRUCTURE – F2
ORC:2909.02.text: _____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion), knowingly cause physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to an occupied structure, to wit: (TYPE OF STRUCTURE AND ADDRESS), in violation of Section 2909.02(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.

ORC:2909.02.heading: AGGRAVATED ARSON 2909.02(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2909.02.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO AN OCCUPIED STRUCTURE BY CONTRACT – F1
ORC:2909.02.text: _____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion), knowingly cause physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT), to an occupied structure, to wit: (DESCRIBE STRUCTURE, STATE ADDRESS), through the (offer or acceptance) of an agreement for hire (or other consideration) to wit: (DESCRIBE AGREEMENT), in violation of Section 2909.02(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2909.03.heading: ARSON 2909.03(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2909.03.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO PROPERTY – VALUE $1,000.00 OR MORE – F4
ORC:2909.03.text: _____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion), knowingly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to property of another, without said owner’s consent, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE PROPERTY AND ITS VALUE, STATE ADDRESS AND OWNER’S NAME), in violation of Section 2909.03(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2909.03.heading: ARSON 2909.03(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2909.03.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO PROPERTY – VALUE LESS THAN $1,000.00 – M1
ORC:2909.03.text: _____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion), knowingly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to property of another, without said owner’s consent, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE PROPERTY AND ITS VALUE, STATE ADDRESS AND OWNER’S NAME), in violation of Section 2909.03(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2909.03.heading: ARSON 2909.03(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2909.03.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO PROPERTY WITH PURPOSE TO DEFRAUD – F4
ORC:2909.03.text: _____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion), knowingly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to property of the offender or the property of another, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE PROPERTY, STATE ADDRESS AND OFFENDER’S OR OWNER’S NAME), with purpose to defraud, to wit: (DESCRIBE FRAUD), in violation of Section 2909.03(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2909.03.heading: ARSON 2909.03(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2909.03.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO STATEHOUSE, SCHOOLHOUSE & ETC. – F4
ORC:2909.03.text: _____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion), knowingly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to (choose one: the statehouse, a courthouse, school building, or other building/structure owned or controlled by the State, any political subdivision, department, agency, that is used for public purposes), to wit: (SPECIFICALLY IDENTIFY BUILDING, STATE NAME AND LOCATION OF STRUCTURE, IF NECESSARY IDENTIFY PUBLIC USE), in violation of Section 2909.03(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2909.03.heading: ARSON 2909.03(A)(4) ORC
ORC:2909.03.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO PROPERTY OF ANOTHER BY CONTRACT – F3
ORC:2909.03.text: _____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion), knowingly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to property of another without said owner’s consent, to wit: (DESCRIBE PROPERTY AND NAME OWNER) through the (offer or acceptance) of an agreement for hire (or other consideration); to wit: (DESCRIBE AGREEMENT); in violation of Section 2909.03(A)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2909.03.heading: ARSON 2909.03(A)(4) ORC
ORC:2909.03.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO PROPERTY OF OFFENDER BY CONTRACT TO DEFRAUD – F3
ORC:2909.03.text: _____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion), knowingly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to property of the offender, to wit: (DESCRIBE PROPERTY), through the (offer or acceptance) of an agreement for hire (or other consideration); to wit: (DESCRIBE AGREEMENT); with purpose to defraud, to wit: (DESCRIBE FRAUD) in violation of Section 2909.03(A)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2909.03.heading: ARSON 2909.03(A)(5) ORC
ORC:2909.03.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO PARK LANDS & ETC. – F4
ORC:2909.03.text: _____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion), knowingly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to (choose one: a park, preserve, wildland, brush-covered land, cut-over land, forest, timberland, greenlands, woods, or similar property) that is (owned or controlled) by (another person, the State, or a political subdivision), to wit: (STATE OWNER/CONTROLLER’S NAME, IDENTIFY PROPERTY, GIVE LOCATION, ADDRESS) without consent of said other person (entity) in violation of Section 2909.03(A)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2909.03.heading: ARSON 2909.03(A)(6) ORC
ORC:2909.03.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO PARK LAND & ETC. WITH PURPOSE TO DEFRAUD – F4
ORC:2909.03.text: _____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion), knowingly, with purpose to defraud, to wit: (DESCRIBE FRAUD) (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to (choose one: a park, preserve, wildland, brush-covered land, cut-over land, forest, timberland, greenlands, woods, or similar property) to wit: (DESCRIBE, TYPE AND LOCATION OF PROPERTY) that is (owned or controlled) by the (offender, another person, the State or a political subdivision), to wit: (STATE OWNER/CONTROLLER’S NAME) in violation of Section 2909.03(A)(6) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2909.03.heading: ARSON 2909.03(B)(1) ORC
ORC:2909.03.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO UNOCCUPIED STRUCTURE – VALUE LESS THAN $1,000.00 – M1
ORC:2909.03.text: _____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion), knowingly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to the structure of another that is not an occupied structure, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE STRUCTURE AND ITS VALUE; STATE ADDRESS AND OWNER’S NAME), in violation of Section 2909.03(B)(1), a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2909.03.notes: NOTE: It is an affirmative defense to a charge under this section that the defendant acted with the consent of the other person.

ORC:2909.03.heading: ARSON 2909.03(B)(1) ORC
ORC:2909.03.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO UNOCCUPIED STRUCTURE – VALUE $1,000.00 OR MORE – F4
ORC:2909.03.text: _____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion), knowingly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to the structure of another that is not an occupied structure, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE STRUCTURE AND ITS VALUE; STATE ADDRESS AND OWNER’S NAME), in violation of Section 2909.03(B)(1), a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2909.03.notes: NOTE: It is an affirmative defense to a charge under this section that the defendant acted with the consent of the other person.

ORC:2909.03.heading: ARSON 2909.03(B)(2) ORC
ORC:2909.03.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO UNOCCUPIED STRUCTURE THROUGH AGREEMENT FOR HIRE – F3
ORC:2909.03.text: ____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion) knowingly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to the structure of another that is not an occupied structure, to wit: (DESCRIBE OWNER AND ADDRESS OF STRUCTURE), through the (offer or acceptance) of an agreement for (hire or other consideration), to wit: (DESCRIBE AGREEMENT), in violation of Section 2909.03(B)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2909.03.notes: NOTE: It is an affirmative defense to a charge under this section that the defendant acted with the consent of the other person.

ORC:2909.03.heading: ARSON 2909.03(B)(3) ORC
ORC:2909.03.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO UNOCCUPIED STRUCTURE IN PARK LANDS & ETC. – F4
ORC:2909.03.text: ____________ did, by means of (fire or explosion) knowingly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT) to the structure of another that is not an occupied structure, to wit: (DESCRIBE OWNER AND STRUCTURE) and that is (in or on) any (CHOOSE ONE: park, preserve, wildlands, brush-covered land, cut-over land, forest, timberland, greenlands, woods, or similar real property) that is (owned or controlled) by (another person, the state or a political subdivision), to wit: (STATE OWNER/CONTROLLER’S NAME, IDENTIFY PROPERTY, GIVE LOCATION, ADDRESS), in violation of Section 2909.03(B)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2909.03.notes: NOTE: It is an affirmative defense to a charge under this section that the defendant acted with the consent of the other person, the state, or the political subdivision.

ORC:2909.04.heading: DISRUPTING PUBLIC SERVICES 2909.04(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2909.04.variant: PURPOSELY IMPAIR EMERGENCY, PUBLIC SERVICE OR MASS COMMUNICATIONS – F4
ORC:2909.04.text: _____________ did, by any means, to wit: (DESCRIBE MEANS), purposely (interrupt or impair) (CHOOSE CORRECT MEDIUM: television, radio, telephone, telegraph, or other mass communication; police, fire or other public service communications, or radar, loran, radio, or other electronic aids to air or marine navigation or communication; or amateur or citizen band radio communications being used for public service or emergency communications) in violation of Section 2909.04(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2909.04.heading: DISRUPTING PUBLIC SERVICES 2909.04(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2909.04.variant: KNOWINGLY DAMAGE PROPERTY TO IMPAIR OR INTERRUPT EMERGENCY, PUBLIC SERVICE OR MASS COMMUNICATIONS – F4
ORC:2909.04.text: _____________ did, knowingly (damage or tamper with) property, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT AND PROPERTY), to (interrupt or impair) (CHOOSE CORRECT MEDIUM: television, radio, telephone, telegraph, or other mass communication; police, fire or other public service communications, or radar, loran, radio, or other electronic aids to air or marine navigation or communication; or amateur or citizen band radio communications being used for public service or emergency communications) in violation of Section 2909.04(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2909.04.heading: DISRUPTING PUBLIC SERVICES 2909.04(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2909.04.variant: KNOWINGLY DAMAGE PROPERTY TO IMPAIR OR INTERRUPT PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION – F4
ORC:2909.04.text: _____________ did, knowingly (damage or tamper with) property, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT AND PROPERTY), to (interrupt or impair) Public (Transportation or service), to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF TRANSPORTATION OR SERVICE; this includes but is not limited to school bus, or water, gas, electric or other public utility service ) in violation of Section 2909.04(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2909.04.heading: DISRUPTING PUBLIC SERVICES 2909.04(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2909.04.variant: PURPOSELY IMPAIR OR INTERRUPT PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION – F4
ORC:2909.04.text: _____________ did, by any means, to wit: (DESCRIBE MEANS), purposely (interrupt or impair) Public (Transportation or service), to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF TRANSPORTATION OR SERVICE; this includes but is not limited to school bus, or water, gas, electric or other public utility service ) in violation of Section 2909.04(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2909.04.heading: DISRUPTING PUBLIC SERVICE 2909.04(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2909.04.variant: PURPOSELY IMPAIR LAW ENFORCEMENT, EMERGENCY PERSONNEL – F4
ORC:2909.04.text: _____________ did, by any means, to wit: (DESCRIBE MEANS), purposely substantially impair the ability of (CHOOSE ONE: law enforcement officers, firefighters, rescue personnel, emergency medical services personnel, or emergency facility personnel), to wit: (NAME PERSONNEL) to respond to an emergency, to wit: (DESCRIBE EMERGENCY) in violation of Section 2909.04(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2909.04.notes: NOTE: “Emergency medical services personnel” has the same meaning as in Section 2133.21 of the Ohio Revised Code. NOTE: “Emergency facility personnel” means any of the following: – Any of the following individuals who perform services in the ordinary course of their professions in an emergency facility: – Physicians authorized under Chapter 4731 of the Ohio Revised Code to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery; – Registered nurses and licensed practical nurses licensed under Chapter 4723 of the Ohio Revised Code; – Physician assistants authorized to practice under Chapter 4730 of the Ohio Revised Code; – Health care workers; – Clerical staffs. – Any individual who is a security officer performing security services in an emergency facility; – Any individual who is present in an emergency facility, who was summoned to the facility by any “emergency facility personnel” described above. NOTE: “Emergency facility” means a hospital emergency department or any other facility that provides emergency medical services. NOTE: “Hospital” has the same meaning as in Section 3727.01 of the Ohio Revised Code. NOTE: “Health care worker” means an individual, other than an “emergency facility personnel” described above, who provides medical or other health-related care or treatment in an emergency facility, including medical technicians, medical assistants, orderlies, aides, or individuals acting in similar capacities.

ORC:2909.04.heading: DISRUPTING PUBLIC SERVICE 2909.04(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2909.04.variant: KNOWINGLY DAMAGE PROPERTY TO IMPAIR LAW ENFORCEMENT, EMERGENCY PERSONNEL – F4
ORC:2909.04.text: _____________ did, knowingly (damage or tamper with) property, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT AND PROPERTY), to substantially impair the ability of (CHOOSE ONE: law enforcement officers, firefighter, rescue personnel, emergency medical services personnel, or emergency facility personnel), to wit: (NAME PERSONNEL) to respond to an emergency, to wit: (DESCRIBE EMERGENCY) in violation of Section 2909.04(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2909.04.notes: NOTE: “Emergency medical services personnel” has the same meaning as in Section 2133.21 of the Ohio Revised Code. NOTE: “Emergency facility personnel” means any of the following: – Any of the following individuals who perform services in the ordinary course of their professions in an emergency facility: – Physicians authorized under Chapter 4731 of the Ohio Revised Code to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery; – Registered nurses and licensed practical nurses licensed under Chapter 4723 of the Ohio Revised Code; – Physician assistants authorized to practice under Chapter 4730 of the Ohio Revised Code; – Health care workers; – Clerical staffs. – Any individual who is a security officer performing security services in an emergency facility; – Any individual who is present in an emergency facility, who was summoned to the facility by any “emergency facility personnel” described above. NOTE: “Emergency facility” means a hospital emergency department or any other facility that provides emergency medical services. NOTE: “Hospital” has the same meaning as in Section 3727.01 of the Ohio Revised Code. NOTE: “Health care worker” means an individual, other than an “emergency facility personnel” described above, who provides medical or other health-related care or treatment in an emergency facility, including medical technicians, medical assistants, orderlies, aides, or individuals acting in similar capacities.

ORC:2909.04.heading: DISRUPTING PUBLIC SERVICE 2909.04(B) ORC
ORC:2909.04.variant: KNOWINGLY USE ELECTRONIC DEVICE TO DISRUPT, INTERRUPT, OR IMPAIR FUNCTIONS – F4
ORC:2909.04.text: _____________ did knowingly use any (computer, computer system, computer network, telecommunications device, other electronic device or system, or the internet) so as to (disrupt, interrupt, or impair) the functions of any (police, fire, educational, commercial, or governmental) operations, to wit: (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2909.04(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2909.05.heading: VANDALISM 2909.05(A) ORC
ORC:2909.05.variant: SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO OCCUPIED STRUCTURE OR CONTENTS LESS THAN $7,500.00– F5
ORC:2909.05.text: _____________ did knowingly cause serious physical harm to (an occupied structure or the contents of an occupied structure), to wit: (DESCRIBE PHYSICAL HARM; THE STRUCTURE INCLUDING LOCATION, AND THE CONTENTS IF APPLICABLE) and the (value of the property or amount of physical harm) was less than $7,500.00 in violation of Section 2909.05(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2909.05.heading: VANDALISM 2909.05(B)(1)(a) ORC
ORC:2909.05.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO PROPERTY USED BY OWNER FOR PROFESSIONAL, BUSINESS, TRADE OR OCCUPATION – F5
ORC:2909.05.text: _____________ did knowingly cause physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE HARM), to the property of another, to wit: (STATE OWNER OR POSSESSOR’S NAME), when the property is used by the owner/possessor’s (professional or business or trade or occupation) and the value of the property or the amount of physical harm involved is $1,000.00 or more, to wit: (STATE VALUE), in violation of Section 2909.05(B)(1)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2909.05.heading: VANDALISM 2909.05(B)(1)(b) ORC
ORC:2909.05.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO PROPERTY NECESSARY TO ENGAGE IN PROFESSION, BUSINESS, TRADE OR OCCUPATION – F5
ORC:2909.05.text: _____________ did knowingly cause physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE HARM), to the property of another, to wit: (STATE OWNER OR POSSESSOR’S NAME), when the property is necessary in order for its owner or possessor to engage in the owner or possessor’s (profession or business or trade or occupation), to wit: (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2909.05(B)(1)(b) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2909.05.heading: VANDALISM 2909.05(B)(2) ORC
ORC:2909.05.variant: SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO PROPERTY BY A GOVERNMENTAL ENTITY – F5
ORC:2909.05.text: _____________ did knowingly cause serious physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE HARM TO PROPERTY), that is (owned or leased or controlled) by a governmental entity, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE GOVERNMENTAL ENTITY), in violation of Section 2909.05(B)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2909.05.heading: VANDALISM 2909.05(C) ORC
ORC:2909.05.variant: SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM TO ANY CEMETERY PROPERTY – F5
ORC:2909.05.text: _____________ did knowingly, without privilege to do so, cause serious physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE HARM), to any (tomb or monument or gravestone or other similar structure used as a memorial for the dead or fence or railing or curb or other property that is used to protect, enclose, or ornament any cemetery or cemetery), to wit: (DESCRIBE VANDALIZED PROPERTY), in violation of Section 2909.05(C) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2909.05.heading: VANDALISM 2909.05(D) ORC
ORC:2909.05.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO ANY MEMORIAL USED FOR THE DEAD – F5
ORC:2909.05.text: _____________ did knowingly, without privilege to do so, cause physical harm, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE HARM), to any place of burial by breaking and entering into a (tomb or crypt or casket or other structure that is used as a memorial for the dead or as an enclosure for the dead), to wit: (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2909.05(D) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2909.06.heading: CRIMINAL DAMAGING OR ENDANGERING 2909.06(A)(1) ORC (CCC 2309.06)
ORC:2909.06.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO ANOTHER’S PROPERTY – M2
ORC:2909.06.text: _____________ did knowingly (cause or create substantial risk of) physical harm to property to wit: (DESCRIBE PHYSICAL HARM AND PROPERTY) of another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF OWNER OR POSSESSOR), without (his or her) consent, in violation of Section 2909.06(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.

ORC:2909.06.heading: CRIMINAL DAMAGING OR ENDANGERING 2909.06(A)(1) ORC (CCC 2309.06)
ORC:2909.06.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO ANOTHER’S PROPERTY AND RISK OF HARM TO PERSON – M1
ORC:2909.06.text: _____________ did knowingly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm to property to wit: (DESCRIBE PHYSICAL HARM AND PROPERTY) of another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF OWNER OR POSSESSOR), without (his or her) consent, and having created a risk of physical harm to a person, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON AND DESCRIBE RISK OR HARM), in violation of Section 2909.06(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2909.06.heading: CRIMINAL DAMAGING OR ENDANGERING 2909.06(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2909.06.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO AN AIRCRAFT AND RISK OF HARM TO PERSON – F5
ORC:2909.06.text: _____________ did knowingly (cause or create a risk of) physical harm to property, to wit: (DESCRIBE PHYSICAL HARM AND THE AIRCRAFT, AIRCRAFT ENGINE, PROPELLER, APPLIANCE, SPARE PART, OR OTHER IMPLEMENT USED IN THE OPERATION OF AN AIRCRAFT) of another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF OWNER OR POSSESSOR), without (his or her) consent, and having created a risk of physical harm to a person, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON AND DESCRIBE RISK OR HARM), in violation of Section 2909.06(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2909.06.heading: CRIMINAL DAMAGING OR ENDANGERING 2909.06(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2909.06.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO AN AIRCRAFT AND SUBSTANTIAL RISK OF HARM TO PERSON – F4
ORC:2909.06.text: _____________ did knowingly (cause or create a risk of) physical harm to an aircraft, to wit: (DESCRIBE PHYSICAL HARM AND THE AIRCRAFT, AIRCRAFT ENGINE, PROPELLER, APPLIANCE, SPARE PART, OR OTHER IMPLEMENT USED IN THE OPERATION OF AN AIRCRAFT) of another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF OWNER OR POSSESSOR), without (his or her) consent, and having created a substantial risk of physical harm to a person, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON AND DESCRIBE SUBSTANTIAL RISK OR HARM), in violation of Section 2909.06(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2909.06.heading: CRIMINAL DAMAGING OR ENDANGERING 2909.06(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2909.06.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO AN OCCUPIED AIRCRAFT – F4
ORC:2909.06.text: _____________ did knowingly (cause or create a risk of) physical harm to property, to wit: (DESCRIBE PHYSICAL HARM) to an occupied aircraft of another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF OWNER OR POSSESSOR), without (his or her) consent, in violation of Section 2909.06(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree

ORC:2909.06.heading: CRIMINAL DAMAGING OR ENDANGERING 2909.06(A)(2) ORC (CCC 2309.06)
ORC:2909.06.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO ANOTHER’S PROPERTY BY DANGEROUS AGENCY – M2
ORC:2909.06.text: _____________ did recklessly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm to property, to wit: (DESCRIBE PROPERTY), of another to wit: (NAME OWNER OR POSSESSOR), without (his or her) consent, by means of (fire or explosion or flood or poison gas or poison or radioactive material or caustic material or corrosive material or an inherently dangerous agency or an inherently dangerous substance), to wit: (DESCRIBE SITUATION OF PHYSICAL HARM AND SUBSTANCE OR AGENCY INVOLVED), in violation of Section 2909.06(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.

ORC:2909.06.heading: CRIMINAL DAMAGING OR ENDANGERING 2909.06(A)(2) ORC (CCC 2309.06)
ORC:2909.06.variant: PHYSICAL HARM TO ANOTHER’S PROPERTY BY DANGEROUS AGENCY AND RISK OF HARM TO PERSON – M1
ORC:2909.06.text: _____________ did recklessly (cause or create a substantial risk of) physical harm to property to wit: (DESCRIBE PROPERTY) of another, to wit: (NAME OF OWNER OR POSSESSOR), without (his or her) consent, by means of (fire or explosion or flood or poison gas or poison or radioactive material or caustic material or corrosive material or an inherently dangerous agency or an inherently dangerous substance), to wit: (DESCRIBE SITUATION OF PHYSICAL HARM AND SUBSTANCE OR AGENCY INVOLVED), and having created a risk of physical harm to a person, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON AND DESCRIBE RISK OF HARM), in violation of Section 2909.06(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(1)(a) ORC (CCC 2309.07(A)(1))
ORC:2909.07.variant: TAMPERING WITH PROPERTY OF ANOTHER – M3
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, without privilege to do so, knowingly (move or deface or damage or destroy or improperly tamper with) the property of another, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE PROPERTY, WHAT WAS DONE AND STATE NAME OF OWNER OR POSSESSOR), in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(1)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(1)(a) ORC ((CCC 2309.07(A)(1))
ORC:2909.07.variant: TAMPERING WITH ANOTHER’S PROPERTY AND RISK OF HARM TO ANOTHER – M1
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, without privilege to do so, knowingly (move or deface or damage or destroy or improperly tamper with) the property of another, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE PROPERTY, WHAT WAS DONE AND STATE NAME OF OWNER OR POSSESSOR), and having created a risk of physical harm to another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON AND DESCRIBE HOW ENDANGERED), in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(1)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(1)(b) ORC
ORC:2909.07.variant: TAMPERING WITH RESIDENTIAL REAL PROPERTY TO DECREASE VALUE OR ENJOYMENT WITH COMPLAINT PENDING – M3
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, without privilege to do so, knowingly (move or deface or damage or destroy or improperly tamper with) one’s own residential real property, to wit: (DESCRIBE REAL PROPERTY AND STATE ADDRESS AND OWNER) by means of (STATE WHAT WAS DONE TO PROPERTY) with the purpose to decrease the value of or the enjoyment of the residential real property, and when the real property is subject to a mortgage and the person has been served with a summons and complaint in a pending residential mortgage loan foreclosure action relating to that real property, in (STATE COURT NAME AND CASE NUMBER OF COMPLAINT AND DATE SERVED), in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(1)(b) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.
ORC:2909.07.notes: NOTE: “Pending” includes the time between judgment entry and confirmation of sale.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(1)(b) ORC
ORC:2909.07.variant: TAMPERING WITH RESIDENTIAL REAL PROPERTY TO DECREASE VALUE OR ENJOYMENT WITH COMPLAINT PENDING AND CREATING RISK OF HARM TO ANOTHER – M1
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, without privilege to do so, knowingly (move or deface or damage or destroy or improperly tamper with) one’s own residential real property, to wit: (DESCRIBE REAL PROPERTY AND STATE ADDRESS AND OWNER) by means of (STATE WHAT WAS DONE TO PROPERTY) with the purpose to decrease the value of or the enjoyment of the residential real property, and when the real property is subject to a mortgage and the person has been served with a summons and complaint in a pending residential mortgage loan foreclosure action relating to that real property, in (STATE COURT NAME AND CASE NUMBER OF COMPLAINT AND DATE SERVED), and having created a risk of physical harm to another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON AND DESCRIBE HOW ENDANGERED) in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(1)(b) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2909.07.notes: NOTE: “Pending” includes the time between judgment entry and confirmation of sale.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(2) ORC (CCC 2309.07)
ORC:2909.07.variant: INTERFERE WITH ANOTHER’S PROPERTY BY EMPLOYING GAS AGENT – M3
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, with purpose to interfere with the (use or enjoyment) of property, to wit: (DESCRIBE PROPERTY), of another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF OWNER), employ (a tear gas device, or stink bomb or smoke generator or a device releasing a substance which is harmful to persons exposed or a device releasing a substance which is offensive to persons exposed or a device releasing a substance which tends to cause public alarm), to wit: (DESCRIBE WHAT WAS DONE AND THE DEVICE), in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(2) ORC (CCC 2309.07)
ORC:2909.07.variant: INTERFERE WITH ANOTHER’S PROPERTY BY EMPLOYING GAS AGENT AND RISK OF HARM TO ANOTHER – M1
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, with purpose to interfere with the (use or enjoyment) of property, to wit: (DESCRIBE PROPERTY), of another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF OWNER), employ (a tear gas device, or stink bomb or smoke generator or a device releasing a substance which is harmful to persons exposed or a device releasing a substance which is offensive to persons exposed or a device releasing a substance which tends to cause public alarm), to wit: (DESCRIBE WHAT WAS DONE AND THE DEVICE), and having created a risk of physical harm to another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON AND DESCRIBE HOW ENDANGERED), in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(3) ORC (CCC 2309.07)
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, without privilege to do so, knowingly (move or deface or damage or destroy or improperly tamper with) a (bench mark or triangulation station or boundary marker or survey station or survey monument or survey marker), to wit: (DESCRIBE ITEM WHAT WAS DONE AND THE LOCATION), in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(3) ORC (CCC 2309.07)
ORC:2909.07.variant: TAMPER WITH MARKER AND RISK OF HARM TO ANOTHER – M1
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, without privilege to do so, knowingly (move or deface or damage or destroy or improperly tamper with) a (bench mark or triangulation station or boundary marker or survey station or survey monument or survey marker), to wit: (DESCRIBE ITEM WHAT WAS DONE AND THE LOCATION), and having created a risk of physical harm to another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON AND DESCRIBE HOW ENDANGERED), in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(4) ORC (CCC 2309.07)
ORC:2909.07.variant: TAMPER WITH SAFETY DEVICE AND RISK OF HARM TO ANOTHER – M1
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, without privilege to do so, knowingly (move or deface or damage or destroy or improperly tamper with) a safety device, to wit: (DESCRIBE DEVICE), (being the property of another or being (his or her) property which was required or placed for the safety of others), so as to (destroy or diminish) the device’s (effectiveness or availability) for its intended purpose, to wit: (DESCRIBE WHAT WAS DONE), and having created a risk of physical harm to another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON AND DESCRIBE HOW ENDANGERED), in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2909.07.notes: NOTE: A safety device is defined as: fire extinguisher, fire house, or fire ax, or any fire escape, emergency exit, or emergency escape equipment, or any life line, life-saving ring, life preserver, or life boat or raft, or any alarm, light, flare, signal, sign, or notice intended to warn of danger or emergency, or intended for other safety purposes, or any guard railing or safety barricade, or any traffic sign or signal, or any railroad grade crossing sign, signal, or gate, or any first aid or survival equipment, or any other device, apparatus, or equipment intended for protecting or preserving the safety of persons or property.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(5) ORC (CCC 2309.07)
ORC:2909.07.variant: INTERFERE WITH USE OF PROPERTY BY SETTING FIRE ON ANOTHER’S LAND – M3
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, with purpose to interfere with the (use or enjoyment) of the property of another, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE PROPERTY AND NAME OF OWNER OR POSSESSOR), (set a fire or place personal property that is on fire) on the land of the other person, to wit: (DESCRIBE LOCATION OF LAND), and in a location outside and apart from any building, structure, or personal property on the said land, to wit: (DESCRIBE FIRE AND PLACEMENT ON THE LAND), in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(5) ORC (CCC 2309.07)
ORC:2909.07.variant: INTERFERE WITH USE OF PROPERTY BY SETTING FIRE ON ANOTHER’S LAND AND RISK OF HARM TO ANOTHER – M1
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, with purpose to interfere with the (use or enjoyment of the property of another, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE PROPERTY AND NAME OF OWNER OR POSSESSOR), (set a fire or place personal property that is on fire on the land of the other person, to wit: (DESCRIBE LOCATION OF LAND), and in a location outside and apart from any building, structure personal property on the said land, to wit: (DESCRIBE FIRE AND PLACEMENT ON THE LAND), and having created a risk of physical harm to another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON AND DESCRIBE HOW ENDANGERED), in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(6) ORC
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, without privilege to do so, and with intent to impair the functioning of any (computer, computer system, computer network, computer software, or computer program), to wit: (DESCRIBE), (alter, damage, destroy, or modify) said (computer, computer system, computer network, computer software, or computer program; or data contained in a computer, computer system, computer network, computer software, or computer program), to wit: (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(6) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(6) ORC
ORC:2909.07.variant: IMPAIR FUNCTION OF COMPUTER – VALUE OF COMPUTER
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, without privilege to do so, and with intent to impair the functioning of any (computer, computer system, computer network, computer software, or computer program), to wit: (DESCRIBE), valued at (STATE VALUE), (alter, damage, destroy, or modify) said (computer, computer system, computer network, computer software, or computer program; or data contained in a computer, computer system, computer network, computer software, or computer program), to wit: (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2909.07(A) (6) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(6) ORC
ORC:2909.07.variant: IMPAIR FUNCTION OF COMPUTER – LOSS TO VICTIM
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, without privilege to do so, and with intent to impair the functioning of any (computer, computer system, computer network, computer software, or computer program), to wit: (DESCRIBE), (alter, damage, destroy, or modify) said (computer, computer system, computer network, computer software, or computer program; or data contained in a computer, computer system, computer network, computer software, or computer program), to wit: (DESCRIBE), which caused a loss of (STATE LOSS) to the victim, to wit: (NAME VICTIM), in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(6) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(6) ORC
ORC:2909.07.variant: IMPAIR FUNCTION OF COMPUTER BY INTRODUCING CONTAMINANT – M1
ORC:2909.07.text: _____________ did, without privilege to do so, and with intent to impair the functioning of any (computer, computer system, computer network, computer software, or computer program), to wit: (DESCRIBE), introduce a computer contaminant into said (computer, computer system, computer network, computer software, or computer program), to wit: (DESCRIBE), in violation of Section 2909.07(A)(6) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2909.07.heading: CRIMINAL MISCHIEF 2909.07(A)(6) ORC
ORC:2909.07.variant: IMPAIR FUNCTION OF COMPUTER BY INTRODUCING CONTAMINANT – VALUE OF COMPUTER
