ORC:2909.23.notes: NOTE: It is not a defense to a charge of a violation of this section that the defendant did not have the intent or capability to commit the threatened specified offense or that the threat was not made to a person who was a subject of the threatened specified offense.

ORC:2909.23.heading: MAKING TERRORISTIC THREAT 2909.23(A)(1)(b) ORC
ORC:2909.23.variant: INFLUENCE THE POLICY OF ANY GOVERNMENT BY INTIMIDATION OR COERCION – F3
ORC:2909.23.text: _____________ did threaten (to commit or cause to be committed) a specified offense, to wit: (STATE SPECIFIED OFFENSE AND VICTIM) when the person made the threat with purpose to influence the policy of any government by intimidation or coercion, to wit: (STATE GOVERNMENT ENTITY/POLICY AND DESCRIBE THREAT) and as a result of the threat, did cause a reasonable expectation of fear of the imminent commission of the specified offense, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 2909.23(A)(1) (b) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2909.23.notes: NOTE: It is not a defense to a charge of a violation of this section that the defendant did not have the intent or capability to commit the threatened specified offense or that the threat was not made to a person who was a subject of the threatened specified offense.

ORC:2909.23.heading: MAKING TERRORISTIC THREAT 2909.23(A)(1)(c) ORC
ORC:2909.23.variant: AFFECT THE CONDUCT OF ANY GOVERNMENT BY THE THREAT OR SPECIFIED OFFENSE – F3
ORC:2909.23.text: _____________ did threaten (to commit or cause to be committed) a specified offense, to wit: (STATE SPECIFIED OFFENSE AND VICTIM) when the person made the threat with purpose to affect the conduct of any government, to wit: (STATE GOVERNMENT ENTITY/CONDUCT AND DESCRIBE THREAT) and as a result of the threat, did cause a reasonable expectation of fear of the imminent commission of the specified offense, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 2909.23(A)(1)(c) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2909.23.notes: NOTE: It is not a defense to a charge of a violation of this section that the defendant did not have the intent or capability to commit the threatened specified offense or that the threat was not made to a person who was a subject of the threatened specified offense.

CCC:2309.27.heading: GRAFFITISM 2309.27(A) CCC
CCC:2309.27.text: _____________ did, without privilege to do so, commit graffitism, to wit (describe) upon any (public or private, real, or personal property), to wit: (describe) in violation of Section 2309.27(A) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2309.27.heading: GRAFFITISM 2309.27(B) CCC
CCC:2309.27.variant: RETAILER FAIL TO DISPLAY WARNING – MM
CCC:2309.27.text: _____________ did, while operating a retail commercial establishment that sells spray paint or wide-tipped markers, to wit (describe location), fail to place a sign in clear public view at or near the display of such products that states: “Graffiti application is against the law. Any person who defaces real or personal property with paint or any other liquid or device is guilty of a crime punishable by imprisonment for up to six months and/or a fine of up to $1000.00” in bold dark letters each at least one (1) inch high on a white background, in violation of Section 2309.27(B) of the Columbus City Code, a minor misdemeanor.

CCC:2309.28.heading: SELLING OR FURNISHING SPRAY PAINT OR WIDE-TIPPED MARKERS TO A MINOR 2309.28(A) CCC
CCC:2309.28.text: _____________ , a (person or firm or corporation), did sell (spray paint or a wide-tipped marker) that is capable of defacing property, to wit: (DESCRIBE PAINT OR MARKER), to a person who is under the age of 18 years, to wit: (NAME AND DOB), in violation of Section 2309.28(A) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
CCC:2309.28.notes: NOTE: This section does not apply if the person, firm or corporation obtained a document evidencing age and identity of an individual issued by a federal, state or local governmental entity, including, but not limited to, a motor vehicle operator’s license, a registration certificate issued under the federal Selective Service Act, or an identification card issued to a member of the armed services.

CCC:2309.28.heading: SELLING OR FURNISHING SPRAY PAINT OR WIDE-TIPPED MARKERS TO A MINOR 2309.28(B) CCC
CCC:2309.28.variant: FURNISH OR GIVE TO MINOR – M1
CCC:2309.28.text: _____________ , a (person or firm or corporation), did (furnish or give) (spray paint or a wide-tipped marker) that is capable of defacing property, to wit: (DESCRIBE PAINT OR MARKER), to a person who is under the age of 18 years, to wit: (NAME AND DOB), in violation of Section 2309.28(B) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
CCC:2309.28.notes: NOTE: This section does not apply if the person, firm or corporation obtained a document evidencing age and identity of an individual issued by a federal, state or local governmental entity, including, but not limited to, a motor vehicle operator’s license, a registration certificate issued under the federal Selective Service Act, or an identification card issued to a member of the armed services. NOTE: This section does not apply to the furnishing of spray paint or wide-tipped markers to a minor for the minor’s use or possession while engaged in a lawful activity under the supervision and control of the minor’s parent, guardian, teacher or employer. NOTE: This section does not apply to spray paint, wide-tipped markers or related substances furnished for use in school-related activities as part of the instructional program when used under the control and supervision of a teacher, instructor or other adult supervisor for such activities, either within the classroom or on the site of a supervised project. These materials shall be inventoried by the teacher, instructor, or adult supervisor upon completion of the activity or project.

CCC:2309.28.heading: SELLING OR FURNISHING SPRAY PAINT AND WIDE-TIPPED MARKERS TO MINORS PROHIBITED 2309.28(E) CCC
CCC:2309.28.text: _____________ , a retail business within the city of Columbus that sells or offers for sale (spray paint or wide-tipped markers), to wit: (DESCRIBE PAINT OR MARKERS), did fail to post the notice required by 2309.28 in a conspicuous area near such spray paint or markers, in violation of Section 2309.28(E) of the Columbus City Code, a minor misdemeanor.

CCC:2309.30.heading: UNLAWFUL PURCHASE OR POSSESSION OF SPRAY PAINT OR A WIDE-TIPPED MARKER 2309.30(A) CCC
CCC:2309.30.text: _____________ , a person under the age of 18 years, to wit: (DOB), did purchase (spray paint or a wide-tipped marker) that is capable of defacing property, to wit: (DESCRIBE PAINT OR MARKER), in violation of Section 2309.30(A) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2309.30.heading: UNLAWFUL PURCHASE OR POSSESSION OF SPRAY PAINT OR A WIDE-TIPPED MARKER 2309.30(B) CCC
CCC:2309.30.text: _____________ , a person under the age of eighteen 18, to wit: (DOB), did (possess or to have under (his or her) control) (spray paint or a wide-tipped marker) that is capable of defacing property, to wit: (DESCRIBE PAINT OR MARKER), in violation of Section 2309.30(B) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
CCC:2309.30.notes: NOTE: This section does not apply to the possession of spray paint or a wide-tipped marker by a person under the age of 18 for the minor’s use or possession while engaged in a lawful activity under the supervision and control of the minor’s parent, guardian, teacher or employer. NOTE: This section does not apply to the possession of spray paint or a wide-tipped marker by a person under the age of 18 for use in school-related activities as part of the instructional program when used under the control and supervision of a teacher, instructor or other adult supervisor for such activities, either within the classroom or on the site of a supervised project. These materials shall be inventoried by the teacher, instructor, or adult supervisor upon completion of the activity or project.

CCC:2309.30.heading: UNLAWFUL PURCHASE OR POSSESSION OF SPRAY PAINT OR A WIDE-TIPPED MARKER 2309.30(C) CCC
CCC:2309.30.variant: POSSESSION BY MINOR WITH PURPOSE TO DEFACE PROPERTY – M1
CCC:2309.30.text: _____________ , a person under the age of 18, to wit: (DOB), did (possess or to have under (his or her) control) (spray paint or a wide-tipped marker) with purpose to deface property while in a public place, to wit: (DESCRIBE PUBLIC PLACE AND CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 2309.30(C) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2911.01.heading: AGGRAVATED ROBBERY 2911.01(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2911.01.text: _____________ did while (committing or attempting to commit or in fleeing immediately after committing or in fleeing immediately after attempting to commit ) a theft offense, to wit: (STATE THE SPECIFIC THEFT OFFENSE AND SECTION NUMBER) have a deadly weapon (on his or her person or about his or her person or under his or her control) and (displayed said weapon or brandished said weapon or indicated said weapon’s possession by the offender or used said weapon), to wit: (DESCRIBE DEADLY WEAPON), in violation of Section 2911.01(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2911.01.heading: AGGRAVATED ROBBERY 2911.01(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2911.01.text: _____________ did while (committing or attempting to commit or in fleeing immediately after committing or in fleeing immediately after attempting to commit ) a theft offense, to wit: (STATE THE SPECIFIC THEFT OFFENSE AND SECTION NUMBER) have a dangerous ordnance (on his or her person or about his or her person or under his or her control) to wit: (DESCRIBE DANGEROUS ORDNANCE), in violation of Section 2911.01(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2911.01.heading: AGGRAVATED ROBBERY 2911.01(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2911.01.variant: THEFT WITH SERIOUS PHYSICAL HARM – F1
ORC:2911.01.text: _____________ did, while (committing or attempting to commit or in fleeing immediately after committing or in fleeing immediately after attempting to commit ) a theft offense, to wit: (STATE THE SPECIFIC THEFT OFFENSE AND SECTION NUMBER) (inflict or attempt to inflict) serious physical harm to another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE HARM CAUSED OR ATTEMPTED), in violation of Section 2911.01(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2911.01.heading: AGGRAVATED ROBBERY 2911.01(B) ORC
ORC:2911.01.variant: REMOVE/DEPRIVE DEADLY WEAPON FROM A KNOWN LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER – F1
ORC:2911.01.text: _____________ did knowingly, without privilege to do so, (remove or attempt to remove or deprive or attempt to deprive) a deadly weapon from the person of a law enforcement officer, to wit: (VICTIM’S NAME) while the law enforcement officer is acting within the course and scope of the officer’s duties, (STATE SPECIFICS OF OCCURRENCE), and the offender knows or has reasonable cause to know that the law enforcement officer is a law enforcement officer, in violation of Section 2911.01(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2911.02.heading: ROBBERY 2911.02(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2911.02.variant: THEFT WITH POSSESSION OF WEAPON OR DANGEROUS ORDNANCE – F2
ORC:2911.02.text: _____________ did while (committing or attempting to commit or in fleeing immediately after committing or in fleeing immediately after attempting to commit ) a theft offense, to wit: (STATE THE SPECIFIC THEFT OFFENSE AND SECTION NUMBER) have a( deadly weapon or dangerous ordnance) (on his or her person or about his or her person or under his or her control), to wit: (DESCRIBE DEADLY WEAPON OR DANGEROUS ORDNANCE), in violation of Section 2911.02(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.

ORC:2911.02.heading: ROBBERY 2911.02(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2911.02.text: _____________ did, while (committing or attempting to commit or in fleeing immediately after committing or in fleeing immediately after attempting to commit ) a theft offense, to wit: (STATE THE SPECIFIC THEFT OFFENSE AND SECTION NUMBER) (inflict or attempt to inflict or threaten to inflict) physical harm to another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE HARM CAUSED, ATTEMPTED OR THREATENED), in violation of Section 2911.02(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.

ORC:2911.02.heading: ROBBERY 2911.02(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2911.02.variant: THEFT WITH USE OF FORCE – F3
ORC:2911.02.text: _____________ did, while (committing or attempting to commit or in fleeing immediately after committing or in fleeing immediately after attempting to commit ) a theft offense, to wit: (STATE THE SPECIFIC THEFT OFFENSE AND SECTION NUMBER) (use or threaten the use of) force against another, to wit: (STATE VICTIM’S NAME AND DESCRIBE FORCE USED, OR THREATENED), in violation of Section 2911.02(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2911.11.heading: AGGRAVATED BURGLARY 2911.11(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2911.11.variant: TRESPASS IN OCCUPIED STRUCTURE WITH PERSON PRESENT FOR COMMISSION OF CRIMINAL ACT AND PHYSICAL HARM TO ANOTHER – F1
ORC:2911.11.text: _____________ did, by (force or stealth or deception) trespass in (an occupied structure or a separately secured portion of an occupied structure or in a separately occupied portion of an occupied structure), to wit: (DESCRIBE TRESPASS AND THE TYPE OF STRUCTURE INCLUDING ADDRESS) when another person is present, to wit: (STATE NAME), with purpose to commit therein a criminal offense, to wit: (STATE THE OFFENSE AND SECTION NUMBER) and (inflicts or attempts to inflict or threatens to inflict) physical harm on another, to wit: (DESCRIBE HARM OR THREAT AND STATE NAME OF PERSON) , in violation of Section 2911.11(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2911.11.heading: AGGRAVATED BURGLARY 2911.11(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2911.11.variant: TRESPASS IN OCCUPIED STRUCTURE WITH PERSON PRESENT FOR COMMISSION OF CRIMINAL ACT WITH A WEAPON OR DANGEROUS ORDNANCE – F1
ORC:2911.11.text: _____________ did, by (force or stealth or deception) trespass in (an occupied structure or a separately secured portion of an occupied structure or in a separately occupied portion of an occupied structure), to wit: (DESCRIBE TRESPASS AND THE TYPE OF STRUCTURE INCLUDING ADDRESS) when another person is present, to wit: (STATE NAME), with purpose to commit therein a criminal offense, to wit: (STATE THE OFFENSE AND SECTION NUMBER) and has a (deadly weapon or dangerous ordnance) (on offender’s person or about offender’s person or under the offender’s control), to wit: (DESCRIBE DEADLY WEAPON OR DANGEROUS ORDNANCE AND TYPE OF CONTROL), in violation of Section 2911.11(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the first degree.

ORC:2911.12.heading: BURGLARY 2911.12(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2911.12.variant: TRESPASS IN OCCUPIED STRUCTURE WITH PURPOSE TO COMMIT ANY CRIMINAL OFFENSE – F2
ORC:2911.12.text: _____________ did, by (force or stealth or deception), trespass in (an occupied structure or in a separately secured or separately occupied portion of an occupied structure), to wit: (DESCRIBE TRESPASS AND THE TYPE OF STRUCTURE INCLUDING ADDRESS), when another person other than an accomplice of the offender is present, to wit: (STATE NAME), with purpose to commit in the structure or in the separately secured or separately occupied portion of the structure any criminal offense, to wit: (STATE OFFENSE AND SECTION), in violation of Section 2911.12(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.

ORC:2911.12.heading: BURGLARY 2911.12(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2911.12.variant: TRESPASS IN PERMANENT OR TEMPORARY HABITATION TO COMMIT ANY CRIMINAL OFFENSE – F2
ORC:2911.12.text: _____________ did, by (force or stealth or deception), trespass in (an occupied structure or in a separately secured or separately occupied portion of an occupied structure) that is a permanent or temporary habitation of any person, to wit: (DESCRIBE TRESPASS AND TYPE OF STRUCTURE INCLUDING ADDRESS AND OWNERSHIP), when any person other than an accomplice of the offender is present or likely to be present, to wit: (NAME PERSON), with purpose to commit in the habitation any criminal offense, to wit: (STATE OFFENSE AND SECTION), in violation of Section 2911.12(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the second degree.

ORC:2911.12.heading: BURGLARY 2911.12(A)(3) ORC
ORC:2911.12.variant: TRESPASS IN OCCUPIED STRUCTURE WITH PURPOSE TO COMMIT ANY FELONY – F3
ORC:2911.12.text: _____________ did, by (force or stealth or deception), trespass in (an occupied structure or in a separately secured or separately occupied portion of an occupied structure), to wit: (DESCRIBE TRESPASS AND TYPE OF STRUCTURE INCLUDING ADDRESS), with purpose to commit in the structure or separately secured or separately occupied portion of the structure any criminal offense, to wit: (STATE OFFENSE AND SECTION), in violation of Section 2911.12(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.

ORC:2911.12.heading: BURGLARY 2911.12(B) ORC
ORC:2911.12.variant: TRESPASS IN A PERMANENT OR TEMPORARY HABITATION WITH PERSON PRESENT OR LIKELY TO BE PRESENT – F4
ORC:2911.12.text: _____________ did, by (force or stealth or deception), trespass in a permanent or temporary habitation of any person, to wit: (DESCRIBE TRESPASS AND STRUCTURE INCLUDING OWNERSHIP AND ADDRESS), when any person other than an accomplice of the offender is present or likely to be present, to wit: (STATE NAME), in violation of Section 2911.12(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2911.13.heading: BREAKING AND ENTERING 2911.13(A) ORC
ORC:2911.13.variant: TRESPASS IN AN UNOCCUPIED STRUCTURE – F5
ORC:2911.13.text: _____________ did, by (force, stealth, or deception), trespass in an unoccupied structure, to wit: (DESCRIBE TRESPASS AND STATE TYPE OF STRUCTURE INCLUDING ADDRESS AND OWNER), with the purpose to commit therein any theft offense or any felony, to wit: (STATE THE OFFENSE AND SECTION NUMBER), in violation of Section 2911.13(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2911.13.heading: BREAKING AND ENTERING 2911.13(B) ORC
ORC:2911.13.variant: TRESPASS ON ANOTHER’S LAND FOR FELONY – F5
ORC:2911.13.text: _____________ did, trespass upon the (land or premises) of another, to wit: (DESCRIBE TRESPASS, STATE NAME AND ADDRESS), with the purpose to commit a felony, to wit: (STATE THE SPECIFIC OFFENSE AND SECTION NUMBER), in violation of Section 2911.13(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:2911.21.heading: CRIMINAL TRESPASS 2911.21(A)(1) ORC (CCC 2311.21)
ORC:2911.21.variant: ENTER OR REMAIN ON ANOTHER’S PREMISES – M4
ORC:2911.21.text: _____________ did, without privilege, knowingly (enter or remain) on the (land or premises), to wit: (STATE LOCATION), of another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF POSSESSOR), in violation of Section 2911.21(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.
ORC:2911.21.notes: NOTE: See definition of “land premises” listed in Section 2911.21(F)(2).

ORC:2911.21.heading: CRIMINAL TRESPASS 2911.21(A)(2) ORC (CCC 2311.21)
ORC:2911.21.variant: ENTER OR REMAIN ON ANOTHER’S PREMISES WHICH ARE RESTRICTED – M4
ORC:2911.21.text: _____________ did, without privilege, knowingly (enter or remain) on the (land or premises), to wit: (STATE LOCATION), of another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF POSSESSOR), when the use of the said (land or premises) was lawfully restricted to certain (persons or purposes or modes, or hours), to wit: (STATE THE RESTRICTIONS), and he (knew he was in violation of the said restrictions or was reckless with regard to knowing that he was in violation of the said restrictions), to wit: (DESCRIBE KNOWLEDGE), in violation of Section 2911.21(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.
ORC:2911.21.notes: NOTE: See definition of “land premises” listed in Section 2911.21(F)(2).

ORC:2911.21.heading: CRIMINAL TRESPASS 2911.21(A)(3) ORC (CCC 2311.21)
ORC:2911.21.variant: ENTER OR REMAIN ON ANOTHER’S PREMISES WHERE UNAUTHORIZED NOTICE IS COMMUNICATED – M4
ORC:2911.21.text: _____________ did, without privilege, recklessly (enter or remain) on the (land or premises), to wit: (STATE LOCATION), of another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF POSSESSOR), where notice against unauthorized (access or presence) (was actually communicated to him or was communicated in a manner prescribed by law or was communicated by posting such notice in a manner reasonably calculated to come to the attention of intruders or was communicated by fencing or was communicated by an enclosure designed to restrict access), to wit: (STATE THE TYPE OF NOTICE GIVEN AND DESCRIBE THE WAY IT WAS COMMUNICATED), in violation of Section 2911.21(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.
ORC:2911.21.notes: NOTE: See definition of “land premises” listed in Section 2911.21(F)(2).

ORC:2911.21.heading: CRIMINAL TRESPASS 2911.21(A)(4) ORC
ORC:2911.21.variant: REFUSE TO LEAVE ANOTHER’S PREMISES UPON NOTIFICATION – M4
ORC:2911.21.text: _____________ did, without privilege, while being on the (land or premises), to wit: (STATE LOCATION), of another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF POSSESSOR) negligently (fail or refuse) to leave upon being notified to do so by the (signage posted in a conspicuous place or upon being notified by the owner or occupant or agent of the owner or agent of the occupant or servant of the owner or servant of the occupant), to wit: (DESCRIBE THE SIGNAGE POSTED IN A CONSPICUOUS PLACE OR STATE NAME OF PERSON GIVING NOTIFICATION, (HIS OR HER) TITLE AND NOTIFICATION GIVEN), in violation of Section 2911.21(A)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.
ORC:2911.21.notes: NOTE: As used in the trespass section, “LAND AND PREMISES” includes any land, building, structure, or place belonging to, controlled by, or in custody of another, and any separate enclosure or room, or portion thereof, including those owned, controlled or in custody of a public agency. NOTE: Also, it is not a defense to a trespass charge that the offender was authorized to enter or remain on the land or premises, when the authorization was secured by deception. NOTE: Because of the difference in penalties between the City and State Code, if the defendant is an organization, it is recommended that the above State Code be used for Criminal Trespass. NOTE: Signage posted in a conspicuous place constitutes sufficient notice of being told to leave the land or premises. If a person has a handgun, and also has a concealed carry license, and they are on private property, which is conspicuously posted with no concealed carry signage, the proper charge is criminal trespass, unless it is one of the prohibited places listed in 2923.126(B) (see notes for 2923.12(A) for the list of prohibited places). If a person is in one of the prohibited places listed in 2923.126(B), and the person has a concealed handgun, then the proper charge is CCW.

ORC:2911.21.heading: CRIMINAL TRESPASS 2911.21(A)(5) ORC
ORC:2911.21.variant: KNOWINGLY ENTER/REMAIN ON CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE FACILITY – M1
ORC:2911.21.text: _____________ did, without privilege, knowingly (enter or remain) on the (land or premises), to wit: (STATE LOCATION) of another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF POSSESSOR), which is a critical infrastructure facility defined in Sections 2911.21(F)(4)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE PROPERTY; INDICATE THE TYPE OF CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE INVOLVED), in violation of Section 2911.21 (A)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2911.21.notes: NOTE: “Critical infrastructure” has the same meaning as defined in ORC 2911.21(F)(4).

ORC:2911.211.heading: AGGRAVATED TRESPASS 2911.211(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2911.211.variant: CAUSE PHYSICAL HARM TO ANOTHER – M1
ORC:2911.211.text: _____________ did, (enter or remain) on the (land or premises) to wit: (STATE LOCATION) of another, to wit: (STATE NAME) with purpose to commit on that (land or premise) a misdemeanor, to wit: (STATE OFFENSE AND SECTION NUMBER), the elements of which involve causing physical harm to another, to wit: (NAME PERSON AND DESCRIBE HARM), in violation of Section 2911.211(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2911.211.heading: AGGRAVATED TRESPASS 2911.211(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2911.211.variant: CAUSE BELIEF OF PHYSICAL HARM TO ANOTHER – M1
ORC:2911.211.text: _____________ did, (enter or remain) on the (land or premises) to wit: (STATE LOCATION) of another, to wit: (STATE NAME), with purpose to commit on that (land or premises) a misdemeanor, to wit: (STATE OFFENSE AND SECTION NUMBER), the elements of which involve causing another person to believe that the offender, to with: (STATE NAME AND REASON FOR BELIEF), would cause physical harm to said victim, in violation of Section 2911.211(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2909.211.heading: AGGRAVATED TRESPASS 2909.211(A)(2) ORC
ORC:2909.211.variant: ENTER/REMAIN ON CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE FACILITY – F3
ORC:2909.211.text: _____________ did, (enter or remain) on the (land or premises) to wit: (STATE LOCATION) of another, to wit: (STATE NAME), which is a critical infrastructure facility defined in Section 2911.21(F)(4)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, with purpose to destroy or tamper with the facility, to wit: (NAME PERSON AND DESCRIBE ACTION), in violation of Section 2911.211(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the third degree.
ORC:2909.211.notes: NOTE: “Critical infrastructure” has the same meaning as defined in ORC 2911.21(F)(4).

ORC:2911.23.heading: CRIMINAL TRESPASS 2911.23(A) ORC
ORC:2911.23.text: _____________ did without privilege, knowingly (enter or remain) on any restricted portion of a place of public amusement, to wit: (STATE LOCATION AND TYPE OF AMUSEMENT AND/OR EVENT TAKING PLACE) of another, to wit: (STATE NAME OF POSSESSOR) and, as a result of that conduct, (interrupt or cause the delay of) the (live performance, sporting event, or other activity) taking place at the place of public amusement, to wit: (DESCRIBE CONDUCT), where notice is given that the general public is restricted from access to a portion of a place of public amusement by the (signage posted in a conspicuous place or exhibited at the entrance to that portion or upon being notified by the owner or occupant or agent of the owner or agent of the occupant or servant of the owner or servant of the occupant), to wit: (DESCRIBE THE SIGNAGE POSTED IN A CONSPICUOUS PLACE OR STATE NAME OF PERSON GIVING NOTIFICATION, (HIS OR HER) TITLE AND NOTIFICATION GIVEN), in violation of Section 2911.23 of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:2911.23.notes: NOTE: As used in this section, “PLACE OF PUBLIC AMUSEMENT” includes a stadium, theater, or other facility, whether licensed or not, at which a live performance, sporting event, or other activity takes place for entertainment of the public and to which access is made available to the public, regardless of whether admission is charged.

ORC:2911.31.heading: SAFECRACKING 2911.31 ORC
ORC:2911.31.text: _____________ did with purpose to commit an offense, to wit: (DESCRIBE OFFENSE), knowingly (enter or force an entrance into or tamper with) a (vault or safe or strongbox), to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES AND LOCATION), in violation of Section 2911.31 of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.

ORC:2911.32.heading: TAMPERING WITH COIN MACHINES 2911.32 ORC
ORC:2911.32.text: _____________ did with purpose to (commit theft or defraud), knowingly (enter or force an entrance into or tramper with or insert any part of an instrument into) a coin machine, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES, INCLUDING LOCATION OF COIN MACHINE AND IF APPLICABLE TYPE OF INSTRUMENT USED), in violation of Section 2911.32 of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:2911.32.heading: TAMPERING WITH COIN MACHINES 2911.32 ORC
ORC:2911.32.text: _____________ did with purpose to (commit theft or defraud), knowingly (enter or force an entrance into or tramper with or insert any part of an instrument into) a coin machine, to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES, INCLUDING LOCATION OF COIN MACHINE AND IF APPLICABLE TYPE OF INSTRUMENT USED), having been previously convicted of (a violation of this section or any theft offense), to wit: (STATE VIOLATION, SECTION NUMBER, DATE, CASE NUMBER AND COURT OF PREVIOUS CONVICTION), in violation of Section 2911.32 of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

CCC:4707.07.heading: RE-OCCUPANCY OF A PLACARDED STRUCTURE 4707.07 CCC
CCC:4707.07.text: _____________ did (use or use for human habitation), to wit: (DESCRIBE USE), a building or structure which has been vacated and declared and posted as unfit for human habitation or use or found to be vacant and declared a hazardous building pursuant to Columbus City Code 4709.03 or a public nuisance pursuant to Columbus City Code 4701.08, to wit: (DESCRIBE PROPERTY, ADDRESS AND DATE OF PLACARD, in violation of Section 4707.07 of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:4707.07.heading: TAMPERING OR REMOVING PLACARD 4707.07 CCC

ORC:2913.02.heading: THEFT 2913.02(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2913.02.variant: WITHOUT OWNER’S CONSENT – PROPERTY VALUE
ORC:2913.02.text: _____________ did, with purpose to deprive the owner, to wit: (STATE THE OWNER’S NAME), of (property or services) valued at (STATE AMOUNT), knowingly (obtain or exert) control over (DESCRIBE THE PROPERTY OR SERVICES), without the consent of (the owner or the person authorized to give consent), to wit: (STATE PERSON’S NAME), in violation of Section 2913.02(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code:
ORC:2913.02.notes: – VALUE LESS THAN $1,000.00, Misdemeanor theft, a misdemeanor of the first degree. ORC:2913.02.heading: THEFT OF DRUGS 2913.02(A)(1) ORC
ORC:2913.02.variant: WITHOUT OWNER’S CONSENT – F4
ORC:2913.02.text: _____________ did, with purpose to deprive the owner, to wit: (STATE THE OWNER’S NAME), of a dangerous drug, knowingly (obtain or exert) control over (NAME OF DANGEROUS DRUG) without the consent of the (owner or person authorized to give consent), to wit: (STATE PERSON’S NAME), in violation of Section 2913.02(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fourth degree.
ORC:2913.02.notes: NOTE: “Dangerous drug” means any of the following: (1) Any drug to which either of the following applies: (a) Under the “Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act,” 52 Stat. 1040 (1938), 21 U.S.C.A. 301, as amended, the drug is required to bear a label containing the legend “Caution: Federal law prohibits dispensing without prescription” or “Caution: Federal law restricts this drug to use by or on the order of a licensed veterinarian” or any similar restrictive statement, or the drug may be dispensed only upon a prescription; (b) Under Chapter 3715. or 3719. of the Revised Code, the drug may be dispensed only upon a prescription. (2) Any drug that contains a schedule V controlled substance and that is exempt from Chapter 3719. of the Revised Code or to which that chapter does not apply; (3) Any drug intended for administration by injection into the human body other than through a natural orifice of the human body.

ORC:2913.02.notes: NOTE: “Dangerous drug” means any of the following: (1) Any drug to which either of the following applies: (a) Under the “Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act,” 52 Stat. 1040 (1938), 21 U.S.C.A. 301, as amended, the drug is required to bear a label containing the legend “Caution: Federal law prohibits dispensing without prescription” or “Caution: Federal law restricts this drug to use by or on the order of a licensed veterinarian” or any similar restrictive statement, or the drug may be dispensed only upon a prescription; (b) Under Chapter 3715. or 3719. of the Revised Code, the drug may be dispensed only upon a prescription. (2) Any drug that contains a schedule V controlled substance and that is exempt from Chapter 3719. of the Revised Code or to which that chapter does not apply; (3) Any drug intended for administration by injection into the human body other than through a natural orifice of the human body.
