Outdoor gatherings, public dances, shows, sporting events, concerts, entertainment events, and other temporary events that may emanate noise in violation of this chapter, provided these events are conducted pursuant to a permit or license issued by the License Section of the Department of Building and Zoning Services or the Special Events Section of the Department of Recreation and Parks. 4. Public works projects as authorized by the state and/or other political subdivisions. 5. The emission of sound that is periodically generated by activities required to maintain the property in compliance with housing, building, zoning, fire, safety, health or sanitation codes and which occurs between the hours of 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.

CCC:2329.11.heading: COMMUNITY NOISE 2329.11(C)(2)(c) CCC
CCC:2329.11.text: _____________ did, between the hours of 10:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m., operate or permit the operation of a (sound amplification system, auditory device, or stationary sound source) from a non-residential property in a manner as to be audible at the property line of a residential unit that is 100 feet or more beyond the property line from which the sound emanates, to wit: (DESCRIBE VIOLATION, INCLUDING DEVICE, PROPERTY ADDRESS, AND DISTANCE INTO ADJOINING PROPERTY), in violation of Section 2329.11(C)(2)(c) of the Columbus City Code, a minor misdemeanor.
CCC:2329.11.notes: NOTE: See definitions listed at end of Section 2329.11. NOTE: This section does not apply to the following: 1. The emission of sound for the purpose of alerting persons to the existence of an emergency, or the emission of sound in the performance of emergency work. 2. Warning devices necessary for the protection of public safety. 3. Outdoor gatherings, public dances, shows, sporting events, concerts, entertainment events, and other temporary events that may emanate noise in violation of this chapter, provided these events are conducted pursuant to a permit or license issued by the License Section of the Department of Building and Zoning Services or the Special Events Section of the Department of Recreation and Parks. 4. Public works projects as authorized by the state and/or other political subdivisions. 5. The emission of sound that is periodically generated by activities required to maintain the property in compliance with housing, building, zoning, fire, safety, health or sanitation codes and which occurs between the hours of 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.

CCC:2329.11.heading: COMMUNITY NOISE 2329.11(C)(2)(c) CCC
CCC:2329.11.variant: PROHIBITED SOUND – NON-RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY – PRIOR WARNING WITHIN 12 HOURS – M4
CCC:2329.11.text: _____________ between the hours of 10:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m., operate or permit the operation of a (sound amplification system, auditory device, or stationary sound source) from a non-residential property in a manner as to be audible at the property line of a residential unit that is 100 feet or more beyond the property line from which the sound emanates, to wit: (DESCRIBE VIOLATION, INCLUDING DEVICE, PROPERTY ADDRESS, AND DISTANCE INTO ADJOINING PROPERTY), and did persist in operating or permitting the operation of a sound amplification system, auditory device, or stationary sound source in violation of Columbus City Code 2329.11(C)(2) after receiving a reasonable warning or request to desist within the prior 12 hours, to wit: (DESCRIBE WHO GAVE THE WARNING/REQUEST TO DESIST, IN WHAT MANNER THE WARNING WAS GIVEN AND AT WHAT TIME IT WAS GIVEN), in violation of Section 2329.11(C)(2)(c) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.
CCC:2329.11.notes: NOTE: See definitions listed at end of Section 2329.11. NOTE: This section does not apply to the following: 1. The emission of sound for the purpose of alerting persons to the existence of an emergency, or the emission of sound in the performance of emergency work. 2. Warning devices necessary for the protection of public safety. 3. Outdoor gatherings, public dances, shows, sporting events, concerts, entertainment events, and other temporary events that may emanate noise in violation of this chapter, provided these events are conducted pursuant to a permit or license issued by the License Section of the Department of Building and Zoning Services or the Special Events Section of the Department of Recreation and Parks. 4. Public works projects as authorized by the state and/or other political subdivisions. 5. The emission of sound that is periodically generated by activities required to maintain the property in compliance with housing, building, zoning, fire, safety, health or sanitation codes and which occurs between the hours of 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.

CCC:2329.11.heading: COMMUNITY NOISE 2329.11(C)(2)(c) CCC
CCC:2329.11.variant: PROHIBITED SOUND – NON-RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY – PREVIOUS CONVICTION – M4
CCC:2329.11.text: _____________ between the hours of 10:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m., operate or permit the operation of a (sound amplification system, auditory device, or stationary sound source) from a non-residential property in a manner as to be audible at the property line of a residential unit that is 100 feet or more beyond the property line from which the sound emanates, to wit: (DESCRIBE VIOLATION, INCLUDING DEVICE, PROPERTY ADDRESS, AND DISTANCE INTO ADJOINING PROPERTY), and having been previously convicted of violating Columbus City Code 2329.11, to wit: (PRIOR CASE NUMBER, NAME OF COURT, AND DATE OF CONVICTION), in violation of Section 2329.11(C) (2)(c) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.
CCC:2329.11.notes: NOTE: See definitions listed at end of Section 2329.11. NOTE: This section does not apply to the following: 1. The emission of sound for the purpose of alerting persons to the existence of an emergency, or the emission of sound in the performance of emergency work. 2. Warning devices necessary for the protection of public safety. 3. Outdoor gatherings, public dances, shows, sporting events, concerts, entertainment events, and other temporary events that may emanate noise in violation of this chapter, provided these events are conducted pursuant to a permit or license issued by the License Section of the Department of Building and Zoning Services or the Special Events Section of the Department of Recreation and Parks. 4. Public works projects as authorized by the state and/or other political subdivisions. 5. The emission of sound that is periodically generated by activities required to maintain the property in compliance with housing, building, zoning, fire, safety, health or sanitation codes and which occurs between the hours of 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. DEFINITIONS 2329.11 CCC AUDITORY DEVICE – Any device that can be used to create a sound that can be heard. DEVICE – Any system or machine devised or constructed to perform one or more tasks. EMERGENCY WORK – Any work performed for the purpose of preventing or alleviating the physical trauma or property damage threatened or caused by an emergency. LOUD OR RAUCOUS NOISE – Any noise or sound that emanates in such manners and/ or volume and is of such intensity, character and duration to be offensive or disturbing to a person of ordinary sensibilities. MACHINE – Any system or device together with its power source and auxiliary equipment used to accomplish a specific objective. NON-RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY – Any area zoned or utilized for purposes other than residential including, but not limited to, commercial, manufacturing, and institutional. PERSON – Any public corporation, private corporation, individual, firm, partnership, association or other entity. PROPERTY LINE – The line along the ground surface, and its vertical extension, which separates the real property owned, rented, leased or occupied by one or more persons from that owned, rented, leased or occupied by another person and the imaginary line which represents the legal limits of property of any person who owns, rents, leases, or otherwise occupies an apartment, condominium, hotel or motel room or any other type of residential unit. RESIDENTIAL UNIT – a single unit providing complete, independent living facilities for one or more persons, including permanent provisions for living, sleeping, eating, cooking, and sanitation including, but not limited to, any residential units located within Planned Unit Development Districts, Planned Community Districts, or any other area zoned for mixed use. SOUND AMPLIFICATION SYSTEM – Any device used for the amplification of the human voice, music, or other sound and includes, but is not limited to, any radio, tape player, compact disc player or loud speaker. STATIONARY SOUND SOURCE – A machine or device capable of creating a noise level at the property upon which it is regularly located, including, but not limited to standing motor vehicles, industrial and commercial process machinery and equipment, pumps, fans, air-conditioning apparatus or refrigeration machines. WARNING DEVICE – Any device, which signals an unsafe or potentially dangerous situation.

ORC:4513.361.heading: FALSE INFORMATION TO A POLICE OFFICER 4513.361(A) ORC
ORC:4513.361.text: _____________ did knowingly (present/display/orally communicate) a false (name, DOB, SSN), to wit: (STATE FALSE INFORMATION), to a law enforcement officer, to wit: (NAME AND BADGE), who was in the process of issuing said person a traffic ticket or complaint for (STATE OFFENSE), in violation of Section 4513.361(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:959.15.heading: ANIMAL FIGHTS 959.15(A)(1) ORC
ORC:959.15.variant: ENGAGE IN COCKFIGHTING, BEAR-BAITING, ETC. – M4
ORC:959.15.text: ___________ did knowingly engage in (cockfighting, bear-baiting, or pitting an animal against another), to wit: (DESCRIBE ANIMALS AND CIRCUMSTANCES OF DEFENDANT’S CONDUCT), in violation of Section 959.15(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.

ORC:959.15.heading: ANIMAL FIGHTS 959.15(A)(2) ORC
ORC:959.15.variant: USE, TRAIN, OR POSSESS ANIMAL FOR MALTREATMENT – M4
ORC:959.15.text: ___________ did knowingly (use, train, or possess) any animal for (seizing, detaining, or maltreating) a domestic animal, to wit: (DESCRIBE ANIMAL AND CIRCUMSTANCES OF DEFENDANT’S CONDUCT), in violation of Section 959.15(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.

ORC:959.15.heading: ANIMAL FIGHTS 959.15(B)(1) ORC
ORC:959.15.variant: EMPLOYED AT COCKFIGHTING, BEAR-BAITING, ETC. – FELONY OFFENSE
ORC:959.15.text: ___________ did knowingly be employed at (cockfighting, bear-baiting, or pitting an animal against another), to wit: (DESCRIBE EMPLOYER/ EMPLOYEE, ANIMAL INVOLVED AND CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 959.15(B)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony offense.
ORC:959.15.notes: NOTE: Defendant shall be fined not more than $10,000 for violation of this section.

ORC:959.15.heading: ANIMAL FIGHTS 959.15(B)(2)(a) ORC
ORC:959.15.variant: WAGER MONEY ON COCKFIGHTING, ETC. – FELONY OFFENSE
ORC:959.15.text: __________ did knowingly, regarding an event involving (cockfighting, bear-baiting, or pitting an animal against another), to wit: (DESCRIBE ANIMAL AND EVENT), wager (money or anything else of value) on the results of the event, to wit: (DESCRIBE WAGER), in violation of Section 959.15(B)(2)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony offense.
ORC:959.15.notes: NOTE: Defendant shall be fined not more than $10,000 for violation of this section.

ORC:959.15.heading: ANIMAL FIGHTS 959.15(B)(2)(b) ORC
ORC:959.15.variant: PAY MONEY FOR ADMISSION OR PRESENCE AT COCKFIGHTING EVENT – FELONY OFFENSE
ORC:959.15.text: __________ did knowingly, regarding an event involving (cockfighting, bear-baiting, or pitting an animal against another), to wit: (DESCRIBE ANIMAL AND EVENT), (pay money or give anything else of value) in exchange for (admission to or being present at the event), to wit: (DESCRIBE PAYMENT AND CIRCUMSTANCES INVOLVED), in violation of Section 959.15(B)(2)(b) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony offense.
ORC:959.15.notes: NOTE: Defendant shall be fined not more than $10,000 for violation of this section.

ORC:959.15.heading: ANIMAL FIGHTS 959.15(B)(2)(c) ORC
ORC:959.15.variant: RECEIVE MONEY FOR ANOTHER PERSON’S PRESENCE AT EVENT – FELONY OFFENSE
ORC:959.15.text: __________ did knowingly, regarding an event involving (cockfighting, bear-baiting, or pitting an animal against another), to wit: (DESCRIBE ANIMAL AND EVENT), receive (money or anything else of value) in exchange for the (admission of another person to the event or for another person to be present at the event), to wit: (DESCRIBE PAYMENT AND CIRCUMSTANCES INVOLVED), in violation of Section 959.15(B)(2)(c) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony offense.
ORC:959.15.notes: NOTE: Defendant shall be fined not more than $10,000 for violation of this section.

ORC:959.15.heading: ANIMAL FIGHTS 959.15(B)(2)(d) ORC
ORC:959.15.variant: USE, POSSES, OR PERMIT SUBSTANCE TO ENHANCE ANIMALS FIGHTING ABILITY – FELONY OFFENSE
ORC:959.15.text: ___________ did knowingly, regarding an event involving (cockfighting, bear-baiting, or pitting an animal against another), to wit: (DESCRIBE ANIMAL AND EVENT), (use, possess, permit, or cause to be present) at the event, any (device or substance) intended to enhance an animal’s ability to fight or inflict injury on another animal, to wit: (DESCRIBE OFFENDER’S ROLE AND DEVICE/SUBSTANCE INVOLVED), in violation of Section 959.15(B)(2)(d) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony offense.
ORC:959.15.notes: NOTE: Defendant shall be fined not more than $10,000 for violation of this section.

ORC:959.15.heading: ANIMAL FIGHTS 959.15(B)(2)(e) ORC
ORC:959.15.variant: PERMIT MINOR TO BE PRESENT – FELONY OFFENSE
ORC:959.15.text: _________ did knowingly, regarding an event involving (cockfighting, bear-baiting, or pitting an animal against another), to wit: (DESCRIBE ANIMAL AND EVENT), (permit or cause) a minor to be present at the event, to wit: (DESCRIBE MINOR AND OFFENDER’S ROLE), if any person (present at or involved with) the event is conducting any of the activities described in sections 959.15(B)(1) or (B)(2)(a),(b),(c), or (d) of the Ohio Revised Code, to wit: (DESCRIBE PERSON AND VIOLATION BEING COMMITTED), in violation of Section 959.15(B)(2)(e) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony offense.
ORC:959.15.notes: NOTE: Defendant shall be fined not more than $10,000 for violation of this section.

ORC:959.15.heading: ANIMAL FIGHTS 959.15(C) ORC
ORC:959.15.variant: WITNESS TO COCKFIGHTING, BEAR-BAITING, ETC. – FELONY OFFENSE
ORC:959.15.text: _________ did knowingly witness an event involving (cockfighting, bear-baiting, or pitting an animal against another), to wit: (DECRIBE ANIMAL AND EVENT), when a violation of Section 959.15(B) of the Ohio Revised Code is occurring at the event, to wit: (DESCRIBE VIOLATION OCCURRING AND CIRCUMSTANCES SURROUNDING EVENT), in violation of Section 959.15(C) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony offense.
ORC:959.15.notes: NOTE: Defendant shall be fined not more than $10,000 for violation of this section. DEFINITIONS 959.21 ORC ANIMAL – means a nonhuman mammal, bird, reptile, or amphibian, either dead or alive. OFFENSE – means a violation of this section or an attempt, in violation of Section 2923.02 of the Ohio Revised Code, to violate this section. SEXUAL CONDUCT – means either of the following committed for the purpose of sexual gratification: 1. Any act done between a person and animal that involves contact of the penis of one and the vulva of the other, the penis of one and the penis of the other, the penis of one and the anus of the other, the mouth of one and the penis of the other, the mouth of one and the anus of the other, the vulva of one and the vulva of the other, the mouth of one and the vulva of the other, any other contact between a reproductive organ of one and a reproductive organ of the other, or any other insertion of a reproductive organ of one into an orifice of the other; 2. Without a bona fide veterinary or animal husbandry purpose to do so, the insertion, however slight, of any part of a person’s body or any instrument, apparatus, or other object into the vaginal, anal, or reproductive opening of an animal.

ORC:959.21.heading: ANTI-BESTIALITY 959.21(B) ORC
ORC:959.21.text: ____________did knowingly engage in sexual conduct, to wit: (DESCRIBE SEXUAL CONDUCT) with an animal, to wit: (DESCRIBE ANIMAL), in violation of Section 959.21(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.
ORC:959.21.notes: NOTE: An officer may seize and cause to be impounded at an impounding agency an animal that the officer has probable cause to believe is the subject of an offense. All procedures established in Section 959.132 apply to such animal.

ORC:959.21.heading: ANTI-BESTIALITY 959.21(B) ORC
ORC:959.21.variant: POSSESS, SELL, OR PURCHASE ANIMAL WITH INTENT TO SUBJECT TO SEXUAL CONDUCT – M2
ORC:959.21.text: ___________ did knowingly (possess, sell or purchase) an animal, to wit: (DESCRIBE ANIMAL) with the intent that it be subjected to sexual conduct, to wit: (DESCRIBE SEXUAL CONDUCT AND CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 959.21(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.
ORC:959.21.notes: NOTE: An officer may seize and cause to be impounded at an impounding agency an animal that the officer has probable cause to believe is the subject of an offense. All procedures established in Section 959.132 apply to such animal.

ORC:959.21.heading: ANTI-BESTIALITY 959.21(C) ORC
ORC:959.21.variant: ORGANIZE, PROMOTE, AID, OR ABET SEXUAL CONDUCT WITH ANIMAL – M2
ORC:959.21.text: ___________ did knowingly (organize, promote, aid, or abet) in the conduct of an act, to wit: (DESCRIBE ACT AND CIRCUMSTANCES) involving any sexual conduct with an animal, to wit: (DESCRIBE ANIMAL AND SEXUAL CONDUCT), in violation of Section 959.21(C) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.
ORC:959.21.notes: NOTE: An officer may seize and cause to be impounded at an impounding agency an animal that the officer has probable cause to believe is the subject of an offense. All procedures established in Section 959.132 apply to such animal.

ORC:4510.44.heading: IMMOBILIZING OR DISABLING INTERLOCK DEVICE 4510.44(A)(1) ORC
ORC:4510.44.text: __________ did (request or permit) any other person, to wit: (NAME PERSON) to breathe into the (ignition interlock device or another type of device that monitors the concentration of alcohol in a person’s breath), to wit: (DESCRIBE DEVICE), or did otherwise start the motor vehicle equipped with the device, to wit: (DESCRIBE MEANS) for the purpose of providing the offender with an operable motor vehicle, to wit: (DESCRIBE VEHICLE) after having been granted limited or unlimited driving privileges and during any period required to operate only a motor vehicle equipped with an immobilizing or disabling device, to wit: (DESCRIBE DRIVING PRIVILEGES, COURT, AND JUDGE WHO ISSUED THEM), in violation of Section 4510.44(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:4510.44.heading: IMMOBILIZING OR DISABLING INTERLOCK DEVICE 4510.44(A)(2) ORC
ORC:4510.44.variant: BREATHING INTO IMMOBILIZING OR DISABLING DEVICE – M1
ORC:4510.44.text: ____________ did breathe into an (immobilizing or disabling device) that is an (ignition interlock device or another type of device that monitors the concentration of alcohol in a person’s breath), to wit: (DESCRIBE DEVICE) or did otherwise start the motor vehicle equipped with the device, to wit: (DESCRIBE MEANS) for the purpose of providing an operable motor vehicle to another person, to wit: (NAME PERSON AND VEHICLE) who has been granted limited or unlimited driving privileges under the condition that the person operate only a motor vehicle equipped with an immobilizing or disabling device, to wit: (DESCRIBE DRIVING PRIVILEGES, COURT, AND JUDGE WHO ISSUED THEM), in violation of Section 4510.44(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:4510.44.heading: IMMOBILIZING OR DISABLING INTERLOCK DEVICE 4510.44(A)(3) ORC
ORC:4510.44.variant: TAMPERING WITH IMMOBILIZING OR DISABLING DEVICE – M1
ORC:4510.44.text: ____________ did, without authorization, (tamper with or circumvent the operation of) an (immobilizing or disabling device), to wit: (DESCRIBE DEVICE AND DEFENDANT’S ACTIONS), in violation of Section 4510.44(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:4399.09.heading: KEEPER OF A PLACE 4399.09 ORC
ORC:4399.09.variant: SELL, FURNISH, OR GIVEAWAY BEER OR INTOXICATING LIQUOR – MISDEMEANOR OFFENSE
ORC:4399.09.text: ____________ did keep a place, to wit: (DESCRIBE ADDRESS AND LOCATION OF PLACE) where (beer/intoxicating liquors) are (sold/ furnished/given away), to wit: (DESCRIBE ALCOHOL AND METHOD OF DISTRIBUTION), without having a valid and current permit as required pursuant to ORC 4303, in violation of Section 4399.09(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, an unclassified misdemeanor.
ORC:4399.09.notes: NOTE: “Beer” includes all beverages brewed or fermented wholly or in part from malt products and containing one-half of one per cent or more of alcohol by volume. NOTE: “Intoxicating liquor” and “liquor” include all liquids and compounds, other than beer, containing one-half of one per cent or more of alcohol by volume which are fit to use for beverage purposes, from whatever source and by whatever process produced, by whatever name called, and whether they are medicated, proprietary, or patented. “Intoxicating liquor” and “liquor” include cider and alcohol, and all solids and confections which contain one-half of one per cent or more of alcohol by volume.

CCC:2325.09.heading: KEEPER OF A PLACE 2325.09(A) CCC
CCC:2325.09.variant: SELL, FURNISH, OR GIVEAWAY BEER OR INTOXICATING LIQUOR – M1
CCC:2325.09.text: ____________ did keep a place, to wit: (DESCRIBE ADDRESS AND LOCATION OF PLACE) where (beer/intoxicating liquors) are (sold/ furnished/given away) to wit: (DESCRIBE ALCOHOL AND METHOD OF DISTRIBUTION), without having a valid and current permit as required pursuant to ORC 4303, in violation of Section 2325.09(A) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
CCC:2325.09.notes: NOTE: If the offender has been previously convicted under this section or ORC 4399.09, a mandatory penalty of at least 30 days imprisonment and a fine of at least $500 shall be imposed. NOTE: If the offender has been previously convicted two or more times under this section or ORC 4399.09, a mandatory penalty of at least 45 days imprisonment and a fine of at least $750 shall be imposed. NOTE: Property used in violation of this section shall be seized and forfeited to the City of Columbus upon motion made in a court of competent jurisdiction.

CCC:2325.09.heading: KEEPER OF A PLACE 2325.09(B) CCC
CCC:2325.09.variant: RECKLESSLY PURCHASE, POSSESS, OR CONSUME BEER OR INTOXICATING LIQUOR – M1
CCC:2325.09.text: ____________ did recklessly (purchase/possess/consume) (beer/intoxicating liquor) in a place where (beer/intoxicating liquor) is (sold/furnished/given away), to wit: (DESCRIBE PERSON/PLACE/ALCOHOL AND METHOD OF DISTRIBUTION) without having a valid and current permit as required pursuant to ORC 4303, in violation of Section 2325.09(B) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
CCC:2325.09.notes: NOTE: If the offender has been previously convicted under this section or ORC 4399.09, a mandatory penalty of at least 30 days imprisonment and a fine of at least $500 shall be imposed. NOTE: If the offender has been previously convicted two of more times under this section or ORC 4399.09, a mandatory penalty of at least 45 days imprisonment and a fine of at least $750 shall be imposed. NOTE: Property used in violation of this section shall be seized and forfeited to the City of Columbus upon motion made in a court of competent jurisdiction.

ORC:4301.58.heading: ACTIONS PROHIBITED WITHOUT PERMIT; UNAUTHORIZED SOURCE OF LIQUOR 4301.58(A) ORC
ORC:4301.58.variant: MANUFACTURE PERSONALLY OR THROUGH AN AGENT – M1
ORC:4301.58.text: ____________ did (personally or as the person’s clerk/agent/employee) to wit, (NAME OF PERSON, PERSON’S AGENCY STATUS AND BUSINESS NAME) manufacture any (beer/intoxicating liquor for sale/spirituous liquor) by means of (DESCRIBE TYPE OF ALCOHOL AND METHOD BY WHICH IT WAS MANUFACTURED), and did so while not being the holder of an A permit issued by the division of liquor control in force at the time and authorizing the manufacture of beer or intoxicating liquor, in violation of Section 4301.58(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:4301.58.notes: NOTE: “Manufacture” includes all processes by which beer or intoxicating liquor is produced, whether by distillation, rectifying, fortifying, blending, fermenting, or brewing, or in any other manner.

ORC:4301.58.heading: ACTIONS PROHIBITED WITHOUT PERMIT; UNAUTHORIZED SOURCE OF LIQUOR 4301.58(A) ORC
ORC:4301.58.variant: MANUFACTURE BY PERSON WHO IS NOT AN AGENT OR EMPLOYEE OF DIVISION OF LIQUOR – M1
ORC:4301.58.text: ____________ did, while not being an agent/employee of the division of liquor control authorized to manufacture beer or intoxicating liquor, to wit, (DESCRIBE PERSON) manufacture any (beer/intoxicating liquor for sale/spirituous liquor) by means of (DESCRIBE TYPE OF ALCOHOL AND METHOD BY WHICH IT WAS MANUFACTURED), in violation of Section 4301.58(A) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:4301.58.notes: NOTE: “Manufacture” includes all processes by which beer or intoxicating liquor is produced, whether by distillation, rectifying, fortifying, blending, fermenting, or brewing, or in any other manner.

ORC:4301.58.heading: ACTIONS PROHIBITED WITHOUT PERMIT; UNAUTHORIZED SOURCE OF LIQUOR 4301.58(B) ORC
ORC:4301.58.variant: SELL, KEEP, OR POSSESS ALCOHOL FOR SALE PERSONALLY OR THROUGH AN AGENT WITHOUT LIQUOR PERMIT – M1
ORC:4301.58.text: ____________ did (personally or as the person’s clerk/agent/employee) to wit, (NAME OF PERSON, PERSON’S AGENCY STATUS AND BUSINESS NAME), (sell/keep/posses) (beer/intoxicating liquor/alcohol for sale) to a person not authorized under ORC 4301 and 4303, to wit: (NAME OF PERSON) and did so while not being the holder of a (A/B/C/D/E/F/G/I/S) permit issued by the division of liquor, in force at the time and authorizing the sale of (beer/ intoxicating liquor/alcohol), to wit: (DESCRIBE ALCOHOL AND HOW KEPT OR SOLD), in violation of Section 4301.58(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:4301.58.heading: ACTIONS PROHIBITED WITHOUT PERMIT; UNAUTHORIZED SOURCE OF LIQUOR 4301.58(B) ORC
ORC:4301.58.variant: SELL ALCOHOL AT RETAIL PERSONALLY OR THROUGH AN AGENT – M1
ORC:4301.58.text: ____________ did (personally or as the person’s clerk/agent/employee) to wit, (NAME OF PERSON, PERSON’S AGENCY STATUS AND BUSINESS NAME), sell alcohol at retail, to wit: (DESCRIBE ALCOHOL AND HOW SOLD), and did so while not being the holder of a (A/B/C/D/E/F/G/I/S) permit issued by the division of liquor, in force at the time and authorizing the sale of (beer/intoxicating liquor/alcohol), in violation of Section 4301.58(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:4301.58.heading: ACTIONS PROHIBITED WITHOUT PERMIT; UNAUTHORIZED SOURCE OF LIQUOR 4301.58(B) ORC
ORC:4301.58.variant: SELL, KEEP, OR POSSESS ALCOHOL FOR SALE BY A PERSON WHO IS NOT AN AGENT OR EMPLOYEE – M1
ORC:4301.58.text: ____________ did, while not being an agent/employee of the (division of liquor control/tax commissioner), to wit, (DESCRIBE PERSON) (sell/keep/ possess) (beer/intoxicating liquor/alcohol for sale) to a person not authorized under ORC 4301 and 4303, to wit: (NAME OF PERSON), to wit: (DESCRIBE ALCOHOL AND HOW KEPT OR SOLD), in violation of Section 4301.58(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:4301.58.heading: ACTIONS PROHIBITED WITHOUT PERMIT; UNAUTHORIZED SOURCE OF LIQUOR 4301.58(B) ORC
ORC:4301.58.variant: SELL ALCOHOL AT RETAIL BY A PERSON WHO IS NOT AN AGENT – M1
ORC:4301.58.text: ____________ did, while not being an agent/employee of the (division of liquor control/tax commissioner), to wit, (DESCRIBE PERSON) sell alcohol at retail, to wit: (DESCRIBE ALCOHOL AND HOW SOLD), in violation of Section 4301.58(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:4301.58.heading: ACTIONS PROHIBITED WITHOUT PERMIT; UNAUTHORIZED SOURCE OF LIQUOR 4301.58(C) ORC
ORC:4301.58.variant: SELL, KEEP, OR POSSESS ALCOHOL FOR UNAUTHORIZED SALE AS A PERMIT HOLDER – M1
ORC:4301.58.text: ____________ did (personally or as the person’s clerk/agent/employee), to wit, (NAME OF PERSON, PERSON’S AGENCY STATUS AND BUSINESS NAME) (sell/keep/possess for sale) any intoxicating liquor not purchased from (division of liquor control/holder of a permit issued by the division) without special consent of the division, by means of: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF ALCOHOL AND METHOD BY WHICH IT WAS KEPT OR SOLD), and did so while being the holder of a permit issued by the division of liquor control in force at the time, to wit: (DESCRIBE PERMIT HELD), in violation of Section 4301.58(C) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:4301.58.notes: DEFINITIONS 4301.62 ORC See additional exceptions listed in Sections 4301.62(C) through 4301.62(G) of the Ohio Revised Code. BEER – has the same meaning listed in Section 4301.01(B)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code. CHAUFFEURED LIMOUSINE – means a vehicle registered under Section 4503.24 of the Ohio Revised Code. INTOXICATING LIQUOR – has the same meaning listed in Section 4301.01(a)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code. STREET, HIGHWAY, AND MOTOR VEHICLE – have the same meanings listed in Section 4511.01 of the Ohio Revised Code.

ORC:4301.62.heading: OPEN CONTAINER 4301.62(B)(1) ORC
ORC:4301.62.text: _____________ did have in the person’s possession an opened container of (beer or intoxicating liquor) in an agency store, to wit: (NAME AGENCY STORE AND DESCRIBE ALCOHOL POSSESSED) in violation of Section 4301.62(B)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a minor misdemeanor.

ORC:4301.62.heading: OPEN CONTAINER 4301.62(B)(2) ORC
ORC:4301.62.variant: PREMISES OF LIQUOR PERMIT HOLDER – MM
ORC:4301.62.text: _____________ did have in the person’s possession an opened container of (beer or intoxicating liquor) on the premises of a liquor permit holder whose permit was issued under ORC 4303, to wit: (DESCRIBE PREMISES INCLUDING NAME, ADDRESS, PERMIT HOLDER, AND TYPE OF PERMIT HELD, AND WHAT/HOW ALCOHOL WAS POSSESSED), in violation of Section 4301.62(B)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a minor misdemeanor.

ORC:4301.62.heading: OPEN CONTAINER 4301.62(B)(3) ORC
ORC:4301.62.text: _____________ did have in the person’s possession an opened container of (beer or intoxicating liquor) in a public place, to wit: (DESCRIBE ALCOHOL POSSESSED AND PUBLIC PLACE), in violation of Section 4301.62(B)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a minor misdemeanor.

ORC:4301.62.heading: OPEN CONTAINER 4301.62(B)(4) ORC
ORC:4301.62.variant: WHILE OPERATING OR BEING A PASSENGER IN A MOTOR VEHICLE – MM
ORC:4301.62.text: _____________ did have in the person’s possession an opened container of (beer or intoxicating liquor) while (operating or being a passenger in or on) a motor vehicle, to wit: (DESCRIBE VEHICLE AND ALCOHOL POSSESSED) on any (street, highway, or other public or private property open to the public for purposes of vehicular travel or parking), to wit: (DESCRIBE LOCATION), in violation of Section 4301.62(B)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a minor misdemeanor.
ORC:4301.62.notes: NOTE: See ORC 4301.62(D) and (E) for exceptions.

ORC:4301.62.heading: OPEN CONTAINER 4301.62(B)(5) ORC
ORC:4301.62.variant: WHILE BEING IN A STATIONARY MOTOR VEHICLE – MM
ORC:4301.62.text: _____________ did have in the person’s possession an opened container of (beer or intoxicating liquor) while being in or on a stationary motor vehicle on (any street, highway, or other public or private property open to the public for purposes of vehicular travel or parking), to wit: (DESCRIBE VEHICLE, ALCOHOL POSSESSED, AND LOCATION WHERE POSSESSED), in violation of Section 4301.62(B)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a minor misdemeanor.
ORC:4301.62.notes: NOTE: See ORC 4301.62(D) and (E) for exceptions.

ORC:4301.64.heading: CONSUMPTION IN A MOTOR VEHICLE 4301.64 ORC
ORC:4301.64.text: _____________ did consume (beer or intoxicating liquor) in a motor vehicle, to wit: (DESCRIBE MOTOR VEHICLE AND ALCOHOL BEING CONSUMED), in violation of Section 4301.64 of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.
ORC:4301.64.notes: NOTE: This section does not apply to persons described in ORC 4301.62(D). DEFINITIONS 2317.50 CCC No arrest shall be made for a violation of this section until the arresting officer first requests and affords such person an opportunity to explain such conduct as outlined in Section 2317.50(D) of the Columbus City Code. PUBLIC PLACE – means an area of property, either publicly owned or to which the public has access, and includes but is not limited to streets, alleys, sidewalks, rights-of-way, bridges, plazas, parks, driveways, parking lots, transportation facilities, or other places open to the public; the doorways, entrances, porches, passageways, and roofs to any such building which fronts on any of the aforesaid places; or motor vehicles in or upon such places. DRUG ABUSE OFFENSE – means a violation as outlined in Section 2925.01(G) of the Ohio Revised Code.

CCC:2317.50.heading: LOITERING IN AID OF DRUG OFFENSES 2317.50(A)(1) CCC
CCC:2317.50.variant: REPEATEDLY BECKON, STOP, ATTEMPT TO STOP, OR ENGAGE – M1
CCC:2317.50.text: ____________ did, while in or about a public place, to wit: (DESCRIBE PLACE) repeatedly (beckon/stop/attempt to stop/engage) passers-by or pedestrians in conversation, by means of (DESCRIBE WHAT MANNER OF CONTACT ATTEMPTED AND WITH WHOM), and did so with purpose to commit or aid the commission of a drug abuse offense, to wit: (NAME OF DRUG ABUSE OFFENSE COMMITTED/AIDED), in violation of Columbus City Code 2317.50(A)(1), a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2317.50.heading: LOITERING IN AID OF DRUG OFFENSES 2317.50(A)(2) CCC
CCC:2317.50.variant: REPEATEDLY STOP OR ATTEMPT TO STOP MOTOR VEHICLES – M1
CCC:2317.50.text: ____________ did, while in or about a public place, to wit: (DESCRIBE PLACE) repeatedly (stop or attempt to stop) motor vehicles, by means of (DESCRIBE THE MANNER BY WHICH ATTEMPTS WERE MADE AND TO WHOM), and did so with purpose to commit or aid the commission of a drug abuse offense, to wit: (NAME OF DRUG ABUSE OFFENSE COMMITTED/ AIDED), in violation of Columbus City Code 2317.50(A)(2), a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2317.50.heading: LOITERING IN AID OF DRUG OFFENSES 2317.50(A)(3) CCC
CCC:2317.50.variant: REPEATEDLY INTERFERE WITH FREE PASSAGE OF PERSONS – M1
CCC:2317.50.text: ____________ did, while in or about a public place, to wit: (DESCRIBE PLACE) repeatedly interfere with the free passage of other persons, by means of (DESCRIBE MANNER OF INTERFERENCE AND PERSON(S) INTERFERED WITH), and did so with purpose to commit or aid the commission of a drug abuse offense, to wit: (NAME OF DRUG ABUSE OFFENSE COMMITTED/AIDED), in violation of Columbus City Code 2317.50(A)(3), a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2317.50.heading: LOITERING IN AID OF DRUG OFFENSES 2317.50(A)(4) CCC
CCC:2317.50.text: ____________ did, while in or about a public place, to wit: (DESCRIBE PLACE) direct (pedestrians or motorists) through (words/hailing/waving of arms/pointing/signaling or other bodily gestures), by means of (DESCRIBE MANNER OF COMMUNICATION AND PERSONS WITH WHOM THEY WERE DIRECTED), to a person or premises where controlled substances are possessed or sold, to wit: (DESCRIBE PERSON/PREMISES AND DETAILS OF CONTROLLED SUBSTANCE POSSESSION/SALE) , and did so with purpose to commit or aid the commission of a drug abuse offense, to wit: (NAME OF DRUG ABUSE OFFENSE COMMITTED/AIDED), in violation of Columbus City Code 2317.50(A)(4), a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2317.50.heading: LOITERING IN AID OF DRUG OFFENSES 2317.50(A)(5) CCC
CCC:2317.50.variant: TRANSFER SMALL OBJECTS OR PACKAGES FOR CURRENCY – M1
CCC:2317.50.text: ____________ did, while in or about a public place, to wit: (DESCRIBE PLACE) transfer (small objects/packages) in a (furtive or surreptitious) fashion in exchange for currency or any other thing of value, by means of (DESCRIBE OBJECTS EXCHANGED AND IN WHAT MANNER THEY WERE EXCHANGED), such as to lead an observer, to wit: (NAME OF OBSERVER) to (believe or ascertain) that a drug sale has or is about to occur, and did so with purpose to commit or aid the commission of a drug abuse offense, to wit: (NAME OF DRUG ABUSE OFFENSE COMMITTED/ AIDED), in violation of Columbus City Code 2317.50(A)(5), a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2317.50.heading: LOITERING IN AID OF DRUG OFFENSES 2317.50(A)(6) CCC
CCC:2317.50.text: ____________ did, while in or about a public place, to wit: (DESCRIBE PLACE) act as a lookout by communicating the fact that law enforcement officers are in the vicinity to another person, by means of (DESCRIBE MANNER OF COMMUNICATION AND TO WHOM THEY WERE DIRECTED), in a manner which suggests that the communication is a warning, to wit: (DESCRIBE WARNING) , and did so with purpose to commit or aid the commission of a drug abuse offense, to wit: (NAME OF DRUG ABUSE OFFENSE COMMITTED/ AIDED), in violation of Columbus City Code 2317.50(A)(6), a misdemeanor of the first degree.
CCC:2317.50.notes: DEFINITIONS 2317.51 CCC HEALTH CARE FACILITY – has the same meaning as in Section 2919.16 of the Ohio Revised Code. REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH CARE FACILITY – means a health care facility at which licensed, certified, or otherwise legally authorized persons provide health care services, health care counseling relating to the human reproductive system, or family planning services. PREMISES – means any land, building, structure, or place belonging to, controlled by, or in custody of another, and any separate enclosure or room, or portion thereof.

CCC:2317.51.heading: OBSTRUCTION AND HARASSMENT AT HEALTH CARE FACILITIES 2317.51(B)(1) CCC
CCC:2317.51.variant: PHYSICALLY CONTACT VICTIM WHILE ENTERING/EXITING PREMISES – M1
CCC:2317.51.text: _____________ did knowingly (physically obstruct or block) another person, to wit: (NAME OF OTHER PERSON) from (entering into or exiting from) the premises of a reproductive health care facility, to wit: (NAME OF FACILITY) by physically (STRIKING/SHOVING/RESTRAINING/GRABBING OR OTHER UNWANTED PHYSICAL CONTACT) the victim by means of, (DESCRIBE PHYSICAL CONTACT ENGAGED IN), in violation of Section 2317.51(B)(1) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2317.51.heading: OBSTRUCTION AND HARASSMENT AT HEALTH CARE FACILITIES 2317.51(B)(1) CCC
CCC:2317.51.variant: ATTEMPT TO PHYSICALLY CONTACT VICTIM WHILE ENTERING/ EXITING PREMISES – M1
CCC:2317.51.text: _____________ did knowingly (physically obstruct or block) another person, to wit: (NAME OF OTHER PERSON) from (entering into or exiting from) the premises of a reproductive health care facility, to wit: (NAME OF FACILITY) by attempting to physically (STRIKE/SHOVE/RESTRAIN/GRAB OR OTHER UNWANTED PHYSICAL CONTACT) the victim by means of, (DESCRIBE ATTEMPTED PHYSICAL CONTACT ENGAGED IN), in violation of Section 2317.51(B)(1) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2317.51.heading: OBSTRUCTION AND HARASSMENT AT HEALTH CARE FACILITIES 2317.51(B)(1) CCC
CCC:2317.51.variant: THREATEN TO PHYSICALLY CONTACT VICTIM WHILE ENTERING/ EXITING PREMISES – M1
CCC:2317.51.text: _____________ did knowingly (physically obstruct or block) another person, to wit: (NAME OF OTHER PERSON) from (entering into or existing from) the premises of a reproductive health care facility, to wit: (NAME OF FACILITY) by threatening to physically (STRIKE/SHOVE/RESTRAIN/GRAB OR OTHER UNWANTED PHYSICAL CONTACT) the victim by means of, (DESCRIBE THREAT OF PHYSICAL CONTACT ENGAGED IN), in violation of Section 2317.51(B)(1) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2317.51.heading: OBSTRUCTION AND HARASSMENT AT HEALTH CARE FACILITIES 2317.51(B)(2) CCC
CCC:2317.51.text: _____________ did knowingly (obstruct or block) the premises of a reproductive health care facility, to wit: (NAME OF FACILITY) so as to impede access to or from the facility by means of, (DESCRIBE HOW ACCESS TO/FROM PREMISES WAS OBSTRUCTED), in violation of Section 2317.51(B)(2) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2317.51.heading: OBSTRUCTION AND HARASSMENT AT HEALTH CARE FACILITIES 2317.51(B)(2) CCC
CCC:2317.51.variant: ATTEMPT TO OBSTRUCT OR BLOCK PREMISES – M1
CCC:2317.51.text: _____________ did knowingly attempt to (obstruct or block) the premises of a reproductive health care facility, to wit: (NAME OF FACILITY) so as to impede access to or from the facility by means of, (DESCRIBE ATTEMPT TO OBSTRUCT ACCESS TO/FROM PREMISES), in violation of Section 2317.51(B)(2) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2317.51.heading: OBSTRUCTION AND HARASSMENT AT HEALTH CARE FACILITIES 2317.51(B)(3) CCC
CCC:2317.51.variant: ENGAGE IN DISORDERLY CONDUCT WITHIN 15 FEET OF THE PREMISES – M1
CCC:2317.51.text: _____________ did engage in disorderly conduct pursuant to CCC 2317.11, to wit: (INSERT LANGUAGE FROM DISORDERLY CONDUCT SECTION OF CCM INCLUDING SUBSECTION AND DESCRIBE CONDUCT OF PERSON) within 15 feet of the premises of a reproductive health care facility, to wit: (NAME OF FACILITY) in violation of Section 2317.51(B)(3) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2317.51.heading: OBSTRUCTION AND HARASSMENT AT HEALTH CARE FACILITIES 2317.51(B)(4) CCC
CCC:2317.51.variant: ENGAGE IN BEHAVIOR WHICH PLACES ANOTHER IN FEAR OF PHYSICAL HARM WITHIN 15 FEET OF PREMISES – M1
CCC:2317.51.text: _____________ did (engage in a course of conduct or repeatedly commit acts) within 15 feet of the premises of a reproductive health care facility, to wit: (NAME OF FACILITY) which placed another person, to wit: (NAME OF PERSON) in reasonable fear of physical harm by means of (DESCRIBE CONDUCT/BEHAVIOR OF SUSPECT AND FEAR OF VICTIM), in violation of Section 2317.51(B)(4) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

CCC:2317.51.heading: OBSTRUCTION AND HARASSMENT AT HEALTH CARE FACILITIES 2317.51(B)(4) CCC
CCC:2317.51.variant: ATTEMPT TO ENGAGE IN BEHAVIOR WHICH PLACES ANOTHER IN FEAR OF PHYSICAL HARM WITHIN 15 FEET OF PREMISES – M1
CCC:2317.51.text: _____________ did attempt to (engage in a course of conduct or repeatedly commit acts) within 15 feet of the premises of a reproductive health care facility, to wit: (NAME OF FACILITY) which placed another person, to wit: (NAME OF PERSON) in reasonable fear of physical harm by means of (DESCRIBE CONDUCT/BEHAVIOR OF SUSPECT AND FEAR OF VICTIM), in violation of Section 2317.51(B)(4) of the Columbus City Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3501.35.heading: LOITERING/CONGREGATING NEAR POLLING PLACE 3501.35(A)(1) ORC
ORC:3501.35.variant: BETWEEN POLLING PLACE AND FLAGS – M1
ORC:3501.35.text: _____________ did, during an election and the counting of ballots, (loiter, congregate, or engage in any kind of election campaigning) within the area between the polling place and the small flags of the United States placed on the thoroughfares and walkways leading to the polling place, to wit: (DESCRIBE DEFENDANT’S CONDUCT, WHERE IT WAS DONE, AND STATE NAME/ ADDRESS OF POLLING PLACE), in violation of Section 3501.35(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3501.35.heading: LOITERING/CONGREGATING NEAR POLLING PLACE 3501.35(A)(1) ORC
ORC:3501.35.variant: WITHIN 10 FEET OF ELECTOR IN LINE TO VOTE – M1
ORC:3501.35.text: _____________ did, during an election and the counting of ballots, (loiter, congregate, or engage in any kind of election campaigning) within 10 feet of any elector in line waiting to vote when the line of electors extended beyond the small flags of the United States placed on the thoroughfares and walkways leading to the polling place, to wit: (DESCRIBE DEFENDANT’S CONDUCT, WHERE IT WAS DONE, STATE NAME OF ELECTOR IN LINE AND NAME/ ADDRESS OF POLLING PLACE), in violation of Section 3501.35(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3501.35.heading: LOITERING/CONGREGATING NEAR POLLING PLACE 3501.35(A)(2) ORC
ORC:3501.35.variant: HINDER/DELAY ELECTOR IN REACHING/LEAVING VOTING PLACE – M1
ORC:3501.35.text: _____________ did, during an election and the counting of ballots, in any manner (hinder or delay) an elector, to wit: (STATE NAME OF ELECTOR) in reaching or leaving the place fixed for casting the elector’s ballot, to wit: (DESCRIBE DEFENDANT’S CONDUCT, HOW IT HINDERED THE ELECTOR, AND STATE NAME/ADDRESS OF VOTING PLACE), in violation of Section 3501.35(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3501.35.heading: LOITERING/CONGREGATING NEAR POLLING PLACE 3501.35(A)(3) ORC
ORC:3501.35.variant: GIVE/EXHIBIT ANY BALLOT/TICKET TO ANOTHER BETWEEN POLLING PLACE AND FLAGS – M1
ORC:3501.35.text: _____________ did, during an election and the counting of ballots, (give, tender, or exhibit) any (ballot or ticket) to any person, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON) other than the elector’s own ballot to the precinct election officials, within the area between the polling place and the small flags of the United States placed on the thoroughfares and walkways leading to the polling place, to wit: (DESCRIBE DEFENDANT’S CONDUCT, WHERE IT WAS DONE, AND STATE NAME/ADDRESS OF POLLING PLACE), in violation of Section 3501.35(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3501.35.heading: LOITERING/CONGREGATING NEAR POLLING PLACE 3501.35(A)(3) ORC
ORC:3501.35.variant: GIVE/EXHIBIT ANY BALLOT/TICKET TO ANOTHER WITHIN 10 FEET OF ELECTOR IN LINE TO VOTE – M1
ORC:3501.35.text: _____________ did, during an election and the counting of ballots, (give, tender, or exhibit) any (ballot or ticket) to any person, to wit: (STATE NAME OF PERSON) other than the elector’s own ballot to the precinct election officials, within 10 feet of any elector in line waiting to vote when the line of electors extended beyond the small flags of the United States placed on the thoroughfares and walkways leading to the polling place, to wit: (DESCRIBE DEFENDANT’S CONDUCT, WHERE IT WAS DONE, AND STATE NAME/ ADDRESS OF POLLING PLACE), in violation of Section 3501.35(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3501.35.heading: LOITERING/CONGREGATING NEAR POLLING PLACE 3501.35(A)(4) ORC
ORC:3501.35.variant: EXHIBIT TICKET/BALLOT INTENDED TO BE CAST – M1
ORC:3501.35.text: _____________ did, during an election and the counting of ballots, exhibit any (ballot or ticket) which the elector intended to cast, to wit: (DESCRIBE DEFENDANT’S CONDUCT AND WHERE IT WAS DONE), in violation of Section 3501.35(A)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3501.35.heading: LOITERING/CONGREGATING NEAR POLLING PLACE 3501.35(A)(5) ORC
ORC:3501.35.variant: SOLICIT OR ATTEMPT TO INFLUENCE ANY ELECTOR – M1
ORC:3501.35.text: _____________ did, during an election and the counting of ballots, (solicit or in any manner attempt to influence) any elector in casting the elector’s vote, to wit: (STATE NAME OF ELECTOR, DESCRIBE DEFENDANT’S CONDUCT AND WHERE IT WAS DONE), in violation of Section 3501.35(A)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3501.35.heading: LOITERING/CONGREGATING NEAR POLLING PLACE 3501.35(B)(1) ORC
ORC:3501.35.variant: ENTERING POLLING PLACE WHEN NOT AUTHORIZED – M1
ORC:3501.35.text: _____________ did, without being an election official, employee, observer, or police officer, enter the polling place during the election and was not voting, or assisting another person to vote pursuant to ORC 3505.24, to wit: (DESCRIBE DEFENDANT’S CONDUCT AND STATE NAME/ADDRESS OF POLLING PLACE), in violation of Section 3501.35(B)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.
ORC:3501.35.notes: NOTE: Journalists as defined in ORC 149.43(B)(9)(c) shall be allowed reasonable access to a polling place during an election. NOTE: A person may enter the polling place for the sole purpose of reviewing the official registration list posted pursuant to ORC 3503.23, provided that the person does not engage in conduct that would constitute harassment in violation of the election law, as defined in ORC 3501.90.

ORC:3501.35.heading: LOITERING/CONGREGATING NEAR POLLING PLACE 3501.35(C) ORC
ORC:3501.35.variant: APPROACH VOTING SHELVES MORE THAN PROVIDED – M1
ORC:3501.35.text: _____________ did approach the voting shelves at any time when there were no more voting shelves provided, to wit: (DESCRIBE DEFENDANT’S CONDUCT AND STATE NAME/ADDRESS OF VOTING PLACE), in violation of Section 3501.35(C) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3599.24.heading: INTERFERENCE WITH CONDUCT OF ELECTION 3599.24(A)(1) ORC
ORC:3599.24.variant: USE FORCE OR IMPROPER MEANS TO OBTAIN BALLOTS/BOXES/ POLLBOOKS – F5
ORC:3599.24.text: _____________ did by (force or fraud or other improper means), to wit: (DESCRIBE) (obtain or attempt to obtain) possession of the (ballots/ballot boxes/pollbooks), to wit: (DESCRIBE WHAT WAS POSSESSED AND CIRCUMSTANCES BY WHICH IT WAS OBTAINED OR ATTEMPTED TO BE OBTAINED), in violation of Section 3599.24(A)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:3599.24.heading: INTERFERENCE WITH CONDUCT OF ELECTION 3599.24(A)(2) ORC
ORC:3599.24.variant: RECKLESSLY DESTROY PROPERTY USED TO CONDUCT ELECTIONS – F5
ORC:3599.24.text: _____________ did recklessly destroy any property used in the conduct of elections, to wit: (DESCRIBE WHAT PROPERTY WAS DESTROYED AND HOW IT WAS DONE), in violation of Section 3599.24(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:3599.24.heading: INTERFERENCE WITH CONDUCT OF ELECTION 3599.24(A)(3) ORC
ORC:3599.24.variant: ATTEMPT TO INTIMIDATE ELECTION OFFICER – M1
ORC:3599.24.text: _____________ did attempt to intimidate an election officer, to wit: (DESCRIBE ATTEMPT TO INTIMIDATE AND STATE NAME OF ELECTION OFFICER), in violation of Section 3599.24(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3599.24.heading: INTERFERENCE WITH CONDUCT OF ELECTION 3599.24(A)(3) ORC
ORC:3599.24.variant: PREVENT ELECTION OFFICIAL FROM PERFORMING DUTIES – M1
ORC:3599.24.text: _____________ did prevent an election official from performing the official’s duties, to wit: (STATE NAME OF OFFICIAL, WHAT DUTIES WERE PREVENTED AND HOW), in violation of Section 3599.24(A)(3) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3599.24.heading: INTERFERENCE WITH CONDUCT OF ELECTION 3599.24(A)(4) ORC
ORC:3599.24.variant: REMOVE OR DESTROY REGISTRATION LISTS OR SAMPLE BALLOTS AT POLLING PLACE – M1
ORC:3599.24.text: _____________ did knowingly (tear down, remove or destroy) any of the (registration lists or sample ballots) furnished by the (Franklin/Licking/Delaware) County Board of Elections at the polling place, to wit: (DESCRIBE WHAT WAS REMOVED/DESTROYED AND HOW, AND STATE NAME/ADDRESS OF POLLING PLACE), in violation of Section 3599.24(A)(4) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3599.24.heading: INTERFERENCE WITH CONDUCT OF ELECTION 3599.24(A)(5) ORC
ORC:3599.24.variant: LOITER AT REGISTRATION/POLLING PLACE DURING REGISTRATION OR CASTING AND COUNTING OF BALLOTS – M1
ORC:3599.24.text: _____________ did loiter in or about a (registration or polling place) during (registration or the casting and counting of ballots), to wit: (STATE NAME/ ADDRESS OF REGISTRATION/POLLING PLACE) so as to (hinder, delay, or interfere with) the conduct of the (registration or election), to wit: (DESCRIBE DEFENDANT’S CONDUCT AND HOW IT INTERFERED WITH THE REGISTRATION/ELECTION), in violation of Section 3599.24(A)(5) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3599.24.heading: INTERFERENCE WITH CONDUCT OF ELECTION 3599.24(A)(6) ORC
ORC:3599.24.variant: REMOVE SUPPLIES FURNISHED TO ENABLE VOTER TO MARK BALLOT – M1
ORC:3599.24.text: _____________ did remove from the voting place the (pencils, cards of instruction, supplies or other conveniences) furnished to enable the voter to mark the voter’s ballot, to wit: (STATE NAME/ADDRESS OF VOTING PLACE AND WHAT ITEM(S) WERE REMOVED AND HOW), in violation of Section 3599.24(A)(6) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3796.06.heading: FORMS OF MARIJUANA 3796.06(C)(2) ORC AND 3796.99(A)(2) ORC
ORC:3796.06.variant: MARIJUANA CONSUMPTION AS PASSENGER IN VEHICLE – M3
ORC:3796.06.text: _____________ did knowingly consume (adult-use marijuana, homegrown marijuana, or medical marijuana) by (smoking, combustion, or vaporization) as a passenger in a (vehicle, streetcar, trackless trolley, watercraft, or aircraft) when the operator (is operating or has physical control), to wit: (DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 3796.06(C)(2) and Section 3796.99(A)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the third degree.

ORC:3796.06.heading: FORMS OF MARIJUANA 3796.06(C)(2) ORC AND 3796.99(B) ORC
ORC:3796.06.variant: MARIJUANA CONSUMPTION IN ANY OTHER PLACE OTHER THAN PRIVATELY OWNED REAL PROPERTY – MM
ORC:3796.06.text: _____________ did knowingly consume (adult-use marijuana, homegrown marijuana, or medical marijuana) by (smoking, combustion, or vaporization) in any place other than privately owned real property that is used primarily for residential or agricultural purposes, to wit: (DESCRIBE LOCATION AND CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 3796.06(C)(2) and Section 3796.99(B) of the Ohio Revised Code, a minor misdemeanor.
ORC:3796.06.notes: NOTE: “Privately owned real property” includes any dwellings, facilities, improvements, and appurtenances on such real property.

ORC:3796.06.heading: FORMS OF MARIJUANA 3796.06(F) ORC AND 3796.99(C)(1)(a) ORC
ORC:3796.06.variant: SELL, GIVE, OR DISTRIBUTE MARIJUANA TO PERSON UNDER 21-YEARS OF AGE – M1
ORC:3796.06.text: _____________ did knowingly (sell, give, or distribute) (adult-use marijuana or homegrown marijuana) to a person under twenty-one years of age, to wit: (NAME AND AGE OF PERSON), in violation of Section 3796.06(F) and Section 3796.99(C)(1)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3796.06.heading: FORMS OF MARIJUANA 3796.06(F) ORC AND 3796.99(C)(1)(b) ORC
ORC:3796.06.variant: SELL, GIVE, OR DISTRIBUTE MARIJUANA TO PERSON UNDER 21-YEARS OF AGE – PREVIOUS CONVICTION – F5
ORC:3796.06.text: _____________ did knowingly (sell, give, or distribute) (adult-use marijuana or homegrown marijuana) to a person under twenty-one years of age, to wit: (NAME AND AGE OF PERSON), and having previously been convicted of, or pleaded guilty to, a violation of Section 3796.06(F), to wit: (STATE DATE, COURT, AND CASE NUMBER OF CONVICTION), in violation of Section 3796.06(F) and Section 3796.99(C)(1)(b) of the Ohio Revised Code, a felony of the fifth degree.

ORC:3796.06.heading: FORMS OF MARIJUANA 3796.06(G) ORC AND 3796.99(G)(1) ORC
ORC:3796.06.variant: SHOW OR GIVE FALSE INFORMATION TO PURCHASE OR OBTAIN MARIJUANA – M1
ORC:3796.06.text: _____________ did knowingly (show or give) false information concerning the offender’s name, age, or other identification for the purpose of (purchasing or otherwise obtaining) adult-use marijuana from an adult-use dispensary while under the age of twenty one, to wit: (STATE OFFENDER’S DOB AND DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 3796.06(G) and Section 3796.99(G)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3796.06.heading: FORMS OF MARIJUANA 3796.06(G) ORC AND 3796.99(G)(2) ORC
ORC:3796.06.variant: PRESENT FALSE IDENTIFICATION TO ADULT-USE DISPENSARY– M1
ORC:3796.06.text: _____________ did knowingly present a (false, fictitious, or altered identification card; a false or fictitious driver’s license purportedly issued by any state; or a driver’s license issued by any state that has been altered) to an adult-use dispensary while under the age of twenty one, to wit: (STATE OFFENDER’S DOB AND DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 3796.06(G) and Section 3796.99(G)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3796.06.heading: FORMS OF MARIJUANA 3796.06(G) ORC AND 3796.99(G)(3)(a) ORC
ORC:3796.06.variant: PRESENT FALSE IDENTIFICATION TO ADULT-USE DISPENSARY– PREVIOUS CONVICTION – M1
ORC:3796.06.text: _____________ did knowingly present a (false, fictitious, or altered identification card; a false or fictitious driver’s license purportedly issued by any state; or a driver’s license issued by any state that has been altered) to an adult-use dispensary while under the age of twenty one, to wit: (STATE OFFENDER’S DOB AND DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES), and having previously been convicted of, or pleaded guilty to, a violation of Section 3796.06(G), to wit: (STATE DATE, COURT, AND CASE NUMBER OF CONVICTION), in violation of Section 3796.06(G) and Section 3796.99(G)(3)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3796.06.heading: FORMS OF MARIJUANA 3796.06(G) ORC AND 3796.99(G)(4)(a) ORC
ORC:3796.06.variant: PRESENT FALSE IDENTIFICATION TO ADULT-USE DISPENSARY– TWO OR MORE PREVIOUS CONVICTIONS – M1
ORC:3796.06.text: _____________ did knowingly present a (false, fictitious, or altered identification card; a false or fictitious driver’s license purportedly issued by any state; or a driver’s license issued by any state that has been altered) to an adult-use dispensary while under the age of twenty one, to wit: (STATE OFFENDER’S DOB AND DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES), and having previously been convicted of, or pleaded guilty to, two or more violations of Section 3796.06(G), to wit: (STATE DATES, COURTS, AND CASE NUMBERS OF CONVICTIONS), in violation of Section 3796.06(G) and Section 3796.99(G)(4)(a) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the first degree.

ORC:3796.06.heading: FORMS OF MARIJUANA 3796.06(G) ORC AND 3796.99(H)(1) ORC
ORC:3796.06.text: _____________ did knowingly solicit another person to purchase adult-use marijuana from an adult-use dispensary while under the age of twenty one, to wit: (STATE OFFENDER’S DOB AND DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES), in violation of Section 3796.06(G) and Section 3796.99(H)(1) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the fourth degree.

ORC:3796.06.heading: FORMS OF MARIJUANA 3796.06(G) ORC AND 3796.99(H)(2) ORC
ORC:3796.06.variant: SOLICIT ANOTHER TO PURCHASE – PREVIOUS CONVICTION – M2
ORC:3796.06.text: _____________ did knowingly solicit another person to purchase adult-use marijuana from an adult-use dispensary while under the age of twenty one, to wit: (STATE OFFENDER’S DOB AND DESCRIBE CIRCUMSTANCES), and having previously been convicted of, or pleaded guilty to, a violation of Section 3796.06(G), to wit: (STATE DATE, COURT, AND CASE NUMBER OF CONVICTION), in violation of Section 3796.06(G) and Section 3796.99(H)(2) of the Ohio Revised Code, a misdemeanor of the second degree.

ORC:3796.062.heading: TRANSPORTATION OF MARIJUANA 3796.062(A) ORC AND 3796.99(I) ORC
ORC:3796.062.variant: MOTOR VEHICLE – OTHER THAN ADULT-USE, MEDICAL, OR HOMEGROWN MEDICAL MARIJUANA – MM
ORC:3796.062.text: _____________ did knowingly transport marijuana other than adult-use marijuana, medical marijuana, or homegrown marijuana in a motor vehicle, to wit: (DESCRIBE TYPE OF MARIJUANA AND LOCATION IN MOTOR VEHICLE), in violation of Section 3796.062(A) and Section 3796.99(I) of the Ohio Revised Code, a minor misdemeanor.

ORC:3796.062.heading: TRANSPORTATION OF MARIJUANA 3796.062(B) ORC AND 3796.99(I) ORC
ORC:3796.062.variant: MOTOR VEHICLE – ADULT-USE OR MEDICAL MARIJUANA – MM
ORC:3796.062.text: _____________ did knowingly transport (adult-use marijuana or medical marijuana) unlawfully in a motor vehicle, to wit: (DESCRIBE CONDITION, PACKAGING, AND LOCATION OF MARIJUANA IN MOTOR VEHICLE), in violation of Section 3796.062(B) and Section 3796.99(I) of the Ohio Revised Code, a minor misdemeanor.

ORC:3796.062.heading: TRANSPORTATION OF MARIJUANA 3796.062(C) ORC AND 3796.99(I) ORC
ORC:3796.062.text: _____________ did knowingly transport (adult-use marijuana or medical marijuana) unlawfully in a motor vehicle, to wit: (DESCRIBE CONDITION AND LOCATION OF MARIJUANA IN MOTOR VEHICLE), in violation of Section 3796.062(C) and Section 3796.99(I) of the Ohio Revised Code, a minor misdemeanor.
ORC:3796.062.notes: DEFINITIONS 2133.02 CCC ALL PURPOSE VEHICLE – means any self-propelled vehicle designed primarily for cross-country travel on land and water, or on more than one type of terrain, and steered by wheels or caterpillar treads, or any combination thereof, including vehicles that operate on a cushion of air, vehicle commonly known as all-terrain vehicles, all-season vehicles, mini-bikes, and trail bikes. “All-purpose vehicle” does not include a utility vehicle as defined in Section 4501.01 of the Ohio Revised Code or any vehicle principally used in playing golf, any motor vehicle, or aircraft required to be registered under Chapter 4503 or 4561 of the Ohio Revised Code, and any vehicle excepted from definition as a motor vehicle by division (B) of Section 4501.01 of the Ohio Revised Code.

CCC:2133.02.heading: RECKLESS OPERATION 2133.02(C) CCC
CCC:2133.02.variant: ON PUBLIC OR PRIVATE STREETS – WITHOUT DUE REGARD
CCC:2133.02.text: _____________ did operate an all-purpose vehicle or off-highway motorcycle, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE VEHICLE) on any street, highway, or on any public or private property other than streets or highways, to wit: (STATE LOCATION OF OPERATION) without due regard for the safety of persons or property, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE OPERATION), in violation of Section 2133.02(C) of the Columbus City Code, an unclassified misdemeanor.
CCC:2133.02.notes: NOTE: While this section is an unclassified misdemeanor, the minimum fine is $500.00 up to $1,000.00 and the offender can be placed in jail for up to 30 days.

CCC:2133.02.heading: RECKLESS OPERATION 2133.02(D) CCC
CCC:2133.02.variant: ON PUBLIC OR PRIVATE STREETS – WILLFUL OR WANTON DISREGARD
CCC:2133.02.text: _____________ did operate an all-purpose vehicle or off-highway motorcycle, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE VEHICLE) on any street, highway, or on any public or private property other than streets or highways, to wit: (STATE LOCATION OF OPERATION) in willful or wanton disregard for the safety of persons or property, to wit: (DESCRIBE THE OPERATION), in violation of Section 2133.02(D) of the Columbus City Code, an unclassified misdemeanor.
CCC:2133.02.notes: NOTE: While this section is an unclassified misdemeanor, the minimum fine is $500.00 up to $1,000.00 and the offender can be placed in jail for up to 30 days.
